eng_Latn: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa le ɔkɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, káā lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um eyī nwūla kóō lɛ ɛbɛ má. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le eyī kú ɔyípōklóbíya ā nwūla, anɔ́ɔ ó má ka ɛyí ɛfu ā le mu mla aɔ́nya o bī kpɛ́fú, aúgbɔ́ɔnya o bī kpɛ́fú kú ɔlá le yɛ Ɛláyíssa jīla tá.

eng_Latn: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā gaá gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū, eko nōó lɔfú kɛlā igbɔhá glá ā, ó le cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí uwā, ó kwú Usímīyɔn ú, le ɔ́ abɔ̄ gbō ipéyī uwā.

eng_Latn: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le aádáádā alɔ fu, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ uwá pīya éwo ɛnɛ̄hi eko nēé wɛ ugbɔga ipú ajɛ Íjīpiti ā. Ó bī abōlɔfú le uwā kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā géē mɛtāajɛ, amáŋ a géē yɔ̄ piyóó. Ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpancō géē kpó gbɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka īlī ā, é kē géē kpó uwā bónū bɛ̄ɛka áhingílí ā. é kē í je gblífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
idu_Latn: N géē hɔ́ɔ́hā ce aá klla géē je ayí alɛwa lɛ aá. N géē lɛ okónu kú um, nɛ̄ n ce lɛ aá ā tū.

eng_Latn: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɔlɛcɛ, le ɔdā nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka lɛ uwá ka ɛnyā wɛ ɔwɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā cá um ɛcá mla á le kpaakpa kú uwā ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā í tá ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄ kóō gwó ɔlɛ́ ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē gwó ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā, yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ bónū áncā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú í leyī kwaajɛ kóō gbō igelī nɛ̄hi dúúmā ŋ́, ācogbāajɛ ā bá ī gbāajɛ bónū icííci.

eng_Latn: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē da uwá ka, ísu kú Ujɔ́dan kwú hɛ́ hɔ́hā tá, eko nēé bī ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā gaá bū ɔ̄ ā. Ɛcɔ̄ ā kē í yɔ̄ ī blatū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu eko dóódu, ɔdā nōo yá ā.

eng_Latn: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́dɔm yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ nū. É tɛtɛ wɛ aícɔ́ɔja nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi amáŋ é gwutá ɔlékwu ícɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, nēé ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ ká ācɛ o doōcē ā kéē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okónōgwu kú úwé kú nū á. Odúúdú uwā nēe lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ā, le hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
idu_Latn: Awɔ kē je ɔfú gā um ká n kpɛ́fú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n yá aólɛla kú um lé á.

eng_Latn: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē je ɔlɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ oyɔ́bɔ́cɛ yíífi tāajɛ. Amáŋ ó gē gbō aɔ́dā nɛ̄ ɔnyōkwū lɛ ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu, aá nēé hile ŋmá ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ami húmáyī leyīkwu aá jāā ŋmá eko nēé ma aá á.

eng_Latn: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ n gē nwū ācɛ ɛlā, é gē jāhɔ̄ cíí gē gbēyī ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó wɛ odúúdú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá icɔ́ɔci kú Ujudíya ā jé um eyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the LORD God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ icō kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bɛ̄ɛka ojuja ā. Ó géē tá ɔyī kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ o límanya ā. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō géē dɛ̄ bɛ́ɛka opo nēé yɔ̄ ī tá ā. Ó géē bɛ́yíkwu aólɛlā kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ofúlutu nōo ŋmá ɛháajɛ.

eng_Latn: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛdɔ kú ácí nɛ̄ aálá gē lé ā hɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ a klla lɛ ácí ɔlamu nōo yɔ̄ ɔkwu ɛfu ā kpó hɛ́ eko nɛ̄ ácí nɛ̄ aálá gē lé ā yɔ̄ ī lū abāābɔ̄ ŋmá ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
idu_Latn: É géē nū aá tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ, amáŋ eko gē wā, eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ aá ŋmó géē gbɛlá ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
idu_Latn: É yékwu klla jikwú, í lé ɔdōlé ŋ́ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ohígbū Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, Ujonátan, mɛ́mla ohígbū ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā, alɛwa nēé ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
idu_Latn: Īkpēyī kú um lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā má ɛɛ́. Ahɔ̄ kú um klla lɛ odúúdú uwá pó ɛɛ́. N kē lɛ ɛyí odúúdú uwā kpó jé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
idu_Latn: Á yá um omáaba wā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ le ɔtū má um ɔtū ŋ́, amáŋ ŋmífī nɛ̄ n wā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā ɔ̄cɛnyā nyá í mā ō lɛ okónu kwu um ikpó tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, n géē yá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn lɔfú, kllá í je Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú um tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄. Amáŋ n géē cē ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti abɔ̄, ó kē í yɔ̄ ī tá ifu iyɔ̄bū olɛlā kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé le yá ágbe yɔ̄ ī kwú ā.

eng_Latn: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá abɔ̄yī aá, aá le odée tíne lɛ uwá kéē lé. É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ā wɛ igbō ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛbéenyi ɛpa. A yɔ̄ ī leyīce alɔ ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔdōlé lá lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛwa nɛ̄hi nyā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwá. Ó bī ɛhɔ̄ nyā gé lɛ uwá ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Óndú ā ka anúɔ kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ajɛ Íjīpiti á.

eng_Latn: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
idu_Latn: Alɔ blakwu ɛbéenyi nɛ̄ alɔ gē lé ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ cɛgbá lɛ ā. Ógāapɛ, mɛ́mla álibácā, mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé hī ka ukúkūmba ā.

eng_Latn: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā kpó aádáádā alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ācɛ kú Íjīpiti bī úgbɔ́ɔnyā o kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla ɔnya ɛfú le nū uwā inyā. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ gā okónu ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ikwú kú nū ā, Ábīja klla le ɔfú lɛ tū ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi. Ábīja le anyā igwɛ́ɛnɛ, ó ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ofucɛpa mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā igwɛ́ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mla Ujúda! Eko tɛtɛ ā, aéwo ɔhá gē bī ɔdā nōo yá aá ā lɛ tókónu lɛ iyi uwá ka, Ká ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ífi nōo klá Ísrɛ̄lu mla Ujúda ā kóō wā í klá aá! Amáŋ, n géē nya aá tá. Cɛ́ɛ́ aéwo ɔhá ɔ́ɔmā géē da iyī uwā ka, Kéē lɛ ɛdɔ ɔhā ékpónú nēé hɛ́ ce ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda ā hɛ́ ce aá dúú. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá lɛ ɔtū lé, aá híī yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē lɛ aíne ā tá tū ɔcí okómpīinu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ɔdūngwɔwɛ kú igá kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
idu_Latn: Aóhī le behé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ga ipú ajɛ kú Ugádi mɛ́mla Ugílɛ̄di. Eko nyā Usɔ́lu klá Ugígalu kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ipú kú ācɛ nēe bá mla anú ā kwú gbogodo.

eng_Latn: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
idu_Latn: Óndú ālɛ aícɔ́ɔja oōgɔ̄ mla oolɛɔtū nɛ̄hi kú nū a kpó hīīgwú wɛ̄ɛcɛ, ka e wā í kpó ɛfú otīihɔ ta ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú āle cɔ̄nū mla uwá a ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí nū Ábīja ā he ɔ́ ɔtú fíyɛ́ odúúdú ayí ɔhá nɛ̄ anyā ɔhá ma lɛ ɔ́ á. Anú nɛ̄ ó je lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí īyī nū á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ gē ce īyī uwā a, n le ɔ̄na nā anɔ́ɔ n le má ka aópī nēe bá ī ce aɛ́wū wɛ ohíkākā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí, mɛ́mla otína cílɛ́cílɛ́.

eng_Latn: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē kpó odúúdú aéwo ā wā í túbá tɔ̄ɔ̄há kéē kpɛ́fú tá Ujerúsālɛm, é géē mīyɛ Ujerúsālɛm, kē í je agbénú kpó wu ŋmá ipú aínu alɛwa. É klla í hɛ ācɛnyā kú uwā bá ajɛ abɔ̄fú. É géē kpó āyā éyi kú ācɛ ā ga ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ, amáŋ, é gáā kpó āyā o hile ɔhá ā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ɔwɔ ɔ́ɔmā nōo gē je yá nɛ̄ ajɛ gē kwú bá ɔhá kpɔ́kɔ́ɔ klla ī je ŋmó kɔ́ngɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu ā tá ā, ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yá apíili ga ɛgiyí Ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi Usísa á, nááná ā ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka ń kpó ɛlā dúúmā ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ɛlā ŋmá lɛ ícɔ̄nū kú um. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá kú útuló gē yi ɔ̄cɛ ā. N géē je aá tá abɔ̄ ācobɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi, ācɛ nēe wɛ ɔka kú odée ō je yíífi.

eng_Latn: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń tíne ō pi uwɔ abɔ̄fú káā tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ n dɔɔ̄kā ká ā yá ɔ̄ ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ lɛ ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔma ń gáā yá ɔda dúú ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ a cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá ba Ɔwɔicō ɔdā nōo ce aá ɛgbá ā, ó kē í je lɛ aá. Aá tíne odée ŋmó ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, a kē í lɛ ɔ́. Aá lɛ abɔ̄ gbo ɔ̄wɛ ā, é kē í nwūla ɔ́ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú uwā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi ka ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú pīya tɔ̄há mla Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi á ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ alɛwa kú ācɛ Ugríisi, nēe ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā, mɛ́mla ācɛnyā alɛwa nēe cɛgbá ipú igelī ā á.

eng_Latn: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Alelékwū Ihɔ ā í wā í ce odúúmā kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, amáŋ é yá uwā Ubatísim ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Óndú, Ujísɔ̄si ōfōōfūnū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ijē nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ujúda yɔ̄ ī gwó eko ɔ́ɔmā kahíníi, Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kú iyó ōbī le jɛ̄ alɔ, klla yɔ̄ í cē alɔ gwōnū, alɔ í klla lɔfú yúklɔ́ ɔdɔ ō ma ā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: According to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ jila mla anú ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhórɛ̄bu ā, ɛ́ɛ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ kú ɔ̄ híī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá pó ɔkɛ̄lá kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kōō ī cɛ̄ lɛ aá má eyī ō cɔ̄lá kú nū ā ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ aá géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Unówa wɛ iháyí úlā ce ofigwó eko nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā cēenyi klá ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ajɛ ā, anúɔ kwú ɛhíícō kú igelī kú Arówɛ, nōo kwū Ísu kú Ánɔn ajaajɛ ā ú lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi. Ó ka anúɔ kwú āyā ōhī kú ajɛ kú ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugílɛ̄di ā ú lɛ uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gē yɔ̄ ī gwíijē, yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ piyóó. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gē yɔ̄ ī yá okónu nɛ̄ n ce gā uwɔ ā jīla eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwɔ í cɛgbá eko ɔnɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋ́ má, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ojīlīmā ō je lɛ olíla í cɛgbá ŋ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
idu_Latn: Aá géē yɔ̄ ī kpó ɔdā dóódu nēe ce ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ɛgbá ā lɛ uwá eko. Aá gáā nyí uwā ɔdā dúú ŋ́. Aá klla í kpó aɔ́bɛ́ɛna, aálá, ámāŋ ka ɔyí álá kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ɔkpáncō, ámāŋ ka īkpɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄, ɔmā, ejé ámāŋ anɔ̄ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā le kpó hídáagó anɔ́ɔ é yɔ̄ í ka lɛ ɔ́mpa uwā kahíníī, Ɔdí i yɔ̄ āa? Ɛdɔ kú ɛlā ōnwu ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ yɔ̄ dúú! Ó bī íkwu le ɔ́da je lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí, anɔ́ɔ é kē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
idu_Latn: Ugbɔga, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ o yúklɔ́ ɔ́gwū dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá í gáā lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord God, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā ka anú nōo wɛ Óndú ā, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kóō kóocōō blakwu anúɔ. Ɔwɔicō kú anúɔ kóō kóocōō kóō lɛ ɔfú tū anúɔ iyē igbɔhá kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ ulé kú eyī kú anúɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya ɛ́ɛ kpó pu ā cílá igbeékpónú ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da uwá kóō lɛ ā, é lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú aéwo ɔhá nēé lɛ ā kpó bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
idu_Latn: Alɔ nēe wɛ alɛɛcɛ ā, oyēeyī kú alɔ le kpií bɛ̄ɛka ákú ácí nɛ̄ ó gē yɔ̄ gbojī ŋ́ mā. Alɔ gē jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ododó kú ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
idu_Latn: É nyɔ̄ í cikpó uwá, klla nyɔ̄ í cikpó uwá agōdō. É klá kwúcē wā í cikpó Ohóla mla oholíba, anyā ō yá unwū ācɛnyīlɔ ā.

eng_Latn: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ɔ̄na ā yɔ̄ á ɔcɛ́, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ́da nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā je kóō yá uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā kpɔ́ ā, n má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo lɛ eyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ yɔ̄ ī wā ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō ipú ɔ̄na kú um ā dúu.

eng_Latn: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le Ujósɛ̄fu kwú, kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá, ɛga nēé gē kpó aálagbá kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ bá ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu klá agbá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
idu_Latn: Inu dúúmā nōó bēé nyɔ̄ ā, aá da ádɔ̄lɛ́ ā ka Itíca kú alɔ ka, iní nɛ̄ anúɔ mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú anúɔ géē lé ɔdōlé kú ucɛ kú Onyatá āā.

eng_Latn: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
idu_Latn: kóō lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū mafú gā um cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi lɛyíkwu ɔ́ lɛ aílɔ́wá ā, ń kōō ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō nwū um ɛlā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ ka ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ géē hīgwú lɛ ɔ́ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi ka Usámūwɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko dúúmā, ó gē kpó odée lɛ ācɛ alahá, klla ī lɛ ɔdā ō le kplá ācɛ ɔhá. Ayí nū kē wɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ Óndú ā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
idu_Latn: Ɛga dúú nɛ̄ ɛfɔ́ɔ́lá yi mɛ̄ ā nɛ̄ ɔlá gē nyí ā, ɛga dúú nɛ̄ awanda í yɔ̄ ŋ́, ikpɛ́lā gē mɛ.

eng_Latn: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
idu_Latn: Issíya, ɔyí kú Uréhabíya.

eng_Latn: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a gáā gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɛyí ede, anɔ́ɔ a le bla ka ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ bī odée lɛyíkwu uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɛɛcɛ le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ kpó ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ a kē lɛ je oyī lɛ uwá kéē gwá á. Ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ uwá ā nēé bá ī mīyɛ á.

eng_Latn: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ipú ɔtū kú um íne kú Ɔwɔicō he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu lɛ ohi kpó gé lɛ ɔcɛ́ ka áluka kú odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ nēe ga ɔgbɛ́fú glá ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ úlā bá ɛgiyí úlā ɛhɔ̄ . Áluka kú ācɛ kú Ujúda ā wɛ úlā bá ɛgiyí úlā ɛtá ce ofɛpa cigwó .

eng_Latn: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, kɛlá klá Ujerúsālɛm, kɛlá klá ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā. Pi ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ahɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
idu_Latn: Alɔ̄ cɛ̄ tɔ̄há ka alɔ géē da aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā kéē bī lɛ gbɛ̄gbā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā: igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́ mā, umu, ɛna mɛ́mla álá kú ɔdā ɛgbā kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú ɛ̄cī dóódu, mɛ́mla ɛya otīihɔ kú Usábāti, eko kú ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla eko ucɛ ɔhá dóódu. Alɔ klla í bī ɔdā ɛ̄gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bīya ā, í yá uwā ɛhi. Alɔ klla í kpó aɔ́dā ɔhá dóódu nōo cɛgbá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā wā dúú.

eng_Latn: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
idu_Latn: A le bɛ̄cɛ wā gaá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ hɛ́tá, klla le ɔcɛ́ nāa fu ā hɛ́tá. A le otrɛ̄yí kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā ŋmó wā ajɛ, klla kwú ācɛ nōo gē yɛce ɔ́ ā ú kpó yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ Umósīsi ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā nōo da ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō géē fu ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ ayínɛ́ kú aá kóō le pīya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ bɛ̄ɛka ami ā; Ó kē géē wɛ éyi kú ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si leyī pīya má uwā anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ācɛnyā kú Ujerúsālɛm! Aá híīī jikwū ohígbū ŋ́, amáŋ aá jikwū ohígbū iyī aá mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo kɛlā ga um ā bī ogbló kú ugóolu nēé ī le miya odée abɔ̄ kóō le miya Igelī ā, mɛ́mla aókónɔɔwɛ kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
idu_Latn: Uhússāyi da Ábsālɔm ka ɔ́dāŋ ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ kōō le kwu ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi dóódu nááná, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá ɔ́ɔ géē kpó ɔ́ŋgbá wā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ igá kú igelī ā pi wāajɛ ga ipú ɔpɛ́. Ó ka ɛcɔ̄ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ kōō gáā ce iyī uwā icō ɛfu nɛ̄ igelī ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ kwu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɔhi. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka igá kú ɔdɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gē kwu í tayínū ipú nū eko kú unwalu ā. Ó gē leyīkwu ācɛ nēe kwu ga ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayí kú Ulífāyi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́hāti, Uméhāti, ɔyí kú Amasáyi, Ujówɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Asárīya, ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umérāri. Ukíss, ɔyí kú Ábudi mɛ́mla Asárīya, ɔyí kú Ujɛhalɛ́lɛl, ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn. Ujówa, ɔyí kú Usíma, mɛ́mla Éden, ɔyí kú Ujówa.

eng_Latn: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
idu_Latn: N le je lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛhícō ā, kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ é bá ajaajɛ mɛ́mla ɛga oligbó ā le gwá. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwá gwá ɔgbɔɔgba. N le je lɛ odúúdú aéwo nēe bá ɛcɛ nyā ā le gwá. Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú uwá le gwá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú Ussɛ́ssāku le gwá dúú.

eng_Latn: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ pi ɔyí uwɔ ahɔ̄, ó kē í je omlɛ́nyɔ́ gā uwɔ. Ó klla gáā yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo gē wɛ uwēyī ga uwɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
idu_Latn: N géē je aójibó kú ɔwɔ, nōo lé ka Ássɛ̄ra ā ca tāajɛ ŋmá ipú aá klla í je aígelī nɛ̄hi kú aá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king's laws: therefore it is not for the king's profit to suffer them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uháman le da ɔcɛ́ a kahíníī, Ígwu kú ācɛ éyi lā ipú ajɛ kú uwɔ ā. É le nyīla klá ɛga dóódu kú ipú ajɛ kú uwɔ ā. Ucē kú uwá wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ̄ ucē kú alɔ tá. Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, é ī lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā ŋ́. Ó gáā lɔhi ga uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka á yɔ̄ í leyīkwu uwá kpɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
idu_Latn: N gē blakwu ɛlā ā nɛ̄ a cɛ̄ ŋmá ɔtū ékpó nāa lɛ ā, ɛdɔ kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ nɔnyakwɔcɛ Ulɔyísi mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ Iyunís kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā lɛ ā. N kē jé kpɔ́cii ka a cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
idu_Latn: É gē lɛ ɔtū tū iyī uwā ɔtū ipú ujɔ̄ obɔ̄bí nēé gē tū ā. É gē miya ɛga nēé géē kpla ukpa tá ā. É gē gbɛlá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í má alɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati bī tū Óndú klla kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ ā, bī tū Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ujísɔ̄si gē ga Ujerúsālɛm ɔnū ucɛ kú onyatá.

eng_Latn: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
idu_Latn: Ń mɛ́ɛbɛ glá gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ka ɔtūnōbí kú um le nwuné. Aábɔ̄ mɛ́mla aíkpó kú um le nyinyi kɔ́ŋgɔ́ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí ā.

eng_Latn: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ɔnyakwɔ́cɛ ā lé ka Ohóla, nōo kwɛyí Usɛmérīya ā. Iyē kú ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā lé ka Oholíba, nōo kwɛyí Ujerúsālɛm ā. N lɛ uwá lɛ anyā um, é klla ma ayí gā um.

eng_Latn: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, awɔ, Óndú ā, wɛ ɔcɛ́ o yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ, A kē í cɔcɛ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ mɛ.

eng_Latn: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
idu_Latn: Ámāŋ ɛ́gɛ́nyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā géē lɔfú ga inu kú ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú gaá je odée kú nū abɔ̄fú glá ā? Ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú ɔ́ɔmā gbō gbɔbū ń nɛɛ? Eko ɔ́ɔmā nōó géē kpó iyó kú nū glá á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā yá ācɛ kú Ujúda, ohígbū ka Áhāsi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā le íne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū bīya, ó klla ci ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ínoōbīya ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, N géē nyīla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í gáā gbo uwá áluka glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é leyī pīya gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ ga iyāwu kú uwā. Ayí ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú uwā gbɔbū lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ dóódu nɛ̄ eyī kú nū le pu, ámāŋ nōo lɛ ipí, ámāŋ nōo le gbiíkwá, aá híī bī ɔ̄ wā ɛyí ede gaá gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
idu_Latn: Aá ka ofu nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ɔtáhɛ́ aéwo dóódu. Aá ka úklɔ̄ idáagó kú nū tá ɛcɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kahíníī, Awɔ ā ɔdí nɛ̄ a bī ɔ̄ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛkpa igwu ofɛhɔ̄! Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú ɔkpá kú uwɔ ú ká ā lɛ ɛkpa ofɛnɛ tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Ujísɔ̄si le tá igelī éyi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi nɛ̄ iyē kú nū wɛ agwáágwú ā. Eko nōó le Ujísɔ̄si má ā, ó má gbo kláajɛ le eyī pīya kláajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ɔ́dāŋ ka a cɛ̄, a lɔfú hɛ́ um tá ŋmá agwu kú um nyā glá.

eng_Latn: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄tra awɔ, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, a lɔfú nɛ̄hi. A le ifa yá mla ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ɛgahi bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī lɛ úwé wiyē ā.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ɔtāhɛ̄ Ucérūbim ā. Awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ gē gbō odúúdú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ á. Awɔ yá ɔkpáncō mla ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ami ā, n yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú aá nɛ̄. Aá yá um ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi klla le kpaakpa tū aá ā.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
idu_Latn: Ukálɛ̄bu, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́fūnɛ ā ma ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā: Íru, Ɛlā mɛ́mla Unáam. Ɛlā wɛ ádā kú Ukénāsi ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔmahāapa ā, aá géē na īlī kú aá, cɛ́ɛ́, aá kwú yá yēŋēē, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ aá nwúla ō wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
idu_Latn: Oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛlā kú ɔkpá nyā yɔ̄ á, ayínɛ́ alɔ, aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū alɔ olɛhɔ̄ kú Óndú ā kóō nyīla gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ keē cɛ̄tra anú ɛga dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄tra nū eko nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, N le eko kú ɛpɔ̄ tū ɛɛ́, n kē í hɛ́pɔ̄ ā kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ jégēdēē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, nɛ̄ ācɛ ɛpa lɛ ijáalí cɛ̄ tū ɔ̄, é géē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā. Amáŋ, ijáalí kú ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú í jɛ̄ ō bī lɛ ŋmó oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ kwɛyí ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó ŋmó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
idu_Latn: Ísu ɔ́mpa ā lé ka ísu kú Ugíhɔn. Anú ā gē pɛ́ kɔ́nɔ̄kɔnɔ̄ bū ajɛ kú Ukúss á.

eng_Latn: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
idu_Latn: É gē gwíijē lɛyíkwu ɔdā nāa yá ā mɛ́mla ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
idu_Latn: Á gáā nyā ācobɔ̄bíipú ā tá ŋ́, ohígbū keé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī gbɛlá kwu aɔ́dā kú aá ōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ aá gbɛlá kwu ákú ācɛ ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
idu_Latn: Ɔɔ̄daŋ ka ɔwɔ nɛ̄ aa hɛ́ tū a, ka ō kwú jɛ̄ ícɛicɛ nɛ̄ a hɛ́ ɔɔ tū a, ka o gwá īkpō nāanā, aa gāa cē ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá anú glá ŋ́, ó gē kwu abɔ̄, unwalu mla ōwē mla ɔnɔ la aa ōfuōofūnū.

eng_Latn: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ede gwó abɔ́ɔ, kwú iyē ú ce abɔ́ɔ ka, Ɛl-bɛ́tɛlu, ohígbū ka abɔ́ɔ ā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ma īyīnū fú lɛ ɔ́ eko nōó yɔ̄ ī kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ísɔ á.

eng_Latn: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ayíbɛ, ó wɛ ami abɔ̄yī um gē yá ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ínoōbīya nōo lā ipú ɔtū kú um ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla lɛ mafú lɛ ɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē je úklɔ́ lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Ulífāyi, mɛ́mla ācoyúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ o bī iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó tíne kóō ŋmó Ujɔ́ni nááná ā, ó gē yúúfi ācɛ Ujíyu ā. Ohígbū ka uwá je Ujɔ́ni ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ikwū nēé je yɔ̄ ī hīla ayínū ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le blakwu okónu nōó nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ Ébrahām, mla Áyísīki mla Ujékɔ̄pu āa.

eng_Latn: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.
idu_Latn: Ɛtɛ́ mɛ́mla ocíbú mɛ́mla usóbɛ̄lu o bī fɔ́ɔlá ā mɛ́mla aɔ́gbanjɛ̄ ā. Ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ oje udɔ olɔhi nɛ̄ Uhúram bī le yá odúúdú iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nōó yá lɛ Usólōmɔn kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ oyódōbɔ̄bí bá ī cɛ̄ ijáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tū um. É gē da um ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ń jé ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē jɔ́ɔkwu nū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Utáma da ɔ́ ka ehée, ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ, ka ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē nū anúɔ bɛ̄cɛ ā ɔ́ɔ klla bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá anúɔ ā á. Amáŋ Ámnɔn í jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ cɛgbá ga uwɔ dúú ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a ī lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ āa?.

eng_Latn: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā Ujísɔ̄si klla le hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ ɔwɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ɔtāhɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā nēe yɔ̄ ī ga ipɔ́lɛ́ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ í bá ɛga kú aá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ipɔ́ɔma ipɔ́ɔma kú aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úklɔ́ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ɔyí nū Usólōmɔn je lɛ aá ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū géē bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū le gbō ɛyí ɛfu kú usáyɔn ā. Amáŋ é géē je Umówābu wúlatāajɛ lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ tāajɛ, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī lɛ ikpó da ácí bá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ, ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi le ka ga awɔ kahíníī, Ɔdōlé nyā wɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ é je lɛ ɛcí nɛ̄ n. Ó le lɛ ā, a híīī lé ɔdōlé ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ̄cɛ nōo da awɔ ā mɛ́mla ohígbū ɔtū ō junwatu.

eng_Latn: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ uwá má, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kóō lɛ aá jila. Abɔ̄ é bá yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ɔwɛ ā agwú kú uwā ā mɛ.

eng_Latn: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kwú Ujísɔ̄si ú kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpíinu ōfōōfūnū ā. É klla gáā lɛ ikpíinu ɔhá táajɛ gwō ɔ̄ tá glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ éyi hīgwú wā ɛgiyí nū á, kwú ɔ̄ ú háyi ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā á.

eng_Latn: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
idu_Latn: nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá. Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ Ubɛ́la, ɔcɛ́ kú Usɔ́dɔm, mɛ́mla Ubɛsíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugomóra, mɛ́mla Ussína, ɔcɛ́ kú Ádma, mɛ́mla Ussɛmɛ́ba, ɔcɛ́ kú Usebɔyíim, mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú Ubɛ́la .

eng_Latn: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
idu_Latn: Ussɛ́ma wɛ ádā kú Uráham, mɛ́mla ádáádā kú Ujɔkím á. Ɔyínɛ́ kú Ussɛ́ma wɛ ádā kú Ussammáyi.

eng_Latn: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
idu_Latn: É gē tá ūlī ká e jé ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔtū kú Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū gē tá ohi kú ūlī ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ mla ācɛ nēé gē lɛ íne tū ŋ́ mā, n gē cēyītīkwū ká n̄ lɛ íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu tū ŋ́. N gē yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé gē lɛ íne tū ŋ́ mā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n lɛ uwá bī gé lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. N gē lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō tū ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ gē yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ka lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ géē yá ka ojiji nɛ̄ ɛnɔ ɔ́ɔ tá ce agidigbé nɛ̄ Áhās, nōo tɛtɛ wɛ ɔcɛ́ īkée ā gwó ā, kóo yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu ga igbīhi ikpó igwó. Anɔ́ɔ ojiji ā kē le yɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu ga igbīhi ikpó igwó ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó lā iháyí ofigwó ce ahāapa ɔhá kpɔ́. Ó klla le ayí ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya tá Uhananíya ohi iyɔ̄bū ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe háyi abɔ́ɔ, ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī nwū ācɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā, ācɛ Ufarisisi ōhī mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne nēe pɛ́ ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aípɔ́lɛ́ kú Ugálīli mɛ́mla Ujudíya mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm cīce abɔ́ɔ dúú. Ɔwɔicō le ɔfú je lɛ Ujísɔ̄si eko ɔ́ɔmā kóō hɛ ācɛ nōo ī doōcē tá.

eng_Latn: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu cāŋjɛ le ayí nū mɛ́mla anyā ɔlɛ́ nū kpó ce ɛyí aínyankwūlūmī.

eng_Latn: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ̄kā da, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔyí nyā wɛ ɔyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwā kahíníī, Aá ma ayí alɛwa kú aá nyīla tū ipú ɛcɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá mīyɛ ɛcɛ tābɔ̄. Aá kóō lɛ íkwu īkpɛ̄yí kú aɛ́béenyi, aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.
idu_Latn: Ka ɛ̄cī éyi ugbɔga éyi ɔ́ɔ gā ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ agbénú nɛ̄hi ā. Ó kē lɔtū je álá éyi ŋmá ipú aálá alɛwa kú nū ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le ŋmó ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá ɔdōlé lɛ ugbɔga ā glá ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́ɔ gaá kwú álá ékpónú kú ɔ̄cɛ ogbɛhá ā ú. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ ŋmó lɛ ɔdōlé yá lɛ ugbɔga nōo wā ɔlɛ́ nū ā á.

eng_Latn: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā gā, nēé kwú Íjīpiti ú yíífi. N géē kpó aócɛhɔ̄ tū úgbéenyi nyɔ̄ ī wu ɔtū kú ācɛ kú Itiyópiya klícō, uwá géē yúufi nɛ̄hi. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā yɔ̄ ī wā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, alɔ lɔtūce ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā cɛ̄ ā. Ó géē lɔhi lɛ aá fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɛlā kú uwā, ohígbū ka ɛlā ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo ī cɛ̄ ipú ajɛ odobū jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔlá kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá kú ínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, géē fíyajɛ ipú ɔtū kú aá.

eng_Latn: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
idu_Latn: Aígbómína igwɛ́ɛpa ā mɛ́mla ɛga kú ajɛ nēé gē leyīkwu ɔ́ ā bá yɔ̄ á. Ubɛnhɔ́ wɛ igbómína kú ɔlɛ́ ɛyí ɛfú kú Ɛ́frem.

eng_Latn: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.
idu_Latn: Ó gē tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō, gē nwū ɛlā kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá pāālā, ó kē yúufi ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kē ci ɔ́ anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ujóssuwa píyɛyí wā ɛgiyí nū ɛbɔ́ ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú Umakéda. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ipú ajɛ ā í lɔtú kɛlā lɛyíkwu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
idu_Latn: Eko nāa le tá abɔ́ɔ, dɔɔ̄kā ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo lé ka Ujéhu ɔyí kú Ujɛhósāfati, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Unímīssi ā. Eko nāa lɛ ɔ́ má, kwú ɔ̄ ú ga ɛkwūbá ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ́mpānū.

eng_Latn: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ má ofu kú Óndú ā ɔwɛ dóódu eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ɔlá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā ŋ́. Ó da uwá ka ohígbū olɔhi kú iyī uwā ā ɛ́ɛ má ka.

eng_Latn: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the LORD hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ bī iyē kú Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka anɔ́ɔ ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka ā í yá ŋ́, ɛ́mba ɛlā abɔ̄yī nū nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ bī íkwu kú iyīnū ka tɛ́ɛcɛ á. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ cíka ō yúúfi ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ɛnɔ lɛ ɔkɔ nwūla ā, ó lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nyā kwú boolo anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ɛgba kú nū í lipú ga ipú ajɛ ŋ́ mā, ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nēe bá ā le kpó yɔlá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ aá kwú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ ú gicō, nɛ̄ aá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ anú á, ka ń yá ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɔfú kú um ŋ́, amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā ā nwū um ā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n gē ka á.

eng_Latn: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē hī Óndú igwú. Óndú ā kē í nya um tá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: É géē tēelihɔ iyē kú aá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aéwo ɔhá, cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, N géē kpó aɔ́lɛ́ kú Uhásɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ákú Ubenhádādi nēé hɛ́ igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi kóō wɛ ɔkplɛ́fú kú uwā yɔlá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ébú gē cē ŋmá ipú ajɛ nōo ī kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ í kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi, abɔ̄ alɔ ka ka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Usamérīya, klla lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá nyā wɛ ɛbéelihɔ lɛ aá, ŋmá ipú aɛ́bɛ́ nēe géē pi yɛ ajɛ ā. Aífú ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā. Aápa ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí bɛ̄ɛka ufū, ɔbɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le yá lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ n géē wā í nya aá tá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛnɔ kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī géē fíyájɛ klá aá ā. É géē nya aá tá fíyaa. Ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā géē cījáalí lɛ aá iyɔ̄bū um. N géē yɔ̄ pī aá, géē gbō aá ŋmá ɔ́kíkā dóódu.

eng_Latn: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ gáā tá iyē uwā tāajɛ, ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ ga igelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usɛ́būlɔn ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā tá uwā ohi ka ɔdā dúú kóō je unwalu lɛ uwá ŋ́, ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gē leyīkwu uwá ipú iyāwu kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄hi yá lɛ alɔ ɔkwɛ̄yi gbóó, ɔtū kē he alɔ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
idu_Latn: Ífi nōo wā í klá ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ um cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɛbɛ océyī má, Eko nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtā yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā, aɛ́nɛ́ ogbonɛnɛ kwú ayí abɔ̄yī ūwā ú kpó he lé kwɛyí ɔdōlé. Ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī ī gē má ŋ́ má, nɛ̄ ōwē mɛ́mla ífi mɛ́mla ákanya nyā kpó wā i klá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um á.

eng_Latn: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ, ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe dɔɔ̄kā ō bī ɔdā ɛhi nēé géē lɛ gwó Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā, le kpó wā. É le odúúdú ɔdā dóódu nēe cɛgbá kéē lɛ gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é géē gɔ́ ɔdōwiyē kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kpó wā.

eng_Latn: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
idu_Latn: géē mīyɛ ulé nū igbalɛwa ipú oyēeyī nyā. Ó kē í mīyɛ oyēeyī opiyóó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ipú ɛcɛ ɔhá nōo ī wā ā.

eng_Latn: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ūlī tá ohígbū īlī kú um kéē le ɔ́ kpó kɔ̄ lɛ īyī uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he erected there an altar, and called it EleloheIsrael.
idu_Latn: Ó le ede nōó géē gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí nū ā gwó abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó hī ɔ̄ kahíníī, Ɛ́l-Ɛ́lōhi Ísrɛ̄lu. nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ, Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ī gbā ā.

eng_Latn: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā gē gwō kahíníī, Ami yá odúúdú nū abɔ̄yī um á. N lɔfú, jééyī klla lɛ ula. N lɛ aéwo yálé, mīyɛ uwā ajɛ dúúdú, klla kwú odúúdú iyó mɛ́mla agbénú nēé kpó tū ā í kpó. Bɛ̄ɛka ɔbá ɛna ā, n kwú aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā í kpó yíifi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nwuné klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ cíkā ō cɛ̄tra anú nwuné, ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ mɛ́mla ɛyí ɛfu ōtīihɔ kú nū.

eng_Latn: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú uwɔ le ōwē má nɛ̄hi. Alɔ bá ī ga ɔwɛ ga ácí bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ejé lɛ alɔ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ijakī ā lɛ alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā má­ ā, ó le kwu bá ɔdɔ, le Ubálam ikpó kwu bá ɔdɔ ká. Ubálam le ijakī ā gɔ́ igbɔhá lɛ ɔ̄ pīyɛyí tá ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ miya ɛɛ́ mā wɛ ka, Ɔwɔicō le uwɔ miya, anɔ́ɔ ó kē má ka, á wɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ a cíka ō wɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í nwūla ɔ́ okónu kú nū nōo le mu mla aīnu otūufi kú nū ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass together.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī gbō ɛna mɛ́mla ijakī bɔ́há kéē hɛ́hɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán wɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú Ussɔ́ham.

eng_Latn: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn kwu ɔnyā nū, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Uféro, nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā ú ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi ā gaá lā inu nɛ̄ ó gwó lɛ ɔ́ ōfōōfūnū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á gáā lā ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ ikpáti kú ɛka kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ ɛɛ́, abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ ɛga otīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā wā ɛgiyí nū otú ɔ́ɔmā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām ádā uwɔ á. Ā híī yúúfi ŋ́, n yɔ̄ pī uwɔ. N géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ klla géē kpó ayááyí gā uwɔ, ohígbū okónu nɛ̄ n ce lɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Ébrahām, ā.

eng_Latn: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
idu_Latn: É tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā géē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɔcɛ́ Udéfīdi, ipú Ubɛ́tulɛhēm, igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɛga nēé ma Udéfīdi ā.

eng_Latn: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
idu_Latn: E cíkā ō lɛ ojáma yá uwā, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é má ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ɛgiyí uwā gɛ ŋ́, é kē lɔfú yúklɔ́ ipú icɔ́ɔci glá.

eng_Latn: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nēé tá tū ɔkpá ā á: Ɔkpá nyā gé lɛ Átasásɛsi, Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, ŋmá ɛgiyí ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nēe wɛ ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfarétīisi.

eng_Latn: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo hile ā géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ébú nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ klá aéwo alɛwa, ó í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ ō mí klá ɛyí ācí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ā. É géē gboló ce Ɔwɔicō, é kē gáā yājɛ lɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlamu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā da ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, Ussɛmáya kóō.

eng_Latn: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú uwɔ má um ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ma um á, a lɛ odúúdú ɛ̄cī kú oyēeyī kú um ā tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú uwɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ma um á.

eng_Latn: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka n yēeyī gɔbū kpɔ́, nɛ̄ n lɔfú yúklɔ́ tū ɔ̄ nōo géē tīile glá. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ nyā, ń jé kpɔ́cíí ŋ́, ka n̄ kwú oyēeyī gɔbū ú nɛɛ kɛ̄ɛ ká n̄ kwú íkwū ú.

eng_Latn: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá. É kē wɛ, Uhassúba, Óhelu, Uberekíya, Uhasadíya mɛ́mla Ujússābu Uhɛ́sɛdi.

eng_Latn: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ géē tá ajɛ eko nēé lɛ igelī ā gwó ā, ga ɛháajɛ kú ajɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Īkpō kú nū wɛ ukilómīta ɛhɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔwá kú nū wɛ ukilómīta ɛpa ce āyā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Ó kē lɛ ā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dúú. Ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ ē lā igelī ā á.

eng_Latn: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
idu_Latn: N géē gwíijē í cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō. N géē ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lɛ ā, abɔ̄ n gē tá ɔ̄ ahínyá ā.

eng_Latn: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
idu_Latn: Lɛ ayí kú Ukɔ́hāti ā gbaáluka. Gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla inu kú ádā uwā.

eng_Latn: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
idu_Latn: É klla le ɔgbanjɛ igwó kú oje udɔ yá, ɛhɔ̄ kú nū gē bá ɛháajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɛhɔ̄ ɔhá klla í bá ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É gē bī ɔgbánjɛ nyā le na iwili kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya nēé je gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā. Éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ipú utánki nɛ̄hi ā nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya gē bī le na odée á.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki da Ébrahām ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔdí nɛ̄ a yá lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
idu_Latn: Ódūdū gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɛnwū kú nū, bɛ̄ɛka ódūdū nōo ī tá ŋmá ɛ̄hī nēé lɛ odée ce ɔlá anú, le hɔ́lá yɔ̄ ī wú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó mā Ísɔ yɔ̄ ī wā mɛ́mla ācɛ úlā nēe bá mla anú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū kɔ̄ lɛ Urécɛ̄lu, Ulɛ́ya mɛ́mla anyā ōcɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛpa le gla ŋmá ícɛ, ucɛ kú onyatá ā géē wā, é kē í je Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ tū aólɛlā kú nū abɔ̄ kéē lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ́kpá.

eng_Latn: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
idu_Latn: Á je íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n yá ā yá um ɛhi glá ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ohígbū ka n géē kwú, é kē í je um nyi ānāānā. A géē tíne um, amáŋ ń kē gáā yēeyī ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā kú Ujúdasi ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usáyímɔ̄n Iskárīyɔ̄tu, éyi kú ipú ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā, nōo géē je ɔ́ lá.

eng_Latn: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ uwá mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ uwá gbɔɔ́ ō nū ɔ̄ inya gaá lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tū okónu ókpoó nɛ̄hi nōo kwu Ugíbēyɔn ā.

eng_Latn: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka anúɔ lɛ ɛ̄ba éyi lígíi nɛ̄ anúɔ í ba ŋmá abɔ̄ nū. Ó da ka ɔ̄ híī nyá anúɔ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ ba ɛ̄ba kú nū ā, ka anúɔ í kē gáā nyá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
idu_Latn: Ocíbú ugóolu éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu igwó, nōo le mu mla ɔtulalī ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔbá nū da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí yá nāa géē nyɔ̄ ícɛ ā, ícɛ í wɛ Usábāti, ámāŋ ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔbá nū ohi kahíníī, Ā lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwá le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá, ɛwa kú uwā wɛ ɛnɛ̄nɛ̄ɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ kú ipú ísu ā. É klla bī ɔnya o kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú wā dúú.

eng_Latn: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi tū gé lɛ alɔ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔ̄ccɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū Udɛ́fīdi, kóō lɛ alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú nū éyi le ŋmó. Ācɛ ōhī bá abɔ́ɔ nēe dɔɔ̄kā ō kpɛ́lā ce Ujísɔ̄si koó yɔ ī yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Íne kú Umósīsi cɛ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá tá ŋmá ōcē ɛ̄cī Usábāti.

eng_Latn: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
idu_Latn: Ándru, Ufílīpu, Ubatolómiyu, Umátiyu, Utɔ́mɔ̄si, Ujémīsi ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Álfīyɔsi, mla Utádiyɔ̄si Usáyímɔ̄n ɔ̄cɛ Ukénan.

eng_Latn: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū eko nēé géē wā í je uwɔ agōdō kpó, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ á cíla ulé ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja nēe gē gbō agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ohile nēe bá amānyā ā, le jé kéē tū um agbá ohígbū ka n cɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā, a géē hī um igwú, n kē í tá uwɔ ohi. A géē yɔ̄ í tíne um, ami nɛ̄ a bī abɔ̄ kú uwɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ gā okónu ísu ɛbɔ́ ā, alɔ le jé igbīhāajɛ ka iyē ɔlíidɔ ā lé ka Umálta.

eng_Latn: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka nyā wɛ ɔkwɛyi nɛ̄ n, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá cíkā ō miyɛ ɛlā ā cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
idu_Latn: Kwú ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā í yá alɔ ɛhi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ ī je yá ācɛ nēe yá alɔ ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā ɛhi ā.

eng_Latn: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
idu_Latn: N klla le da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔkpá je gā um kú n̄ le bī gé lɛ Ásāfu, nōo gē leyīkwu ɔcí kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ ɔcí je gā um kú n̄ géē bī le yá ɔcí ō cíla aɔ́wɛ icō kú inu kú ācɛ o gbāajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ɔcí kú igá kú igelī ā, mɛ́mla ákú inu nɛ̄ n gáā lā anú ā. Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ um ba ŋmá abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, ó kwú kpó gā um kpɛ́mm, ohígbū ka Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla um.

eng_Latn: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
idu_Latn: É gē jé ɛ́nɛ́ ɔcí dóódu ŋmá lɛ ikpó nōo gē gwá ā. É gē wū ikpō ɔkpɔ́ɔma ŋmá okwɔnyɛbɔ́tū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kē ī wū alemú ŋmá okwífú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?
idu_Latn: É klla ka amáŋ Ábsālɔm nɛ̄ aá lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ́ ɛyí ka ɔ́ɔ̄ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aá ā ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu o bī Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, wā ɔlɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ami tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo í wā gáā kpɛ́fú tú uwɔ ā ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kē wā í nuunu tá uwɔ géē cɔ̄nyā gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
idu_Latn: Ami Upɔ́lu, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō fu ká n̄ wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, ó kē tū um ɛhɔ̄ gɛcɛ ká n̄ tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi lɛ ācɛ.

eng_Latn: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.
idu_Latn: Aéwo nēe kwu aá ajaajɛ mɛ́mla aéwo nēe bá ligbó lɛ aá ā, géē kpó ɛnwū tū aá, ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá géē lā ipú ákanya mɛ́mla ígbájí lɛ aā.

eng_Latn: And the Lord GOD of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka, eko nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kwú abɔ̄ ú kwu ipú ɛcɛ kpátáá ā, ó kwú ja tāajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ nēe lā ipú nū ā bá í yá ɔtūnōbí. Odúúdú ɛcɛ le hɛ́ gicō lógólógó klla hɛ́ wāajɛ wuuu bɛ́ɛka úgbágwú kú ísu nēé hī ka Unáyilu ā.

eng_Latn: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
idu_Latn: Aá húmáyī lā ipú abahi gɔdɔgbɔɔ í lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdā dúúmā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í kwú aá iyē ŋ́. Amáŋ ufi kóō gbɔɔ́ ō yá aá, ka aá gbɔɔ́ ō fīyɛ̄gbúlú. Aá lɛ īlī kú aá kpó plla ŋmá iyē cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wiyē.

eng_Latn: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ubáalu kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔwɔ kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ kē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú anúɔ. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ í cīgwú mla ɔlá, nōo klla í wā í je ɛbɛ́ nyā kpó yɔlá ā, anú í wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi á. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā ka ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka ā lɔhi íbí.

eng_Latn: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ ɛpa bá abɔ̄ nēé hī uwā ka Usánbālati nōo ŋmá igelī kú Ubɛti Uhórɔn ā mɛ́mla Utobíya éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kú ajɛ kú Ámɔn á. Anɔ́ɔ é le pó ka, ɔ̄cɛ éyi ɔ́ɔ gā gáā yúklɔ́ ohígbū olɔhi kú ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām klla kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ofɛpa nɛ̄ ā má abɔ́ɔ ā bɛ́ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N gaá je ɔ́ yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
idu_Latn: Ujówābu, ɔyí kú Userūyah ā wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóssāfāti, ɔyí kú Ahilúdu wɛ ɔmálɛ o tɔ́kpá kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā ŋmó aágábá mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí dúú ɛɛ́, ó ka anúɔ kē í yá ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā tá opɛ̄ɛcí kú Ufilístiya nōo cá aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo yēeyī ā ɛcá ā.

eng_Latn: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ̄kā kú nū ŋmɛ́yí mɛ́mla ɔ̄kā á. Ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyá kú ācɛ ɛtá nēe bá nyā yá ucē kú ɔ́mpa ɔ̄cɛ tū ɔ̄cɛ nēé hɛ́ ɔ̄ éjulúgwu āa.

eng_Latn: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
idu_Latn: Āpū kú ipú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákánjɔ̄ ā, é gē yila ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnū ā.

eng_Latn: All these were joined together in the vale_of_Siddim, which is the salt_sea.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā pīya tɔ̄há ipú ɔpɛ̄ kú Usídim .

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā tá ami, nōo gbonɛnɛ bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ kú Ussílōwa nōó gē pɛ́ ɛmɛɛma ā, nēé bá ī gwéeyē ohígbū Urésin mɛ́mla Upéka, ɔyí kú Urémalíya ā, kéē tá uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
idu_Latn: Ká éŋkpɔ̄ ohɔ́ɔnɔ nyā kóō tá ipú kú uwɔ, kóō lɛ uwɔ ipú nū cɔtū, kóō yá kú agada kú uwɔ kóō kwú wu tū. Ɔcɛnyā ā í tóohi ka ó lɛ yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
idu_Latn: Ɔnū kú uwɔ lɛyíkwu um, mɛ́mla ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ kú uwɔ lɛyíkwu um ā gaajɛ um ɛɛ́. N géē je agá bū uwɔ ɛnwū, cɛ́ɛ́ n klla kwu anjámī ú wu uwɔ okónu, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú uwɔ ú cīgbīhi bū ɔwɛ pií nāa yɛ wā ā.

eng_Latn: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu kɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, odúúdú eko nɛ̄ ó yēeyī gaá kwu ā.

eng_Latn: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛga nēé gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā lɛ igbó nɛɛ, eko dúú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ he uwá ɔtū ā, ɛ́ɛ lɛ álá ámāŋ ka ɛna nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kpó lɛ uwá ā ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ lé, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ da uwá ā.

eng_Latn: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;
idu_Latn: É klla ka ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá gwó ede ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá bɛ́yíkwu Óndú ā nɛɛ, ámāŋ ka o lɛ ɛka kú aá mla anú bīya nɛɛ, ó lɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū kóō lɛ aá kpó kwú gé lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ aá kpó ŋmó abɔ̄yī uwā ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā. É ka aá ɔ́ bī ɔ̄ ɔtū ka aá gáā gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede ā, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gwó ɔ̄ɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ō kahíníī, Mā um tá, ká n nyɔ̄, eyī gē nyā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu da ɔ́ kahíníī, N gaá cɛ̄ gā uwɔ nyɔ̄ ŋ́, ń táafu ŋ́, a lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce um.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
idu_Latn: A í cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ójīla kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ abɔ̄ kpó ce ayí kú Ulífāyi ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ aóndú nū le má ka ile nēé lɔtūce ā le yɛ ā, é lɛ Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Usáyílāsi kwú, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá pī ga ōlihī iyɔ̄bū ācogbāājɛ.

eng_Latn: Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king's palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.
idu_Latn: Ayípōklóbīya ā cíkā ō jōklóbīya, í gáā lɛ ɔ́nyí dúúmā iyē ŋ́. É cíkā ō jɔ́ɔ́dā nɛ̄hi, í wɛ ācɛ o lɛ ucē olɔhi, é klla cíkā ō wɛ ācɛ o jɔ́ɔ́dā fíyaa. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le cíkā ō wā í yúklɔ́ ipɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́. Asspɛ́nāsi wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gáā nwū uwā ucē mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé tá okónu ucē kú ācɛ Ubábīlɔn á.

eng_Latn: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nāa tá kóō tá alɔ abɔ̄ ā? Kwú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ú kpó ŋmá igbīhi cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ aólɛlā kú alɔ kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
idu_Latn: Aá tɔ́ɔna kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɔfú lɛ ā, lɛ odúúdú aéwo. Aá kē bī úklɔ́ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó yá ā le tɔ́ɔna lɛ odúúdú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: O LORD, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā ŋ́. Alɔ jé ka awɔ ōfōofū uwɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔ́mɛhīlī nɛ̄ ūlī kú Ujóssuwa kwú nēé je ajɛ lɛ uwá ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔcí ufígi ā ka, Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā lé īkpō kú uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
idu_Latn: Ucē kú uwā ī mafú ka ɔdā nɛ̄ íne ā dɔ̄ɔ̄kā le tá tū ipú ɔtū kú uwā. Ohígbū ka ɔtū kú uwā kē ī ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí eko ōhī, ó kē ī cɛ̄pɔ̄ uwā eko ōhī dúú.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, īlī ohíinu igbó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kwú yílɛɛpa ŋmícō wāajɛ. Ajɛ le jíliyē, aɛ́cɔ̄ kē le yíla.

eng_Latn: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aá le tá ipú inu dóódu nɛɛ, ɔdā aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ aá í ka ā wɛ, Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla ɔlɛ́ nyā.

eng_Latn: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē cīgbīhi ga ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Ka ācɛ Asírīya géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā piíí, ohígbū ka é tá kéē cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí anúɔ.

eng_Latn: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
idu_Latn: N géē cābɔ̄ lɛ aá ka, ami, ɔyínɔ̄nyīl kú Ɔ̄cɛ lɛ íkwu ipú ɛcɛ ká n̄ je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā yá uwa ɛhi. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka lɛ ɔ̄cɛ o ŋmííyē ā ka.

eng_Latn: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā ŋ́ mā, bī ɔdā nēé wu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́cɛ wā gaá nuunu tá um, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācobɔ̄bíipú ī nū um inya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:
idu_Latn: N klla má eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú ka, ācɛ Ujíyu alɛwa lɛ anyā lɛ ŋmá Ássidɔ̄du, Ámmɔn, mɛ́mla Umówābu.

eng_Latn: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníi, N le tútū ō tá ācɛ nēé dɔɔ̄kā um ŋ́ mā ohi ɛɛ́. N kē le tútū ō ma iyī um fú lɛ ācɛ nēé tíne um ŋ́ mā. Éwo nōó hī um igwú ŋ́ mā, n cɛ̄ uwā igwú kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á. Ami yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ dúúmā í gáā mīyɛ ajɛ ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́. Ajɛ nɛ̄ ó géē je lɛ ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ā gēe ŋmá ipú ukpɛ kú ajɛ kú nū nēé miya lɛ ɔ́ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká o híī pīya ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tū oŋmá lɛ omīyɛ uwā ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá í bī le jé ɔ́dāŋ́ keé lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi á. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo ī ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́ɔ wā bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā lɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le uwá tū ga ɔgbɛ́fú, mɛ́mla Ufínɛ̄has, ɔyí kú Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, nōo gē leyīkwu aɔ́da otīīhɔ mɛ́mla opo ō tá kú eko ɛfú ō kpó ā.

eng_Latn: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nɛ̄ n kwú ɛlā ú ka ɛɛ́, é klla lɛ ɛlā ɔhá ō ka kwu ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɛlā kú um gē pɛ́ tū uwá iyē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ɔwɔ gē ga ajɛ nōo le ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
idu_Latn: Aá ogwuda, aá kllɔcɛ́ kú aá jɔ́dā. Aólíla, aá jāhɔ̄ kú aá jíjééyī.

eng_Latn: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka īnyīlɛyí kú ɔ̄cɛ le gbɛ́ ŋmá údɔ̄bū kú nū ámāŋ ka igbīhi ɛyí kú nū, ɛyí ō fakpá kú údɔ̄bū nōó lɛ á, amáŋ ó le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ɔ̄cɛ o lohílīpú lɔhi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ ugóolu ámāŋ́ ka ɛdɔ aɛ́cɔ̄ ō gbɔlá á.

eng_Latn: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔdā obɔ̄bí yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá ibīyājɛ tū ɔ̄cɛ nōó yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛlā ɔ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa kú uwā lā aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe kwu ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā ajaajɛ ā. Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā lā Ukɛriyáti Aába, Udíbɔn, mɛ́mla Ujékābisiil, mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe kwu igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā a.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ nááná nōó gē da Ujósɛ̄fu ɛlā ɛcī ga ɛcī, ó cɔ̄kɔkpɛkɛ lɛ ɔ́ nyɔ̄ í gwutá mla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
idu_Latn: A gē kpó ɔ́lá lá lɛ ācɛ kú Udɛ́dan mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā ajɛ alɛwa kú okónu ísu ā. É kē ī kpó ayīnu adāgbá mɛ́mla ɔká le cíla awɔ ulé kú iyó kú uwɔ nāa ī kpó lá lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ aá le pīya ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō le okónu kwu aá iyē kú ucē bɛ̄ɛka ikpɔ́nyā ō ce, unwū ɔnyā ó yá bɛ̄ɛka opī ā, ámāŋ ka o gbɛlá olɔhi kú iyī ɔ̄cɛ ofūnū ā. ­Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í cíkā ō má ɔdā ō labɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ kɛlā kú ucē ɛ́gɛ́nyā lɛyíkwu aá fúlufúlu ŋ́, abɔ̄ aá le pīya ayí ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yīnū í yá ācɛ ubatísim ŋ́ mā, amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū gē yá á.

eng_Latn: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú kwú odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú oje udɔ ā ú kpó ca, ó klla le igbóje nēé le cíla odūngwɔ̄wɛ ā kpó hɛ́ bónū.

eng_Latn: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n klla bī úklábɔ̄fú ā le Ubáalāti, Utáma, ipú ígbíli kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti í wɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, ācɛ ɔlamu nēé wɛ á. Aɔ́nya obī kpɛ́fú kú uwá kē wɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔlamu, é kē wɛ aálelékwū ŋ́ má. Eko nɛ̄ Óndú géē yá odée kóō ma ɔfú kú nū fú ā, éwo olɔfú nōo ī tá éwo ɔhá abɔ̄ ā géē wúlatāajɛ, éwo nōó lɔfú ŋ́ nēé gē tábɔ̄ ā kē ī je catāajɛ dúú. Uwá ɛplɛ́ɛ́pa géē je yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi wɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā á. Anyākwɔ́cɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ɛtá ā, bá mla Usɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ujísɔ̄si jé ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē yá ibīyājɛ tū ɔ̄ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kahíníī, Ó wɛ odúúdú aá le yēŋēē ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
idu_Latn: Umáyɔn, Ukaamɛ́lu, Usífi, Ujúta.

eng_Latn: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú ka ka ɔtū kú anúɔ le yēŋēē, Odo kú anúɔ í kē bīyíne dúúmā ŋ́ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Á gáā lɔfú nuunu mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka a wɛ ɔyípɛ̄, amáŋ anú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú ɛfú ŋmá ɔyípɛ̄ kú nū jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā gā um igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
idu_Latn: Agblīihɔ nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā le nwūla tɔ́ɔtɛ́, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ Ikpati Ɛka kú nu má abɔ́ɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔwɔ gbɔɔ́ ō límanya máa máa, uya nɛ̄hi yá, akpáabana kē yɔ̄ ī gbo klá gbo gblágádáá. Ajɛ yɔ̄ ī jíliyē nɛ̄hi, ɔwɔ owɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi kē yɔ̄ ī yā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, Olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā kahíníī, Aá mɛ́mla anyā aá le okónu ce ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá, klla í lɛ ejé fu ajɛ lɛ ɛcí nɔ̄nyā nēé hī ka Ɔcányā kú ɔkpáncō ā, aá kē le yá lɛ ā ŋmá lɛ ucē kú aá ɛɛ́. Ó lɔhi! Aá nyɔ̄ gáā yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a cokónu nū lɛ ɔ́ ā mɛ́ɛnɛ. Aá nyɔ̄ í yá oji nɛ̄ aá hɛ́ ā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi wɛ iháyí ofuciigwó ɛ́ɛ́ nōo gbɔɔ́ ō gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúdú á. Ó kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwá iháyí ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ācɛ nēe gē gwéeyē ohígbū unwalu kú um ā ɔtū gbájí. Uwēyī kóō le pīya klá ācɛ nēe gē gbɛlá ka aá lɔhi fíyɛ́ um ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īlī ī klá ɔ̄cɛ iyē ā.

eng_Latn: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
