idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā, gē yúufi Óndú ā, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ipú oyēeyī kú nū ŋ́ mā, í yúufi kú Óndú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, N da ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ nēe bá nyā kwú okónu ú klá, aɛ́cɔ̄ abɔ̄yī uwā géē tɔ́ɔga.

eng_Latn: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
idu_Latn: ó le mu pitīī mla ɔbɔ́ɔcɛ, ó kē jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, o yá unwɔ̄dā ɛdɔ obɔ̄bí, ó yɔ̄ gē táafu mla ācɛ ɔhá mɛ́mla o yɔ̄ ge gbaapɔ̄ ohígbū ɛyí kú ɛlā oōjé, ɛnya ge yá kóō má ācɛ ɔhá ímálānyī kéē cá iyī uwā ɛcá, kéē ka obɔ̄bí kú iyi uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē yíkpɛ́lā tá ɔ́mpa uwā, mɛ́mla eyī ō kpóce ɔ́mpa uwā ɛdɔ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛdɔ kú ɛka nɛ̄ n géē gbo mla Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ̄cɔ̄bū, Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ka, n géē kpó íne kú um tū ipú ɔtū kú uwā, klla géē lɛ íne ā tá bá ɔtū kú uwā. N géē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, é géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Áyísīki le obugā bū ɔpɛ̄ ā anɔ́ɔ é le éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi má ipú nū á.

eng_Latn: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ obū ā í kē dobū tū uwɔ ŋ́. Otú ā kē tá péee bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ā tū uwɔ, ohígbū ka obū mɛ́mla ofíyajɛ wɛ ɔdā ékpónú tū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé mīyɛ ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō kiŋini lɛyíkwu ádɔ̄lɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees , came upon them,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni yɔ̄ gē kɛlā lɛ ācɛ ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya mla ācogbāajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla ācɛ Usádusīi ā, le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí uwā.

eng_Latn: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛlam ɔhá ā wɛ, úlā ɛtá ce ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ .

eng_Latn: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ klla gaá lā Alússi.

eng_Latn: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
idu_Latn: Ubálāki le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ubálam ka lɛ ā. Ubálam kwú ɛna éyi, mɛ́mla omlede éyi ú gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede ā éyééye.

eng_Latn: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, mɛ́mla ɛlā nɛ̄ ádā uwā ka lɛ uwá, mɛ́mla ɔhā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ ā bá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kahíníī, N géē túblá anú kú n lɛ ɛbɛ ohéyī nyā má lɔɔlɔhi. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ácí ā í je yɔlá ŋmá ajɛ ŋ́ mā a.

eng_Latn: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ nēe bá ipú kú nū ā bá ī nya mɛ́mla īyī uwā ipú kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ī yá um āa? Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí Óndú ā gaá le ɔ̄kā da.

eng_Latn: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lā ajɛ kú Ufilístiya abɔ́ɔ, ɔyā igwɛ́ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ayípōklóbīya kú alɔ kwú kéē gbā igbāmkpa mɛ́mla igwu lɛ uwá abɔ̄fú bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́fiyɛ ā. Ɛdrɔ́ kú alɔ bá ī túgagá ohígbū ɛfú ogbɛnú nēé gē gbō ce uwá ɛyí abɔ̄fú āa.

eng_Latn: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ kwú ɔlɛ́ nū nōo yɔ̄ ipú igelī nēé le igá cē tū ɔ̄ ā ú lá. Ó lɛ íkwu ō lá ɔdā iyī nū cīgbīhi ɛplá iháyí odunkwulu ŋmá ɛ̄cī nēé lá ajɛ ā glá.

eng_Latn: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú tá ucē kú uwā ā. Amáŋ é gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē yá okónu nɛ̄ ó cē ā piíí, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔnɔ tū ɔ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɛwa ā kéē yāajɛ ɛyí ácí, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú igbō ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛbéenyi ɛpa ā ú á, Ó je eyī gicō, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ klla lɛ ɔ́ cē á. Ó kwú kpó lɛ ayíkpó kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó ā kē kwú kpó lɛ ācɛ ā kéē lé á.

eng_Latn: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ihɔtū nāa lɛ gā um eko dóódu ā, le oyéeyī kú um tū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē lɛ íne nāa je gā um ā tū.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ klla tū uwā ukɔ́ kpɔ́ kéē híī cɛ̄ɛla kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ipú ɛpɔ̄ nēé géē hɛ́ ā ŋ́. Kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄hī jōōnjīlɛ̄. Ó ka anúɔ da uwá kéē híī yúúfi eyī kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā eko nēé ī hɛ́pɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛpɔ̄ ō hɛ́ wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō nɛ. Ɛpɔ̄ dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le lɔnɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛhi, kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā bī gé lɛ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka anúɔ jāhɔ̄ tá ɛpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.
idu_Latn: Uféro gaā le Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, N le íne kú Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá bīya, n klla le ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá aá.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ aá lɛ ɔtū kú aá túkwu ō ka olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ, amáŋ aá híīī gwū ucē ɔhá ō ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
idu_Latn: Upíta kahíníī, Óndú, a yɔ̄ ī kwu ita nyā lɛ alɔ ofōōfū alɔ nɛɛ, kɛ̄ɛ ka a kwu ɔ́ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ.

eng_Latn: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔyí ā kē gekwú ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ ā ɔdíyá nɛ̄ anúɔ cíkā ō gwōkónu kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā? Ka anúɔ í lɔfú je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū glá gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ gáā ga ɛgiyí nū ɛ̄cī éyi mɛ́ɛ̄ á, amáŋ ɔyí ā ɔ́ɔ́ gáā kwúcē wā ɛgiyí anúɔ gbógbóō glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
idu_Latn: É klla gbā Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádáádā uwā, ɛ̄gbā gɛ ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō kē kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti á. É gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā. Aɔ́wɔ kú ācɛ nēé lā mla uwá ā. É gē túkpɛɛ́ lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī cɛ̄ lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya plla aá, ɛ́ɛ́ nóō gē kpó aá nyíleyī lɛ ā ŋ́. Aá kpɔ́tūce ɛlā kú nū ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔwɔ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú éwo ámāŋ ɛyí ajɛ dúúmā nōo nya ācɛ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú alɔ jējēe ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú aá gē nya aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú alɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́cī nū ā, aígabɔ̄ kú uwā ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne ā gaá le jīla bá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ kú uwā kóō kwú pīya ɛtrɔ-ɛtrɔ mɛ́mla obū, eko nɛ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā í yɔ̄ ī nū uwā inya ā.

eng_Latn: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā ōfōōfū uwā nɛ̄ n ka keé tīile gā um gɛ ŋ́ mā ŋ́, amáŋ n je odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ yá ā bɛ̄ɛka ífi ā dúúdú ohígbū Óndú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si nɛ̄ n jé ā. Ɔ́ɔmā tīile ga um fíyɛ́ á. Ohígbū nū ā n lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē yá gbɔbū ā kpó bónū, n je uwá bɛ̄ɛka īmū icííci ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ile ka n wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā lɛ.

eng_Latn: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
idu_Latn: Anú ā wɛ ɛ́gbla kú Ɔwɔicō á, ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wɛ ā nōó wɛ á, ó bī ɛlā olɔfú kú nū le yá ká aɔ́dā nēe yɔ̄ ā kéē yɔ̄ ī yɔ̄ kpɔ́. Igbīyāajɛ nɛ̄ ó le yá kú Ɔwɔicō kóō kwú íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā í yá alɔ ɛhi ā, ó gaá cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
idu_Latn: Aá gwíijē, kú aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nōo lā Usáyɔn ā. Aá ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ uwá mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā lɛ cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ bī odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ gē je lɛ uwá ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
idu_Latn: N tá Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si Óndú alɔ ahínyá, anú nōo je ɔfú gā um kú um yúklɔ́ kú um ā. N tá ɔ̄ ahínyá ohígbū ka ó lɛ um fu ka n cíkā ō cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɛ́yá kú aá tá ga abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɔ́kɔ ā, aá géē má ɛbéenyi í kwú. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛ́yá ā tá, amáŋ é lɔfú pi ɔ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ glá ŋ́ ohígbū ɛbéenyi alɛwa nēe bá ipú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔ́mā, anú mla ayíkpó kú nū le pɛ́ tá ipú ɔ́kɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ i yɛ tá ajɛ kú Udalimanúta.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ipú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, anúɔ géē je ɔ́da lɛ ɔkpáncō kóō lɛ ɔwɔ yā wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔyī kú nū tá, le aólɛlā kú nū pahīla. Ó bī ɔwɔ olímanya kú nū, le aólɛlā fíyákátā bá ī kwinya gicō gajɛ.

eng_Latn: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī uwā le nwū ayááyí kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé jɛ̄ ɛfú ō kpó ŋ́ mā ɔwɛ nēé gē kpɛ́fú lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: So Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubenhádādi cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nɛ̄ Ása, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ka ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó gaá le ɛfú kpó tá aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu á. É lɛ Íjɔn, Udáni, Ébɛ̄lu Ubɛ̄timáka, mɛ́mla āyā kú ísu kú Ugálīli ā yálé klla mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Unáfutāli ā.

eng_Latn: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
idu_Latn: N habɔ̄ aá tá ipú ɛbɔ́, ɛbɔ́ kú um nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá á. Ó wɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛcɛ gē je ā nɛ̄ n gē je lɛ aá ā ŋ́. Ɔtū kú aá kóō lɛ unwalu ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kē ī yúufi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.
idu_Latn: É gáā yúklɔ́ áncā ŋ́. É kē gáā ma ayí nēe í lɛyí olɔnɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka uwá géē wɛ ayí nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā le ɔdā olɔhi yá lɛ uwá mɛ́mla ayí uwā.

eng_Latn: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú abɔ̄ í bī um igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ n kwú lɔfú iyē fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
idu_Latn: Ujehóyāda yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó kwú ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ómbilí ɛpa kú aíkpō Ufíigi nēe hayi iyɔ̄bū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā mafú ga um. Ɔdā nyā yá igbīhi nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Ubábīlɔn kwú ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyākim, Ujɛhóyācin, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda alagbá ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga Ubábīlɔn ā. Ó le aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācoyúklábɔ̄ kú Ujúda kpó ɔfiyɛ nyɔ̄ Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
idu_Latn: N da aá ɛlā ɔhá kpɔ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ɛpa kú aá nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ amānyā cɛ̄ tɔ̄há lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ odée yá lɛ aá, Ádā um nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā géē yá ɔ̄ lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛgbá ka Ɔwɔicō kóō hī ɔ̄cɛ igwú wā ɛga okɛpɔ̄ kú nū kóō kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu lɛ ɛgwā ā gwō jigijigi tū ipú ɔlá, ó kē yá ɔ̄ ágbe dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔnyā nū ɔtū túlé á. Ó le gwutá mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū, anɔ́ɔ ó klla le ipú yɔ̄ igbɔhá le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ma á. Udéfīdi kwú iyē í ce ɔ́ ka Usólómɔ̄n. Ɔyí ā he Óndú ā ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, kwu aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā, kwu ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ,mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé lā Ujerúsālɛm ā, húmáyī yá um ɛlā ícɔ́nū ohígbū odúúdú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé húmáyī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā da Umósīsi ka.

eng_Latn: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umídiya le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu túwājɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo yá kéē ka ɔdā dúúma glá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le ikwū je klá Óndú ā kóō tá uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄ncɛnyā ā wɛ Ukɔ́sibi, ɔyí kú Úsɔ nɛ̄ ádā nū wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ígwu éyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú ācɛ Umídīyan ā.

eng_Latn: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā Ujósɛ̄fu, ɔ̄cɛ Arimatéyi, ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ɔyíkpo kú Ujísɔ̄si tayínū ohígbū kóō gē yúufi ācɛ Ujíyu ā, ba Upáyílēti kóō kwú okwū kú Ujísɔ̄si ú lɛ anúɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti cɛ̄ á. Ujósɛ̄fu wā gaá kwú okwū kú nū ú.

eng_Latn: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, Ehéee, amáŋ ami wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Óndú ā, n kē gā amanyā ɛɛ́ Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ eyī pīya klla ajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbō ɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ̄. Ɔdī nɛ̄ Óndú um tíne ká n̄ yá ā.

eng_Latn: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.
idu_Latn: Aúnóji kú uwá ā bá ɛga nōo lipú fíyɛ́ dúú kú ɔlékwū ā á. Ɛfú lé odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Únóji kú uwá yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá. Amáŋ, é tɛtɛ gē tū ācɛ nōo yēeyī ɛcɛ ā ufi.

eng_Latn: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n lɔfú mlɛ́nyɔ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ɔdā olɔhi yá gā um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄nyā ā gāá jīla anú ɔwɛ. Ɔnyā ā le ifa kú akwuna yá. Ɔdā ékpónú kē kwu ɔ́ ɔtū ō yá á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Aá gbaáluka iháyí ahāapa ɛga ahāapa, odúúdú nū í wɛ iháyí ofɛpa cahāanɛ.

eng_Latn: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ ā le iyī uwā tútū kéē kpɛ́fú ɛɛ́. É yɔ̄ ī yá ujuju kéē bɛ́yíkwu Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ó fu ā. Anɔ́ɔ é gē ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔnyā ā kóō yɔ̄ cíí ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka owu ō kwú tū ipú abɔ̄, ámāŋ ka o hɛ́ anɔ̄ tū ipú abɔ̄ omōmu ā.

eng_Latn: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka lɛyíkwu o kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō nōo ŋmá lɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ā á, Á híī da iyī uwɔ ɔ̄kā ka, Ɔ̄nyɛ géē ga ɔkpáncō ā? .

eng_Latn: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
idu_Latn: Ɔfú kú uwɔ nāa bī le je aɛ́fu kwu ɛga nēé kwu ā á. Ɛ̄nyā klla ī mafū ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
idu_Latn: Ā híī ka ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ā lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ō yá mla ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛlā ō plla ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's razor, and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kwu ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ō lulé éyi ú ka á lɛ īnyīlɛ̄yí kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔnwāgba kú uwɔ plá. Kwú īnyīlɛ̄yí mɛ́mla ɔnwū ɔ́ɔma í ce ɔdā ole mīya ɔdā ká a lɛ ɔ́ miya, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔ́ kɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
idu_Latn: Unehemíya kahíníī, Usánbālati, Utobíya mɛ́mla Ugéshem mɛ́mla aólɛlā kú alɔ o hile ā, le pó ka alɔ ɔ́ɔ le ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ma kwɛyí ā, nɛ̄ ɛpá dúúmā í klla tá ipú ɔdɔ ā gɛ ŋ́ mā. Nááná nɛ̄ alɔ í kpó ɔwɛ ā kwu ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ōcē obɔ̄bí wā í kpó uwā yíífi, amáŋ n géē je uwɔ pīya ádā kú éwo nēe lɛwa klla lɔfú fíyɛ́ ācɛ nēe bá nyā.

eng_Latn: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.
idu_Latn: É gaá le ka lɛ Usɔ́lu ka, Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ klá Ukéyīla. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛhɛ́ɛ, Ɔwɔicō le ɔ́ kwú gā um ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka ó kwú iyī nū ú tá ipú egbudu o ŋmá lɛ ō ga ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nōo lɛ odūngwɔ̄wɛ mla ogbló ō lɛ gwū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē kokónu áncā ka aá wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. É gē bī okónu kú uwā le gbā um ɛ̄gbā. Amáŋ ɔtū kú uwā tá ɛga ɔhá kpánáaa hɛ um tá. Ɛ̄gbā nēé gē gbā um tū īyī uwā ā wɛ íne nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ tū ā, nēé jé tɛ̄yí, bá ī ka tɛ́ɛcɛ icííci á.

eng_Latn: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
idu_Latn: Lɛ īyī uwɔ mafú lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem, Ubénjamīn, mɛ́mla Umanásɛ. Bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā ká ā wā í lɛ alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.
idu_Latn: Ása yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū bɛ̄ɛka ádáádā nū, Udéfīdi ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā le ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ yá nɛ̄hi, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce alɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā kóō yēeyī piyóó. Ācɛ kú Ussɛ́ba kéē kpó ugóolu gē lɛ ɔ́. Ācɛ kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū ɔcɛ́ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
idu_Latn: N má Ɔyí álá ā lɛ éyi kú ɔja ahāapa ā fō ŋmá épɔ̄kpá oōhā ā, anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ kú éyi kú aɔ́dā oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ akpáabana gē kɛlā ā á. Ó kahíníī, Gāa.

eng_Latn: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le īkpɛ̄yí ā bī gē lɛ Udéfīdi Uhɛ́brɔn kahíníī, Īkpɛ̄yí kú Íssbɔ̄ssɛti, ɔyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu nōo wɛ olɛlā kú uwɔ, nōo yá kóō ŋmó uwɔ ā, yɔ̄ á. Ágábáidu, ícɛ ā, Óndú ā le yá ká ā lɛ ɔ́ci gwō Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nú kú ɔlɛ́ nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ ɔdɔ nyā bu beé amānyā. N lɛ ɔdɔ ā bu beé abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ n gáā lɛ ɔwɛ éyi má á.

eng_Latn: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka eko nɛ̄ ádā nū le pó, nɛ̄ ó tá ká ɔ̄ híī cē oji nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ ā ŋ́, ó gáā lɛ ɔ́ tū ŋ́. Óndú ā í je yá ɔ̄ ɛhi, ohígbū ka ádā nū tá.

eng_Latn: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ācɛ ā kéē jāhɔ̄ lɛ aíne mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā nwū uwā ā. Ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē yéeyī klla í lā ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɔkwɛ̄yí, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kē ī kɛlā bū okónu kú uwā, uwá kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē híī kpó ohile kú iyó kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā, nēe bá Ujerúsālɛm ā, ga Ubábīlɔn gɛ ŋ́. É kē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kéē híī kpó aíyō kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda nōo hile Ujerúsālɛm ā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɔna tá ga ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ ā bá ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō bī ɔdā dúú wā ohígbū ō gwó kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā í bī ɛ̄gbā ɔhá wā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́há ā wɛ Ukírīyati Ubáalu mɛ́mla Urába, aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛpa mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ jīla anú tá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka gɔbū ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Agbénú kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla Itiyópīya géē je kpó pīya ákú uwɔ. Ācɛ Usɛ́ba nēe wɛ aágwu nɛ̄hi ā géē wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwɔ. A géē kpó agbá kwu uwá abɔ̄, nēé géē yɛ tá uwɔ igbīhi. É géē tūkpɛɛ́ ga uwɔ, klla í lɛ okónu ce ɔ̄ ga awɔ ka, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ pi awɔ̄. Ka anú ofōōfūnū ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā dɔɔ̄kā ō kɛlā mla Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ń tíne ō je ɛga dúúmā lɛ ɔ́ lígíi kóō je um yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mīyɛ odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā tābɔ̄. Ó le ācɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā kpó ŋmó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayí nū kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē yá aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā a? Ācɛ dóódu gē da um ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā tá lɛ ācɛ nēe gē lɛ íne kú Umósīsi ā tū ā, n gē yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka n gē lɛ íne ā tū dúú āa nááná nɛ̄ n lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne ā ŋ́ mā. N yá ɛ̄nyā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú n lɛ ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne ā bī gé lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ɔ̄ kóō kwú kwáahi klla í yá ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn lɔfú. Eko nɛ̄ n kwú ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú um ú wu ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn abɔ̄, nɛ̄ ó kwú ɔ́ɔ ú miya kwu Íjīpiti ā, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n da uwɔ lɛ ā ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā yá ā nōó mafú gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé gaá aáklɔ̄kpe kú ɛfú kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔfú kpó kwu uwā klla le uwá nū cīgbīhi. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le bá uwā ɔkwu yɔ̄ gē nū uwā inya nɛ̄hi klla bá gē ŋmó ācɛ Umówābu ā.

eng_Latn: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa da uwá keé wɛ Ijáalí kú iyī uwā á. Koó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ka uwá ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ ka Óndú nɛ̄ aá je kú aá gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā á. Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ ka aá wɛ ijáalí kú iyī aá á.

eng_Latn: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔnyā nōo yīipú ā gbɔɔ́ ō yɔ́ɔma ā géē yá kóō lɛ ɔyí ā ma piíí. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n géē yá ká ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kéē le pīya éwo á.

eng_Latn: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ nōo le yēŋēē ā géē lɛ ewo kú ɛna nɔ̄wá ā túbá ɛga oyēŋēē eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ipú ɔlɛ́ ā, lɛ ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu. É géē pīya ɔ̄ tū éŋkpɔ̄ kú oōyá yēŋēē kú uwā. É géē yá uculo nyā kéē kpó íne nēé bīya ā nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, le okónu tá le ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nōó cíkā ō yá kóō lɛ ɛka nyā tū ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
idu_Latn: É klla gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ ce ucē obɔ̄bí kú ɛcí ō pá kú aéwo, nɛ̄ Óndú ā nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ka ká aɔ́lá nēe bá ā kéē fíyajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā ipú ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó kē le yá lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ īkpēyī, nááná aá mɛ́ɛbɛ glá ŋ́ nɛɛ? Aá lɛ ahɔ̄ aá lɔfú pó ɔdā dúú ŋ́ nɛɛ. Aá blakwu ɔdā dúú glá ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ɛfú nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ gē hɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ī, lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā géē je bū ácí mɛ́mla ujē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kōō gáā ga abɔ́ɔ glá gɛ ŋ́. Ó géē je pīya ɛga nɛ̄ aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na géē bá ī lúúlé ipú nū.

eng_Latn: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
idu_Latn: Ahíssa gē leyīkwu ācoyúklɔ́ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ á. Adónīram, ɔyí kú Ábuda gē leyīkwu úklábɔ̄fú kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá tá íkwu nɛ̄ um lɛ lɛyíkwu aá ā gbojī ɛɛ́. Aá klla tá ō gbā um ɛ̄gbā. Aá bá ī pā aɛ́cí ɔkwu aɔ́cí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ nēe kwu ɛyí aɛ́fu ā bɛ̄ɛka akwuna nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ éyi gā ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a jé, a lɔfú gē da obū mɛ́mla ɔlá ofíyáajɛ, ɛga nɛ̄ uwá géē yɛ nyɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla ɛga nēé ī kwúcē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Aá wā ɛgiyí um, kú aā yēeyī.

eng_Latn: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, adá Uféro lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄, kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔyí nū.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔyí uwɔ Usólōmɔn géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um á. N kwú ɔ̄ ú kóō wɛ ɔyí um, n kē í wɛ ádā nū.

eng_Latn: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ le íne bīya ipú ɔdā dúúmā kú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā nōó le ɛpɔ̄bí lé, ɔdā dóódu nōó je uwī ā, ó géē cíla ulé nū. Ó kōō wɛ ɔdā dúú nōó je uwī ámāŋ ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ipú ɔ̄cɛ ohɛ́lé, ipú ɔ̄cɛ opīyatū ā, ámāŋ ɔdā nēé le tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ nōó mīyɛ tɔ̄ɔ̄kwu je ā, ámāŋ ɔdā nōo gebí nōó le ɔ́ pīyɛ.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó abɔ̄ ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa kú nū ce opī ā ɛyí, géē ka odúúdú aɔ́dōōbɔ̄bí, íne nēé bīya, mɛ́mla ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī ɔwɛ nyā kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dōōbɔ̄bí nōó ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ā í kpó ce opī ā ɛyí. Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú opī ā tū ɔ̄cɛ nēe fu ā abɔ̄ kóō kwú ga ipú ígbíli, kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú nū ɔ nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó klla í jila anú kpɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛga nɛ̄ odée ā yɔ̄ ā í je pīya abɔ̄ ɔhá ŋ́, nōó kē nyīla ŋ́ náaná ā, ó le tēelihɔ kpɔ́. É géē je odúúdú īlī ā yɔlá, ó kōō wɛ igbīhi ámāŋ ka iyɔ̄bū nɛ̄ odée ā yɔ̄ á nááná.

eng_Latn: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
idu_Latn: Ó kla túkpɛɛ́ lɛ ɔkpá tá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
idu_Latn: Ukpa lɛ ɔ́ ikpó kwú, klla bī ɔ̄ kli.

eng_Latn: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ŋgbá kú ikwū le um gbō dúúdú. Ífi le pɛ́ gla um ɛyí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ísu gē cēnyi ī pɛ́ gla ɔ̄cɛ ɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Umówābu le pó ka aɔ́cɛ́ ɛtá ɛ́ɛ í wā gaá kpɛ́fú tá aá ā, odúúdú uwā nēe kpɛ́fú gllá, kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ kwu ayípɛ̄ le pɛ́ gaá kwāajɛ ɔwɛ, ɛjī kú uwā mla Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usitífin tóohi kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ mɛ́mla aádā alɔ, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um. Ɔwɔicō kú ɛgahi le iyī nū mafú lɛ ádā alɔ Ébrahām eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Umɛsopotémīya gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nōó nyɔ̄ í lā ajɛ kú Uháran ā.

eng_Latn: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
idu_Latn: Ācokwɛ́bényi géē nā ɛ́yá kú uwá daa klá ɛcɛ abɔ́ɔ, ɛga nōo māháyi eyī ísu ā. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́. Aéwɔhá a géē je Itáya wúla tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí igwáahātá nɛ̄ Ujosíya lé ɔcɛ́ ā, eko nōo lɛ ajɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā yá tīihɔ yēŋēē ŋmá ɛcí nēé gē pā ipú nū ā, Ujosíya le Ussafán, ɔyí kú Asálīya, Umáaséya igbómína kú Ujerúsālɛm, mɛ́mla Ujówa, ɔyí kú Ujowáhāsi, éyi kú aígabɔ̄ ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā tú gílayá.

eng_Latn: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa māháyi abɔ́ɔ lɛ áhingílí wiyē.

eng_Latn: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the house tops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā í lɔfú dúúmā ŋ. É bá ī yúufi, klla jé ɔdā nēé lɔfú yá ā ŋ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí kú ipácí, ámāŋ ka ácí nōo jɛ̄ kwɛyí inu eko ɔnɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi í lɔtū nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gaá gwɛ́ɛya ɛ́ɛ nōo í nyɔ̄ i gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā abɔ́ɔ ŋ́, ohígbū koó yɔ̄ gē yúúfi ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo he Ɔwɔicɔ̄ ɔtū ā nɛ̄ ó gé je íjééyī mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé mɛ́mla éeyē lɛ ɔ́ á. Amáŋ, ācɛ o bīyííne ā, ó ge je úklɔ́ lɛ uwá kéē yá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó ije mɛ́mla agbénú tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú, Ɔwɔicɔ̄ kóō géē je kpó lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā. Odúúdú nū wɛ áncā klla wɛ owu oōnū inya nɛ.

eng_Latn: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ kú aá. N géē yá ká aá lɛ ajɛ ā hí klla lɛ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá nyi ipú ajɛ ā igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī gbō uwā, ó kē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā pīya uwá tū ŋ́, ó lɛ abɔ̄ pi aɔ́cɛ́ ā ahɔ̄ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā klla da ɔ́ ka Usádɔ̄ku mɛ́mla Abíyāta ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, ɛ́ɛ géē bá abɔ́ɔ dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ í pó ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā kpó ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nyā cābɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n géē je ɔbɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla ɔbɔ́cɛ nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā cē ɔkɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē bī ōcē obɔ̄bī wā í klá odúúdú aéwo nēe kpɛ́fú tá Ujerúsālɛm ā. Ɔkpíyē kú uwā í je wā eko nēé yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Īkpēyī mla ígblɛ́nyī kú uwā géē je wā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Uféro á. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū aábaná nɛ̄ ó tū klá Uféro, ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú Íjīpiti tá kpátáá abɔ́ɔ á. Lɛ ádā uwɔ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ kpó gaá lā ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúu kú ajɛ ā, nōo wɛ ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ ipú uwā nōo jé ō leyīkwu aɔ́dāajɛ lɔɔlɔhi, kwú ɔ̄ ú yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo gé­ē leyīkwu aɔ́dāajɛ kú um.

eng_Latn: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kéē híī ci uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo bī iyē kú anúɔ le yúklɔ́ o hídáagó nɛ̄ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó klla gbɔɔ́ ō ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu anúɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
idu_Latn: Ɛga nōo wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō nyā géē wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū kú Usádɔ̄ku ā. Uwá gbā um kpaakpa, í kē kwɔhá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ká e yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ohile ā yá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu cāŋjɛ, ó le abɔ̄ yá lɛ uwá kéē mā uya, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, mɛ́mla aéwɔhá nēe ī gbō Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā, kócōō, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um!.

eng_Latn: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é dɛ̄gba hī Ulɔ́tu igwú da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ɔ̄nɛ̄mā ā bá āa? Lɛ uwá kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ gé lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ lɛ ikpó uwā ce.

eng_Latn: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ aólɛlā kú aá fu kéē wā í kpó ɛfú gwō aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
idu_Latn: É dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá tá alɔ abɔ̄! Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē nwū ācɛ ɛlā ɛbɛɛbɛ lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ujíyu mla íne kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā á. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ o fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ó kē le ācɛ Ugríisi kpó wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā dúú, kē le ɛgotīihɔ nyā nyílá.

eng_Latn: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uríya tá Udéfīdi ohi ka ikpáti kú ɛka kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda ɛ́ɛ bá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú ipácí. Ó ka ɔkpani anúɔ, Ujówābu mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā, ɛ́ɛ kē gbo bá ɛcɛ ipácí. Ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā, ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ anúɔ í ga ɔlɛ́ anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ gaá gwá, ká anúɔ lé klla gwutá mɛ́mla ɔnyā anúɔ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔkpá gbo ka anúɔ í gáā yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́ á.

eng_Latn: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ɛbɛ́ ā ú lé ícíícɛ nɛ̄ aá gwɛ́ɛya ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī cɛ̄ lɛ odóódu kú nū kóō hile gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ŋ́. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
idu_Latn: É háyi abɔ́ɔ jigbaa ohígbū ɔdā nēé má ā. Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú é le ācɛ ɛpa nēe le úwé nɛ̄hɛ́ o ceyī ŋmaáŋmaá wiiyē má hayi pī uwā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya kahíníī, Ācɛ nāa kpó gaá lā ajɛ kú Usamérīya ā, abɔ̄ é jé íne kú Ɔwɔicō kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́ mā, ó le ágábá tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō kpó uwá ŋmó ɛɛ́ n.

eng_Latn: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ igbīhi gaá lɛ ācɛ pllā, nēe kahíníī, Alɔ pó eko nōó gē bīya iyē kú Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And he will appoint him captains over thousands, and captains over fifties; and will set them to ear his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and instruments of his chariots.
idu_Latn: Ó géē fu ācɛ ōhī kú uwā kéē wɛ aógbēnjūwā kú aícɔ́ɔja ulúlā kú nū, ācɛ ɔhá kē í gbɔbɛ́fú kú ígwíígwu kú ofɛpa ce igwó ā, ofɛpa ce igwó, ayí aá ōhī géē bá í hɛ́hɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́, ígwu ɔhá géē bā ī cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū. Aɔ́há géē bā ī na iyɛ́fú kú nū mɛ́mla iyó kú úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nū.

eng_Latn: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ ká ā pó ɛcá mɛ́mla oōgwō kú uwā. Ígblɛ́nyī kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄wā ipú okónu kú uwā, nááná ā, é kē gbɛlá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, ɔ́ɔ pó ɛlā kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
idu_Latn: Ayí nɛ̄ Ásɛ̄nati, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Upɔtifɛ́ra, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Uhiliyɔpɔ́lisi ā, ma lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu, ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā wɛ: Umanásɛ mɛ́mla Ɛ́frem.

eng_Latn: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ um má ɛɛ́, kē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā má dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ihɔtū kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ eko dóódu lɛ ācɛ nēe gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā piyóó ā. Olɔhi kú nū kē yɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋmá ayááyí ga ayááyí.

eng_Latn: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú, awɔ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā ā. Awɔ nōo cīce ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aúcɛ́rōbim ā, awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo kē ī gbō odúúdú aájɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ á. Awɔ kē yá ɔkpāncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mā iyó kū nū, nɛ̄ ó bī ā tá, ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu ɛkpa kú ɔdōlé ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu ga ɔgbɛ́fú nyɔ̄ í hókónu tū ayínɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ádā um gē yúklɔ́ ojigógó, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n kē í yá á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá í cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, aá géē je éyi ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú nū lɛ Uféro. Aá lɔfú bī ɛga nōo hile ā kóō wɛ ɛdɔ nɛ̄ aá í nyi igbɔhá. Ó klla í wɛ ɔdōlé kú aá mɛ́mla aíkonó kú aá.

eng_Latn: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
idu_Latn: N klla géē je uwɔ lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ a gē yúúfi uwá ā, nēe ī tíne ō ŋmó uwɔ ā. N géē je uwɔ lɛ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū.

eng_Latn: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóbu lɛ ɔ́ɔmā pó ā, ó cāŋjɛ, le īlī kú nū híla, klla lɛ ɛyí kú nū plla, kóō mafú ɔtūnōbí kú nū. Ó má gblugudu klá ajɛ lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ ká n̄ le ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī ka ā ka lɛ Ugɔ́gu. Ó kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu lá ipú ajɛ kú uwá ɛbɔ́ ā, a gē gbɔɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thus were the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof was great.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄na nɛ̄ n nā eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbiiyɔ̄lā yɔ̄ á. N pīyeyī, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔcí kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ ɛcɛ. Ó jɛ̄ licō nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā le má ka, Umósīsi ɔ́ɔ le eyī pīya yɔ̄ ī túbla ɔlá ā ajaajɛ ā, ó le ɔ́ higwú ŋmá ipácí ā, kahíníī, Umósīsi, Umósīsi, Umósīsi Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi nēé túgwó igbɔ̄há kpɔ́, ká ācɛ kéē wā í le pīyatɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ójīla ā kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā yá nyā, wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā je íne kú nū gā um ká n yá nɛ.

eng_Latn: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́, alɔ tíne ká ā le jé ka, ācɛ Ujíyu, nēe ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú uwɔ wā í lā Ujerúsālɛm amānyā a, klla gbɔɔ́ ō tū igelī nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lā anú ā bɔ̄bíipú, klla ī yíikpɛ̄yí olɔfú ɔ́ɔmā gwó igbɔhá ɛɛ́. É gbɔɔ́ ō ma ɔdɔ ā ɛɛ́, é kē í je ɔ́ ma kwɛyí eko kpií nōo í wā ā.

eng_Latn: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
idu_Latn: Ighīhi ɛ̄nyā, ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō gē dɛ̄gba lɔfú lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka akpáabana nōo ī gbo ā. Ɔwɔ kē ī yɔ̄ ī límanya eko ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu ɔ́ gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ, ayínɛ́ um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ yúklɔ́ lɔfú lɔfú lɛ ā! Alɔ yúklɔ́ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú cɛ́ɛ́ ka abɔ̄ alɔ bá mla aá gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá ā, kóō híīī wɛ unwalu kú ije ō ŋmó lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔhá kú Ɛ́lam ā wɛ úlā ɛtá ce ofɛpa ce igwɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɔlá tū, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō yi, nɛ̄ó le hábɔ̄ ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, nɛ̄ó kwú ɔdɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó cē bá ajɛ ā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e háyi icō ā ú yi, ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū ɔlá ā géē gbā ulé kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo yɔlá ā lɛ óndú nū.

eng_Latn: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Uhanáni, éyi kú ayínɛ́ um mɛ́mla ígwu kú ācɛ ɔhá, gā ŋmá Ujúda. N le ɔ̄kā da uwá ohígbū Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu nēe pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi ka aá cɛ̄, ka Óndú kóō wɛ ijáalí kú aá mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ í kpó odúúdú aéwo nēe í wā í dɔɔ̄kā ō kpɛ́fú tū ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā yíifi eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī gbɛlá ipɔ́tū kú aá ka, Abɔ̄ Ébrahām kē wɛ ádáádā alɔ ā, ɔdā dúú í yá alɔ gla ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n da aá ka Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɛ ɛcɔ̄ nēe bá ā pīya ayí lɛ Ébrahām glá.

eng_Latn: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Aá, ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā ɛpa nyā, n gē je ōwē lɛ aá ohígbū ajā nɛ̄ aá gbo ā, mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aá bī ŋmá lɛ ɛcí nɛ̄ aá pá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
idu_Latn: Ubatsséba klla da ɔ́ ka Ágábáidu, odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ le eyī kpó klá anú eko ɔ́ɔmā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ da uwá, ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipú ācɛ nēe cīce ā mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nɛɛ, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā cíkā ō mā ɛlā.

eng_Latn: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
idu_Latn: Eko kpií ā, n géē kwú, í ga ɔlékwū, nɛ̄ n kē gáā yēeyī gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ábsālɔm lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū wɛɛlɛ yɛ ipú odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔkɔ kú opo pó ɛɛ́, ɛ́ɛ̄ ka ka Ábsālɔm ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé ajɛ kú Uhɛ́brɔn ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, Usɔ́lu lɛ aícɔ́ɔja úlā ahāapa ce ofu igwó tū ga ipú ígbíli kú Usífu, kéē gaá dɔɔ̄kā Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka gā uwɔ ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é lɛ ede ā gwó, a géē je ede ā gā um, oŋmá lɛ o gwɛ́ɛya ɛya oyɔlá ɛyí nū mɛ́mla oyī kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya ā oōmī klā ede ā.

eng_Latn: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā wɛ áncā. Óndú ā í kɛlā dúúmā lɛ uwā ŋ́. Ɔdā nēé ka ā géē yá uwā abɔ̄yī uwā á.

eng_Latn: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó ā, í gáā ga abɔ́ɔ í gwɔ̄ɔ́ci ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ka Ɔwɔicō géē hɔ́hā ce aá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛbɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā kóō yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū o ŋmá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ujísɔ̄si Óndú alɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usófa, ɔ̄cɛ Unáamā ā tóohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
idu_Latn: N lɔfú pi ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ahɔ̄ ká ó géē kwú, amáŋ ó lɔfú mā ɔ́bíipú kú nū ā tá klla gbo ɔ́ ō yá ɔdōlɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdā okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú, aá blakwu ɔdā nyā ka aá leyī yɛ ɔ́. Aá mlanyī ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ klla kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um nɛ̄ n fu le owu kú um nōo ī lɛ ɔfú tū ɔ̄cɛ iyē ā je lɛ ɔ́ ā yɔ̄ á. Anú nɛ̄ n fu ā, ɛlā nū kē he um ɔtū. N le ɔfú je lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ó kē í bī ɔ̄ɔ̄ hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa lɛ ācɛ kú éwo dóódu ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá géē fūla ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú ijakī kú aá mla omlede kú aá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá í gáā hīla ɔ́ ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɔ́ ɔkɔ cē. Aá géē fūla ɔ́kplá kú aá dóódu. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá í gáā wā iyɔ̄bū um abɔ̄ áncā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá á. Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ wā gaá gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɛgbā kú nū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
idu_Latn: Ó le lɛ ā, alɔ nēe wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā gáā yá kú ádā alɔ kóō kwú ipú ɔtūnōbí mɛ́ɛ̄ á, ohígbū ka oyēeyī kú ádā ā gbolóce oyēeyī kú ɔyí ā.

eng_Latn: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Amasíya da Émɔ̄si kahíníī, Ó jɛ̄ ɛɛ́, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā ga Ujúda, kú ā gaá bēē tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō abɔ́ɔ kéē gbā ulé gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, aéwɔhá géē cɛ̄ aá ɛhɔ̄. É géē gbo aálá kú aá, é í hɛ́hɔ̄ lɛ aá, klla í leyīkwu ɛhɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin kú aá.

eng_Latn: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ipú ɛcɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā, eko nɛ̄ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē yāajɛ akpa ɔcɛ́ kú nū nōo tū ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā, aá nēe kē yɛce um ā géē yāajɛ ɛyí akpa ɔcɛ́ igwɛ́ɛpa ká aá kɛpɔ̄ tū aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka ó yɔ̄ ī nwū ayíkpó kú nū ɛlā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ācɛ géē yá ibīyājɛ tū Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ, é kē í ŋmó ɔ̄. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá le gla ó géē héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
idu_Latn: Okónu nɛ̄ um ce ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó gē pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́. N bī odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n wɛ ā le ɔkpá gbo ɛɛ́. Ka odúúdú ācɛ géē wā í lɛ okwúukwu kwaajɛ iyɔ̄bū um klla géē gbo ɔkpá ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ ga um piíí.

eng_Latn: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí kē wɛ ɛyí kú ɔcí nēé hī ka olīfu nēe háyi ābɔ̄ ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa kú ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ āā.

eng_Latn: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū trɛ̄yí bū ipú ígbíli ā, ijēēnyi í ŋmó uwá ŋ́. Ohígbū koó je éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā. Ó kwú ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā ú yíla, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ kwú ca klɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
idu_Latn: A le aólɛla kú um hīgwú bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé gē hīgwú ga ɔ anú ucɛ ā, kéē wā í kpɛ́fú tá alɔ ŋmá ɔ́kíkā dóódu. Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā, ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kwu ámāŋ ka oyēeyī glá ŋ́. Ayí um nɛ̄ n bī jɛ̄, nēe klá hi um ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā, aólɛla le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe pó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó bī ohílīpú yɔ̄ í le dɔɔ̄kā klla yɔ̄ ī cīla ɔ̄kā ā le kpó hídáagó.

eng_Latn: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
idu_Latn: Alɔ nɛ̄ ɛ̄nɛ̄ mla Ádā alɔ wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ā, nɛ̄ alɔ í kē wɛ aílɔ́wá nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu hī ācobīyíne ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n géē kpó anyā uwā lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ ɔhá. N klla í kpó ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā lɛ ācɛ nēe í gaá mīyɛ ɔkwu uwā ā. Kwu ācɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kwu ācɛnɛ̄hi ī tíne ō bī ɔwɛ újí le lɛ agbénú. Kwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya gē plla ācɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
idu_Latn: Aólíla, ó wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yá iyɛ̄ɛcɛ ā yá eyīpú dúú ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yá aɔ́dā alɛwa tayínu nōó he Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ŋ́. É le aíkpɛ́cí kpó gwó tū ipú aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ kú eyīpú kú uwā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā á. Óndú ā, wɛ iyē nū á.

eng_Latn: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
idu_Latn: Aá bá cíí iyɔ̄bū kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā le kwu ajaajɛ ɛɛ́. Óndú ā le tútū kóō ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ nēé gáā le gwɛ́ɛya ā. Ó le aólɛlā hīgwú kéē wā í kwú Ujúda í wu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō, ā géē bī ācoŋmɔ́ɔ̄cɛ, mɛ́mla aúwī, mɛ́mla ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā ga ipú únóji kú uwā piíí. Uwá í gāa lā āyā éyi kú oyēeyī kú uwā ga ajɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ ami ā, géē lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā nēé géē je ɔ̄cɛ o lɔnyā ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē gwōkónu eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
idu_Latn: A gē mīyɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē he uwá kéē yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē lā oyēeyī kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tíne kéē lā ā bɔ́ɔtū. A le cɔ̄nū da alɔ ohígbū ka alɔ lɛ íne kú uwɔ bīya. Nááná nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū tū alɔ ā, alɔ kē bá yɔ̄ ī bɔ̄bíipú eko dóódu ŋmífī īkée. Ó lɛ ā, é nya alɔ tá gbóógbóō glá āa?.

eng_Latn: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú tū Uhágāyi fu ācɛ ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name's sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu klla da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le okónu ce lɛ uwá ɛɛ́. Ó gáā cīgbīhi kwu uwá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ó kwú uwā ú pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
idu_Latn: É le alɔ yá ocɛ̄bícɛ̄bi, alɔ gwutá ajɛ lɛ eyī pīya klá úmúlá ɛɛ́, alɔ í kē cāŋjɛ ŋmá ajɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ɛgahi kú Ísrɛ̄lu í gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē pīya ɔtū kú nū abɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka, ó wɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ klla ī pīya ɔtū kú nū abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
idu_Latn: Awɔ olíla, n géē yá ká ā le jé ka ɔ́dāŋ ka a cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō áncā, nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ a gē yá kóō ma ɔ́ fú ŋ́, ó tīile dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
idu_Latn: Ó géē leyīkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́mla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú um piyóó. Ipɔ́ɔmā kú ɔlɛ́ nū géē yɔ̄ ī lé ɔcɛ́ piyóó.

eng_Latn: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
idu_Latn: N yá ɔdā alɛwa nɛ̄hi. N gwó inu alɛwa klla hɛ́hɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ odɔ̄lɛ́ éyi nōo yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Usakíyɔ̄si. Ó kē lɛ agbénú.

eng_Latn: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ oklobīya ā í kpó eko bónū ŋ́, ó le ɔdā nɛ̄ é ka ā yá, ohígbū ka ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā he ɔ́ ɔtū. Anú ā kē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ fíyɛ́ kpɛ́mm ipú odúúdú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ɔ̄hā hɛ́ ce aá ipú úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú aá dóódu ɛ́ɛ́. Ka ɔ́ɔ leyīkwu uwá ipú iyāwu kú uwā o yɛ ga amu ga anú kú ipú ígbíli nɛ̄hi ā. Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ húmáyī yɔ̄ mla uwá ŋmífī iháyí ofɛpa nēe gaá yɛ ā. Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ le odúúdú aɔ́dā nōo ce uwá ɛgbá kpɛ́mm ā lɛ.

eng_Latn: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le cɔ̄nū abɔ̄ Ubálam yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā. Abɔ̄ Ubálam ce ijakī kú nū yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ mla ayíkpó kú nū ɛpa ā, alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gaá háyi ɔwɛ kú nū, ó le ɔkpacaŋ́gelī bī abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aójéeyī ā bī anɔ̄ ɔhá ipú íkpém mɛ́mla agege kú uwa.

eng_Latn: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
idu_Latn: Kwú pīya ɔ̄cogbāálá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, nāa fu ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, Óndú. Uwá lā hī iyī uwā tá ipú ígbíli nááná ā, ajɛ oyɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ kē yɛ jíla uwā tā. Cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kéē kōō nyɔ̄ í lé ɔdōlé kú ajɛ olɔhi kú Ubássan, mɛ́mla Ugílɛ̄di, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ uwá tɛtɛ yá íkée ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā olɔhí dóódu nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ugídīyɔn yá lɛ uwá ā, í jɛ̄ uwá eyī ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛnyā kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm ā da Unaómi kɔ́ɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Óndú ā, nɔ́ɔ le ɔyí kú ɔyí nōo géē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ je lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́ ā. É cōkónu lɛ ɔyí ā ká ɔ̄ le fāajɛ nɛ̄hi ipú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka oŋmá lɛ ɛya nōō gwó igbo ékpó ā, ó le ācɛ nēé gwu uwá iyē ŋmá íneoōbīya ā yá yēŋēē piyóó.

eng_Latn: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
idu_Latn: Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ oleyīɛpa ā! Aá lɔfú le ɛcɛ má le ɔkpáncō má anɔ́ɔ aá gē ka ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ á. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdá nōo yɔ̄ í yá eko nyā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ucɛ ā, aá géē je aíkpɔ̄cí nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ŋmá ɔcí kú aá, ābɔ̄ kú alī, mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí nōo lɛ ēpū nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucɛ yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē ipéyī Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Uféro ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le abɔ̄ je gicō le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ akpáabana mɛ́mla ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɔ̄ ā mɛ, ɔwɔ í klla yā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n wā í yɛ igbɔhá ā, n má ka, eko ga ga uwɔ nāa le jɛ̄ ō lɛ ɔbá ɛɛ́. N kwú īlī kú um ú pīya klá iyē kú uwɔ nōo tá ohɛ́ɛwa ā. N lɛ okónu ce gā uwɔ ka n géē yɔ̄ ī yíihɔtū tá uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ n le okónu kú ɔbá mla ɔnya ce mla uwɔ, anɔ́ɔ a kwú pīya ɔnyā um á. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
idu_Latn: Mīyɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū gē nwū uwɔ ā, ká ā kwú ɛlā kú nū ú tayínū ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí kú Ukálɛ̄bu ɔ́mpa ā wɛ ádā kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m á. Ɔyí nū ɔmɛ́tá ā wɛ ádā kú Ubɛ́tgáda á.

eng_Latn: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
idu_Latn: Aógwuda gē kwú ohígbū íjééyī nēé tá ā. Á lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdée ŋ́ kú olíla gē je ɔ́ yíífi á.

eng_Latn: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
idu_Latn: É le gba klá odúúdú utéblu dóódu nēé cīce pīyeyī fu ā. Ó kē lɛ ɛga dóódu nōo le péee ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ háyi ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cokónu ka aá cɛ̄ aɔ́dā nēe tá táajɛ ipú ɛka nɛ̄ aá gbo mla Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
idu_Latn: Nyi īkpɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ eko dóódu, ohígbū ka á jé eko nōo géē yá lɔhi ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka é géē je bīya dúúdú nɛɛ ámāŋ ka ó géē yá lɔhi nɛɛ, á jé ŋ́. Ekōhi ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ūwā géē yá lɔhi, amáŋ aɛ́nɛ̄ a nyi eko éyi ā kē lɔfú jé ā.

eng_Latn: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ubálam le ohi tá ɔ̄ ka, n da ācɛ nāa tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu um ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ kú ipú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Árɔ̄ni, nōo géē je oyī mɛ́mla ijē ā gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā, géē lɛ átákwū kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ yá ɔ́ɔmā wɛ Usádɔ̄ku, ɔyí kú Ɛlísaa mɛ́mla Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Utáma ā.

eng_Latn: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
idu_Latn: Ayisáya dɔɔkā kahíníī, Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō nú iyó nɛ̄ ícɔ́ɔjá kpó abɔ̄fú ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā glá āa? Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō hɛ́ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ olɔfú kwú tū agbá ā tá glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujeremíya yɔ̄ agbá ipú inu kú ācogbāajɛ kú agblɔcɛ́ ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, Ɔwɔicō kɛlā nyā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó cɛ̄ mɛ́mla anú ŋ́, ó kōō ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ó géē je ɔ́ ŋmó tónū.

eng_Latn: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kwú iyī aá ú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ká aá cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄, ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, aá kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā. Ó kōō wɛ ákú íne ō bīya nōo ŋmɛ́yí tá ikwū, ámāŋ ákú ɛyí ō táajɛ nōo ŋmɛ́yí tá o kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umefíbóssɛ̄ti tukpɛɛ́ le ágbá tá ɔ́ yɔ̄ ī ka ka anúɔ í lɔhi fíyɛ́ okwū ewō ŋ́, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ anúɔ āa.

eng_Latn: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gwō tū ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú gaá kpó iyó kú nū glá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ gbō tāajɛ gbɔbū, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó í má ɛga kpó iyō kú nū glá á.

eng_Latn: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
idu_Latn: Umánōwa í jé kóō wɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kóō híī nyɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ ɛbɛ́ kú ɛdrɔ́ kú ɛwū he lɛ ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ lé ɛ́ɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ í nyɔ̄ ŋ́ nááná, anúɔ í gáā lé ɔdōlé kú nū a ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ kéē tíne ō yá ɔdōlé ā piíí nɛɛ, ɛ́ɛ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndá ā.

eng_Latn: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,
idu_Latn: Ajɛ kú uwá kē wɛ, Usóra, Ɛssitáwolu, Irissémessi.

eng_Latn: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn wɛ, Ɛlísāfan, ɔyí kú Upanáci.

eng_Latn: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɛlá kwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, nēe gē wā ɛgiyí aá bɛ̄ɛka aálá nōó ī yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ eyīpú ā, é lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔgwú oyúkpanu ā.

eng_Latn: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
idu_Latn: Aá géē gwɛ́ɛya kú umu kú īkpɔ̄dā nēé lɛ anɔ̄ kú ólífu tū ɔ̄. Okoolo ɛtá kú umu mla ɔbá ɛna éyi, ɛpa ŋmá ipu igwó kú umu mla omlede éyi.

eng_Latn: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
idu_Latn: Ujehósōfati yɔ̄ í lɔfú mla íkwu tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ gɔbū. Ó le ɔdɔ olɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla igá kpó gwó tū odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda ā, mɛ́mla.

eng_Latn: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, Ujóssuwa cāŋjɛ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há. Anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le uwá bī tá ga Ái.

eng_Latn: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē je uwɔ, Userúbábɛ̄lu ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā, n klla í fu uwɔ ká ā bī iyē kú um le gbāājɛ. Awɔ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n fu á. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ɔtū kpó ce ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī uwā, anɔ́ɔ é gē ŋmó ācɛ á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;
idu_Latn: Eko nōó je unwalu kú ɛlā nyā lɛ ɔ́ oŋmá ɛ̄cī éyi ga ɛ̄cī ɔhá ā, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄jɛ̄ unwalu ā le jɛ̄ Usámsin, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ eyī kōō yá ɔ̄ kóō gekwú.

eng_Latn: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel's father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.
idu_Latn: Ofúlɔ̄cī kú ɛci ɔmɛhɔ̄ ā, ó cāŋjɛ gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄, amáŋ ádā odiyɔ̄ ā da ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔdōlé lé ɛ́ɛ́. Kéē gbēyī lígíí ɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyɔ̄ igbīhāajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛnyīlɔ ɛpa ā lɛ ɔdōlé lé tɔ̄há á.

eng_Latn: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
idu_Latn: Úgbɔ́ɔ́nya nɛ̄ aɔ́nya nōbí ā gē pi ā gē ga Ubábīlɔn. Aɔ́nya nɛ̄hɛ́ ā bá ī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, aɔ́nya o tína poópoó ā bá ī ga ɛháajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ okwū ɔnyā nū tá ā, lɛ tá ɛgiyí ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, gaá da uwā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó lā iháyí ofigwó ɔhá kpɔ́. Ó klla le ayí ɔhá dúú.

eng_Latn: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli kú ɛ̄cī Aláadi eko nɛ̄ obū le du kpɔ́ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, Umerí Umagidalíni, le tá únóji, anɔ́ɔ ó má kéē le ɛcɔ̄ ā míya ŋmá okónu únóji ā.

eng_Latn: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ n ka nyā, Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Asíriya ā kéē lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā kpó gwu ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú. Kwu ajɛ kú aá, ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cowɛ́ɛ́yí gē bī igwu o wɛ́ɛ́yí ī púla īnyīlɛ̄yí, gē wá ɔnwū agba mɛ́mla ɔnwū ikpó ŋmá ācɛ iyē ā.

eng_Latn: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
idu_Latn: Aá yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ga ipú ajɛ nōo ge gbiyē nɛɛɛ ā. Amáŋ ami ā, í gáā nyɔ̄ mla ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ n géē kpó aá ŋmó. Ohígbū ka aá wɛ ācɛ o yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú.

eng_Latn: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
idu_Latn: ācɛ kú Ugɛ́balu, ācɛ kú Ámɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki. Ācɛ kú Ufilístiya mla Utáya.

eng_Latn: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda le ibīyāajɛ yá tū um dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ujékɔ̄pu í tū Ubɛ́njamīn, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ujósɛ̄fu abɔ̄ɔ̄bɔ̄yi nū ā ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwá ŋ́, ohígbū koó yɔ̄ gē yúúfi ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí éyi ɔ́ɔ lɔfú yá ɔ̄ glá.

eng_Latn: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka bū okónu kú Ujéhu, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā, lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ubássa ā, Usímri le odúúdú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nu kú Ubássa ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
idu_Latn: Lɛ alɔ kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ kpɔ́, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ményīnyi alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ le nyatá.

eng_Latn: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu ce ɛhīlī nɛ̄ Ása, lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ɛ́la, ɔyí kú Ubássa le ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ɛpa, ajɛ kú Utɛ́sa.

eng_Latn: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
idu_Latn: N géē klá mla aá ligíi, ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́, n géē klá mla aá eko kú ofū ā dúúdú, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɔfú tá um abɔ̄ ká n̄ yɛ gɔbū ipú iyāwu kú um, ɛga dúú nɛ̄ n tíne ō nyɔ̄ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upɔ́lu da uwá kahíníī, É ŋmó alɔ ɛpɔ̄bí kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúú nɛ̄ alɔ yá ŋ́, nááná é kē le alɔ gɔ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ ɛwa, alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ ajɛ kú Uróm! Anɔ́ɔ ē kē lɛ alɔ kpótú ipú ināgbá. Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā é tínē kéē kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ wɛɛlɛ ɛkwūbá āā? Alɔ tá. Éē gā abɔ̄yī uwā gaá kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɛtá pióo, agbénú nɛ̄hi kú Umówābu a gēe mɛ. Ɛwa kú ācɛ kú Umówābu nɛ̄hi nyā gēe gāa hile ācɛ ɛflɛ́ɛfu lígíí.

eng_Latn: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aícɔ́ɔja ula cofigwó kú Udáni, nēe lɛ tútū kéē kpɛ́fú ā háyi okónɔɔwɛ kú igá ā bá ī gbāājɛ.

eng_Latn: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
idu_Latn: Náaná nɛ̄ a jé ku ācɛ Ubábīlɔn géē mīyɛ igelī nyā ā, Óndú le ka ga um, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, piií kē da um ka amíyɔ̄ bī ije lɛ ajɛ ā lá, klla lɛ aíjáalí hī.

eng_Latn: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tóhi kahíníī, Ɔcí dóódu nɛ̄ Ádā um, nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā, í tū ŋ́, é géē fu ɔ́ tɛgbatɛgba ŋmá ajɛ.
