eng_Latn: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ukɔ́tin yá mla owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔwá. Kú ā lɛ ijā he tū ɔ̄ mla ifotó kú Ucérūbim o lɛ acá.

eng_Latn: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī igwú ā nyāŋjɛ anɔ́ɔ é le Ujísɔ̄si bī ga iyɔ̄bū Upáyílēti á.

eng_Latn: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛga nēé je lɛ Óndú ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ajɛ ā á. É gáā je āyā dúúmā kú ajɛ kú Óndú ā lá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ uwá gē je ɔ́ fllabɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́. Ajɛ ā wɛ ákú Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
idu_Latn: Aúcɛ́rōbim ā le eyī pīya tá iyī ūwā. É le acá nāndaa klá ɛga o cīce kú eyīnyinyi ā.

eng_Latn: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ɛhícō kú ikpámílī kú aɔ́cɛ́ á. Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm jikwū nū klla le ekwu kú nū yɔ̄ dúú. É klla le ojīlīmā ce okwú kú nū nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū, Umanásɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá híī yá kú ācɛ kéē ŋmó aá okónu ohígbū ka aá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
idu_Latn: Igbómína ā le abɔ̄ yá lɛ Upɔ́lu kóō kɛlā, anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n jé ka a húmáyī kɛpɔ̄ ajɛ nyā iháyí alɛwa ā, ɔtū he um nɛ̄hi bá n gē kɔkɔ kú um ā.

eng_Latn: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ bá gē ka olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ mā, ámāŋ ka ācɛ ɔlamu le bēhé wā ipú ínu ā, ɛlā nōó í pó ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄ jé ka anúɔ lɛ ínebīya.

eng_Latn: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛlā Ukémosi, ɔwɔ kú Umówābu ā, géē tū ācɛ Umówābu uwēyī, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ojibó kú ugóolu kú, ɔwɔ nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu lɔtūce tɛtɛ ā, tū uwá uwēyī ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
idu_Latn: Ó gáā ga inu ɛgiyí okwū dúúmā ŋ́. Ó kōō wɛ okwū kú ádā nū ámāŋ ákú ɛ́nɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
idu_Latn: Usísmayi, Ussálum.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́! Aá lɛ únóji olɔɔlɔhi ma lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ aádáádā aá kpó ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ka eko ɔ́ɔmā ā ekwu nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm géē yɔ̄ ā, géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ é yɔ̄ ohígbū Uhadadi rímɔn ipú ɔpɛ́ kú Umegído ā.

eng_Latn: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛgahi kú eko nɛ̄ Alelékwū ā lɛ ɛka ā kwajɛ ā nwuné fíyɛ́ kɔ́ɔ́.

eng_Latn: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
idu_Latn: Usíya klla mīyɛ Ɛ́lāti kwúcē, klla le ɔ́ tūgwó, igbīhi ikwú kú ádā nū ā.

eng_Latn: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē yá ā, wɛ ohígbū kéē lɛ odée má lé mɛ́mla o lɛ odée má gwá nɛ, amáŋ ipú kú ɔ̄cɛ í kē ī nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ā gē yá ɔdā dóódu ipú obíipú nɛ̄hi, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ́ɛ wɛ ajɛ kú Ugíbēya ā Ó ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē blatū íne nēé bīya ā klla í yá ūwā italā ohígbū nū.

eng_Latn: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ó géē wā í kɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ onɔwá, gē na oje nɛ̄hɛ́ amáŋ ka ugóolu péee ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ó géē gwu ācogwɛ́ɛya ā iyē klla í na uwá mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi péee lɛ á. Jāā gbéeko nēé gbɔɔ́ ō gwɛ́ɛya okpaakpa lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ahíja kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ, ɔnyā kú Ujérobōwam yɔ̄ í wā ɛgiyí uwɔ, gaá da uwɔ ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɔyí nū nōo gē doōcē ā. Ɛlā nyā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ a géē ka lɛ ɔ́ á. Eko nōó gā, ó yúula ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā ɔhá.

eng_Latn: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
idu_Latn: Yá ká n̄ jɛ́ɛyí íne kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ yɔ̄ ī lɛ ɔ́ tū mla odúúdú ɔtū kú um.

eng_Latn: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
idu_Latn: N jikwū gbōmgbōm klá Óndú ā kóō tá um abɔ̄, ó kē le ikwū nɛ̄ n je ā pó. Anɔ́ɔ ó kē le um tábɔ̄ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Óndú ā he ɔ́ ɔtū, ó ī lɛ ojīlīma ce ācɛ nēe gē tá iyí uwā wāajɛ ŋmá lɛ ō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
idu_Latn: Óndú, aálelékwū nēe bá Ɔkpancō gē gwíijē kú ɔdā idáagó nāa ī yá ā, é gē gwíijē lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tōō lɔtūce lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!
idu_Latn: Ó géē he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ um ba ā je ga um, klla lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ um tíne ā yá gā um.

eng_Latn: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
idu_Latn: Ó kē jé kpɔ́cíí ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē yá ɔdā nōó cokónu nū ā glá.

eng_Latn: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Aá í gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,
idu_Latn: Aá blakwu ɔdā nōo yá eko íkée ā, ká aá jé ka ami ōfōōfūm wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō á, ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ ka ɔdā ɔhá dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
idu_Latn: O gē bī ookpaakpa le ka ɛpɔ̄ kú aólɛhɔ́cɛ, ó gēe ka ɛpɔ̄ ookpaakpa, kú ācɛ nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ootá uwá abɔ̄ ŋ ma. Ɛlā okónu kú nū ofuōofūnū gēe ŋmó ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ɛpɔ̄bí, klá í je odúúdú ācɛ obɔ̄bíipú a kpó ya ífi.

eng_Latn: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbīhi iháyí ɛtá n pīyɛyí ŋmá Udamáskɔ̄si ā n le tá Ujerúsālɛm gaá miya ɛlā mla Ukífāsi. Anɔ́ɔ n yɔ̄ mla anú ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É le jīla tɔ̄há mɛ́mla Ánāsi, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla Ukayáfāsi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni mɛ́mla Alesáŋda mɛ́mla odúúdú ipɔ́ɔnū kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é le jé ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ mā, é kwú eyī ú pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ācogwɛ́ɛya, ācɛ Ulífāyi, ācoyúklɔ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla ayí kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Usólōmɔn lā ipú ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī uwā mɛ́mla ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú abɔ̄yī uwā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ iyē kú ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nyɔ̄ í lā Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
idu_Latn: N géē tū aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí ɛhɔ̄ klá aá. É géē kpó ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá ŋmó, klla géē kpó aɔ́dāajɛ kú aá yíífi. Aá nēe géē hile ā í gáā nwuné ŋ́, nōo géē yá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kōō gáā tá ɔwɛ kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ ā, kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Áhābu gaá da ɔ́ ka anúɔ da ɔ́ gbɔbū ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla anyá ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ayí nū í kpó gé lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
idu_Latn: Ubɛsálilu, Oholíyābu mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ɔfú mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé lɛ uwá ā, ācɛ nōo jé ō yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu nēe cɛgbá kéē le gwó Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, géē yá uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā cābɔ̄ lɛ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
idu_Latn: Isíkēlu ka Óndú ā da anúɔ kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, lɛ eyī hɛ́tū ācɛnyā kú ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ̄ ē gē mɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā. Ka ɛbɛ obɔbí tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ lɛ ɔtū kú nū yá ékpó ka anúɔ í gáā lɛ ɔnyā ŋ́, nɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kē kwu ɔ́ bá ɔ̄ ŋ́, nōó kē cē únwū kú nū tū glá, ayíka ɔdā olɔhi nōo yá ka anúɔ í lɛ ɔ̄cɛnya ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔtū lé ga um eko kpiíí ká n̄ le mafú gā uwɔ. Ɔdā alɛwa bá nɛ̄ n géē ka kwɛyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ alelékwū-otɛ̄hɔ̄, o lɛ eyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ nyā yātū á. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá ɛga dóódu ā, kéē jé ka Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā, lɛ íkwu īkpɛ̄yí kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú alɛɛcɛ́ dúúmā ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Ó klla lɔfú je ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ nyā lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu nōó fu ā. Kwu ɔ̄cɛ nōó jɛ̄ ācɛ eyī ŋ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta le ɔ́ bī ga ɛkwūbá gbɔɔ́ ō ka ífulá tá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō tá, ká ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kóō yá uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gáā da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
idu_Latn: Éyi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um. Ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí le ɔ́ híla nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ lé, ohígbū ka oŋmífī nōó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā, ń má ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ā le inya nū Usedekíya jāā gbéeko nēé gaá lɛ ɔ́ kwú, ɔpɛ́ kú Ujérīko ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kwú kpó kwu hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá.

eng_Latn: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, blakwu um, eko nōó le lɔhi ga uwɔ. Kócōō ā mlanyī ká ā kɛlā kú um lɛ ɔcɛ́ nóó. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā tá um abɔ̄ kéē kwú um bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú agbá amānyā.

eng_Latn: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
idu_Latn: Ojuju kú aá dóódu ā wɛ áncā, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá miya ka aá ɔ́ɔ gē yá ā wɛ áncā, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ mɛ́mla alɔ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as at this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi da ācɛ aígelī kú Ujúda, le yá mla uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā ipú aígelī ɔhá kú Ujúda ā mɛ́mla aúlāyi kú Ujerúsālɛm á. É le uwá wúlatāajɛ, kwú uwā ú tá alácɛ̄ jāā kwu ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛka nɛ̄ n géē gbo mla uwá. Eko nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā le yɛ, n géē kpó íne kú um tū ipú ɔtū kú uwā, n klla géē tá íne ā bá ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ɔkpáncō yɔ̄, iyē kú ɛcɛ yɔ̄. Ɛgahi kú ɔkpíyē kú ɔkpáncō wɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ̄ ɛgahi kú ɔkpíyē kú ɛcɛ tá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, A ī plla īlī tá ohɛ́ɛwa bɛ̄ɛka akwuna ā ī je iyī uwɔ tá lɛ aɔ́ya uwɔ ā, mla aɛ́cí nāa ī pā ā. A klla ī ŋmó ayí uwɔ ī kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ aɛ́cí ā.

eng_Latn: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā le ujɔ̄ kú uwā ā jé ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́kwu gā aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ulístra mɛ́mla Udábi, igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ulayikónīya klla yɛ jāā ga aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe yɛ jīla ajɛ ā tá ā.

eng_Latn: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ Ágrīpa! N lɔfú kɛlā gā awɔ tɛ́ɛcɛ péee glá. N jé cāā ka a jé aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā, é kē wɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū uwɔ ŋ́, ohígbū ka aɔ́dā nēe yá ā í yá ipú ajoodobū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í lɛbɛ̄ɛka Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, nōo cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū icō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū í gē kwú ŋ́ má, ó lā ipú ɔlá o fíyaajɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í túblá anú gllá ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í má ɔ̄ eyī jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í ke gáā má ɔ gbóógbóō gllá ŋ́ má. Ojīlīmā mɛ́mla ɔfú ō lɛ piyóó kóō wɛ ákú nū.

eng_Latn: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā é le yɛ úgbéenyi kwúcē wā Ántiyɔ̄ku, ɛga nēé kpó uwā tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄ kóō leyīkwu uwá ohígbū úklɔ́ nēé yá kwɛyí ā.

eng_Latn: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le odúúdú íne nɛ̄ Óndú ā kpó lɛ ɔ́, ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi ā kpó ka lɛ uwáá.

eng_Latn: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. Then they brought these men before the king.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɛlā ā pó ā, ó kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ uwá kpó wā iyɔ̄bū anúɔ.

eng_Latn: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
idu_Latn: N le gbo ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ klla kwú hīla ɛɛ́, amáŋ ń má ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa dúúmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā kwú ɛlá nū ú gwū jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cí nū ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ nēe wā ɛgiyí ucɛ ā le pó ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ gē wā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ kú ogwugwu dóódu, idangblēnyi, ucē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú uwā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ o cɔ̄nū í gē mīyɛ ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka o ŋmá lɛ ō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ipú ɔtū kú alɔ ā nēe le ka alɔ gwó mla Ɔwɔicō á. Ó kē wɛ o bī okónu kú alɔ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ā yá nēé nya alɔ tá á.

eng_Latn: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
idu_Latn: gaá yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ojuja ā le ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ Íjīpiti bá ā yá dobū kpím amáŋ ó le ɔlá ō fíyajɛ je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja í túblá iyī uwā ajaajɛ otú ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ uwá kpó ga ɔlɛ́ nū, le ɔdōlé je lɛ aíjakī kú uwā, klla lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ je lɛ uwá le ikpó na. Ó klla le ɔdōlé je lɛ uwá i lé.

eng_Latn: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kóō le má ka anúɔ í lɔfú jɛ̄ ŋ́, ó géē tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ɔcɛ́ ā eko nōó yɔ̄ ɛgaligbó ɛ́ɛ́ ma cɛ́ɛ́ kóō da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā, ɔdā nēe í yá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpɛ́fú tū iyī uwā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Ɔwɔicō, ó lɛ éwo dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ipu ɛcɛ nyā nɛ̄ Áhābu í tíne uwɔ nyɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú éwo éyi le ka ka á yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ, Áhābu gē da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ lɛ ɔkpá gbo kéē pīya uwɔ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
idu_Latn: N klla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú abɔ̄ kú ɔcí kú ɔ́lifu ɛpa nēe bá igbīhi kú aúlo kú ugóolu nēé gē bī le pīya anɔ̄ tū agege āa.

eng_Latn: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa kú Ujíyu jé ɔdā nēé tá ā, ohígbū ka ɛga nēé je Ujísɔ̄si nyɔ́kpá ā yɔ̄ kwu Ujerúsālɛm ajaajɛ. É tá ɔ̄ okónu Uhíbru, Ulátin mɛ́mla Ugríisi.

eng_Latn: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ aá gē lé ɔdōlé ā, aá gē gbēyī ɔ́mpa aá ŋ́, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ gbɔɔ́ ō lé ɔdōlé kú nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó ācɛ ōhī, ejé kē lɛ ācɛ ɔhá kwú.

eng_Latn: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛcɛ géē yɔ̄ í kwu lɛ ā, eko nēé ī nyi ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ géē yɔ̄, eko nēé géē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kē í yɔ̄. Eko ofū mɛ́mla eko iye okwulá géē yɔ̄, ɔgwā mɛ́mla ɔnɔ̄ kē géē yɔ̄. Ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú kē géē yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā, le yɛ tá ajɛ kú Uhɛ́ti, lɛ ɔlɛ́ gwó abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ, ó kwú iyē í ce ɔ́ ka Ulúsi á. Iyē ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ ā lé jāā kwu eko nɛ̄ é tɔ́kpá nyā á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:
idu_Latn: Kéē kwú ɛpɔ̄ kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā ú bī gé lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ulífāyi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ā hɛ́.

eng_Latn: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi gē je ɔdā olɔhi ŋmá agbénú olɔhi kú nū. Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí gē je ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ŋmá agbénú obɔ̄bí kú nū.

eng_Latn: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
idu_Latn: Otɛtɛ, Utɛ́dāsi cāŋjɛ gē jɔfú ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi. Anɔ́ɔ áluka ācɛ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka úlá éyi cēkplá mla anú. É lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ dóódu nēe cēkplá mla anú ā le fíyákátā, anɔ́ɔ ofú kú uwā mɛ á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdī wɛ iyē kú uwɔ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla ákú Umanásɛ le yɛ gaá le ɛfú kpó tá igelī nēe hī ka Ubɛ́tɛlu. Éko ɔ́ɔmā é hī iye nū ka Ulúsi. Óndú ā tá uwá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
idu_Latn: Aá géē gwu odúúdu īlī kú aá, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nēé bī ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ yá, ámāŋ ka ɔnwū kú ɛwū, ámāŋ ka ɔcí cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú yá yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā le aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja o cɔɔnya kpó kē nyɔ̄ mla um. Anɔ́ɔ n le yɛ tá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Uyúfaretīisi á. N kwú ɔkpá kú ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā ú lɛ aígbómína ā.

eng_Latn: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó kwú ɛyí ú táajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā í cɔ̄nū je uwá kpó yíífi gɛ ŋ́ má. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le eyīnyinyi kú Ujúda má á.

eng_Latn: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Uhámɔ le ɛlā ka lɛ uwá kahíníī, Ussɛ́kɛm, ɔyí um, kwú ihɔtū kú ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú uwɔ ɛɛ́. kóocōō kóō lɛ ɔ́ lɛ.

eng_Latn: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.
idu_Latn: Ó híī hɛ́ aá idáagó ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ aá má ka aígabɔ̄ kú ipɔ́lɛ́ gē pīya aólɛhɔ́cɛ tū, klla nyá uwā ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa, klla í gē yá uwá ɔdā olɔhi ŋ́. Igabɔ̄ dóódu lɛ igabɔ̄ ɔhá nōo yɔ̄ ɛhícō gē gbō ɔ̄, ɔhá kē yɔ̄ nōo kē wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú odúúdú aígabɔ̄ nōo gē gbō odúúdú uwā.

eng_Latn: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ajɛ kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, ɔcí ō gwá ufáyin mɛ́mla ɔcí nēé hī Ufígi mɛ́mla ɔcí ɔhá nēé hī ka upɔmegrɛ́nēeti, mɛ́mla ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu mɛ́mla ɛnwú.

eng_Latn: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī ga Ubiyɛssɛ́ba gaá gbā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Aá híī tíne um Ubɛ́tɛlu ŋ́, Ubɛ́tɛlu í gáā wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Aá kē híī ga Ugígalu ŋ́, ohígbū ka é í kpó ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ abɔ̄fú ga ɛga nēé géē cɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla okoolo éyi kú umu mɛ́mla ɔyí omlede éyééye.

eng_Latn: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
idu_Latn: Oŋmá iyāwu alɛwa nɛ̄ n yɛ ā, n gē kwu ikwu ajaajɛ ipú enyi o cēenyi klɛ́ɛcɛ. N gwō tū ipú aíjagwuda. N lɛyí cikwū ipú abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ujíyu kú ɔlɛ́ um, n lɛyí cikwu ipú abɔ̄ kú aílɔ́wá. N lɛyí cikwū ipú igelī alɛwa, n lɛyícikwū ipú ūpū. N lɛyí cikwū ipú ísu, n klla kē lɛyícikwū ipú abɔ̄ kú aóklóbīya ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́daŋ ka ācɛ okpaakpa ā wɛ ofɛpa ce igwó ipú igelī ā bɛ́ɛ? A géē je odúúdú igelī ā yíífi kpɔ́ɔ̄? Á gaá mabɔ̄ igelī ā tá ohígbū ācɛ ofɛpa ce igwó ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔ́wá kú Ufárisīs ōhī le ɔdā nōo yá ā má, anɔ́ɔ é da ayíkpó kú nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ itíca kú aá gē lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ācɛ odɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla ācobīyíne āa.

eng_Latn: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó kwú īyī nū ú tɛ́ɛcɛ péee, cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú ācɛ kéē má ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ akwunaā, ó kwú ce um eyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo cɛ̄ kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā, géē jé ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ um nwū ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ámāŋ ka n kɛlā mla ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī um.

eng_Latn: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ajɛ nɛ̄ aá í je lɛ ācɛ Ulífāyi ā mɛ́mla ajɛ o lúúlé kú aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā ā í wɛ ofɛpa ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ é le bū ipú Ugálīli. Ó dɔɔ̄kā kú ācɛ ɔhá dúú kéē jé ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā aá géē lɛ ɔdōlé nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá géē lé nōo géē jɛ̄ aá. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē cɛ̄tra ami nōo wɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nɛ̄ o yá ɔdā idáagó nyā lɛ aá ā. Uwēyī í gáā kwú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ámāŋ ka ɔdā dóódu í gbla um ŋ́ mā. Ami gē nya ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá á.

eng_Latn: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,
idu_Latn: N géē nya uwɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla o ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aílɔ́wá nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí uwā ā.

eng_Latn: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ ge plá ɔ̄cɛ fíyɛ́ ɔdā dóódu á. Ó bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi, ɔnyɛ géē jé ɔtū kú ɔ̄cɛ glá?.

eng_Latn: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
idu_Latn: Óndú kóō ma ihɔtū kú nū fú gā um ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ dóódu, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ijē nɛ̄ n géē gwó otú, ká n̄ kē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo cɛ̄ gā um yēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ kú Emím ɔ́ɔ tɛtɛ lā abɔ́ɔ á. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ klla lɛwa, lɔfú nɛ̄hi klla jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ayí kú Ánāki ā.

eng_Latn: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔdōlé olɔnyɛ, mɛ́mla igbō nōó yá ā ú kpó lɛ ɔyí nū, Ujékɔ̄pu á.

eng_Latn: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
idu_Latn: Ámōōmɛ ɛlā nyā wɛ, opīyatɔ̄há kú aá mla Óndú ā kóō lɔfú tū aá iyē ŋmá ipú ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da um kahíníi.

eng_Latn: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
idu_Latn: Aɔ́há ā wɛ, aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Uhalíhulu, Ubɛtísɔ, Ugédɔ.

eng_Latn: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhússāyi le ohi tá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā ŋ́. Óndú ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le uwɔ fu ká ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ ɛɛ́. Ɔcɛ́ dúúmā nēé kē fu ā, nɛ̄ n géē klá pī uwɔ ká n̄ cɛ̄ ɔ́ ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú nū le odúúdú agbénú kú nū kpó uwī le yɛ ɛɛ́. É kōō klla má ɔ̄ abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó bēé ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, Ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā le aílɔ́wá gwū ŋmá anú kéē híī lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
idu_Latn: Anyā kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá lɛ okónu ce gā um, ka aá í gáā junwalu lɛ alɔ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔnyɛ kú ihɔtū kú alɔ jé kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā kwú Ébrahām iyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka Íssmɛ̄lu wɛ ɔyí nū dúú.

eng_Latn: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé kɛlā ohígbū nū ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka, Ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá nōo gē gwíinu ā leyī gwū ɔ̄ tá ā, kwú pīya ɛcɔ̄ nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ ī nwū aá ɛ̄nyā ā, alɔ í bī ɛlā nɛ̄ íjééyī kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu gē nwū ā ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ gē bī ɛlā nɛ̄ Alelékwū ā ī nwū ā, abɔ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ gē ka ɛyí kú ɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ Alelékwū ā.

eng_Latn: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
idu_Latn: É kpó ācɛ éwɔhá ā yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ɔ́da lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
idu_Latn: N géē yá aá ōwē ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū tū aá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ aá gwó ɔcí. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā aá le jé ka ami, nɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ le cɔ̄nū mla aá.

eng_Latn: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi bī ákpá fōōfūnū kwú ɔkwu yɔ̄ ī jīijē lɛ Óndú ā mla odúúdú ɔfú kú nū.

eng_Latn: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, ohígbū ka ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n le fu kóō cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄, kóō yá ká aílɔ́wá, aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ iyē kú um jé.

eng_Latn: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le cīgbīhi wā Ɛnmísspāt gaá le ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri nēe lā Uhasasɔ̄n-táma ā yálé á.

eng_Latn: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú uwā le nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā ɛɛ́. Odúúdú uwá bɔ̄bí tɔ̄há, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ nōo yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
idu_Latn: N le ucē nēé gē yá ā má ɛɛ́, nááná n géē hɛ́ uwá tá kpɔ́. N géē bī uwá jé ɔwɛ, klla í tá uwā abɔ̄. N klla í tá ācɛ nēe yēekwu ā ɔtū lé.

eng_Latn: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɛpɔ̄hi kú ɔdā nōo yá um ā lé gbóó. Ohígbū ka n tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́. Amáŋ aá jāhɔ̄ gā um, ācɛ kú ɛga dóódu. Aá má um, ipú ɔnɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī jé ā. É le ayípōklóbīya mɛ́mla ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ um kpó kwú ga ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And them that are turned back from the LORD; and those that have not sought the LORD, nor enquired for him.
idu_Latn: N géē je ācɛ dóódu nēe kwúcē igbīhi nēé yɛce um gɛ ŋ́ mā kpó yíífi. Ācɛ nēé wā ɛgiyí um gaá da um ka n̄ bī uwā jé ɔwɛ ŋ́ mā géē kpó yíífi dúú.

eng_Latn: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu lɛ ācɛ ɔhá tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gāá lɛ Udéfīdi kwú wā. Eko nēé gā, nēé má ígwu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ bá ī mɛ́ɛbɛ, nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu kpó trɛ̄yí ā, alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō wā í klá ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Usɔ́lu ā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ukɔnílīyɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī ɛnɛ nēe gaá yɛ ā, ɛpléeko nyā, n yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ inu ɔlɛ́ um ɛplá oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú ɔ̄cɛ éyi nōo le otógwō nōo yɔ̄ Iceyīŋmáŋmá wiyē ā wā í háyi iyɔ̄bū um.

eng_Latn: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
idu_Latn: Uhábakūku kahíníī, N géē lɛ icō inɔ̄ɔda kú um ā tū, kú n̄ gbēyī cɛ́ɛ́, kú n̄ pó ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā ka gā um, mɛ́mla ohi, nɛ̄ ó gáā tá um ā.

eng_Latn: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá ka eko nēé lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā yá kwɛyí ā, é géē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí um. Amáŋ ó kwúcē wā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛɛka ɔnyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kē má odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā kpɛ́m.

eng_Latn: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
idu_Latn: Ń hī aá ka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ í gē jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpani nū gē yá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ n hī aá ka aɔ́ya, ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n pó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ádā um mā, n le ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī nū kpó ka lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place? and what hast thou here?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá abɔ́ɔ ā, é pó ɔkɔ kú ɔyípōklóbīya kú Ulífāyi éyi, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá ɛgiyí nū gāá le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē yá abɔ́ɔ āa? É ka ɔnyɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bī ɔ̄ wā abɔ́ɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Obadíya da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Íne nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ bīyíne ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē je ɔ́ tá abɔ̄ kú Áhābu kóō je ɔ́ ŋmó āa?.

eng_Latn: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nēé ī nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā, kóō lɛ odúúdú ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā kɔ̄ mla ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī nwū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka iháyí ofɛpa, nɛ̄ Óndú ā kpó aá bū ipú ígbíli ā. Īlī kú uwā ɔ́ gbɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ áblákpá kú uwā ɔ́ɔ ī lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō jé ɔdā nēé gē gbɛlá ā, ó kē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ohílīpú kú uwā wɛ ákú olíla lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɛga éyi. Eko nōó lɛ ɔkɔ ā gbā kwɛyí ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔyíkpó kú nū éyi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, nwū alɔ ɛlā nɛ̄ alɔ cíkā ō ka eko nɛ̄ alɔ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni nwū ayíkpó kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a le aíne kú uwɔ je lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́, a kē tíne ká ālɔ̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ka ka anúɔ yɔ̄ mla ɔlá ofíyajɛ ā, nááná nɛ̄ ó kē ī wɔ́tū ɔyínɛ́ nū kpɔ́, ɔ́ɔmā léka ó yɔ̄ ipú ajoodobū ā kpɔ́ɔ́kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
idu_Latn: Á ka anúɔ gēe tīcō ga ɛhícō bū ojuja aā ipú, cɛ́ɛ́ ka anúɔ lɛ īyī anúɔ yá bɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō, nōo nwuné klá lɛicō fíyɛ́ dúu a nɛ.

eng_Latn: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
idu_Latn: Ó gaá kwu ɛjī ɛhícō ɛgiyí ajɛ kú Ujúda, ó kē gaá kwu ɛjī ɛháajɛ ɛgiyí ajɛ nōo wɛ ákú Ubɛ́njamīn ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú ɔyí uwɔ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ékpónú, Áyísīki nōo he uwɔ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā ú, ká ā ga ajɛ kú Umórīya. Kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya oyi ɔlá dúúdú gā um ɛyí ɛfu nɛ̄ n géē mafú gā uwɔ āa.

eng_Latn: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, kɛlā lɛ ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Le ɔdā nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ gē ka ā ka lɛ aɛ́fu, kwu ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄hi, aáyɔ́kpá mɛ́mla aɔ́pɛ́ ipú íwɔ́tū nɛhi kú um, ohígbū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aéwɔhá cá uwā ɛcá klla je uwēyī lɛ uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka.

eng_Latn: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le héyī ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, é má kéē lɛ ede kú ojibó kú Ubáalu mɛ́mla ɔcí kú ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra ā wúlatāajɛ, é klla lɛ ɔbá ɛna ɔ́mpa ā gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ɛyí ede, ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nēé gwó kwu abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ úlā ofu ahātá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kpó kéē gaá kpó iyó kú úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wā. Ācɛ úlā ofigwó kéē nyɔ̄ gaá gbā ɛcɔ̄. Ó kē le ācɛ úlā ahāanɛ nēe géē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē má ka é lɛ úklɔ́ a yá piíí ā fu dúú.

eng_Latn: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ iháyí ofu ɛtá gɔbū. Ije kú nū géē wɛ īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ koó wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyā ije kú nū géē wɛ īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ igwó.

eng_Latn: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
idu_Latn: Ó gē kwú aólíla iyē ɔ́dāŋ ka é le ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔtū gē he Ɔwɔicō eko nɛ̄ ācɛ lɛ ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā yá.

eng_Latn: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kē í lɛ okónu cɛ̄ ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ ka Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā wɛ Óndú á, ɛ̄nyā géē yá kú ācɛ kéē wóófu Ɔwɔicō Ádā ā.

eng_Latn: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
idu_Latn: Aá nēe gē je epɔ̄ okpaakpa gbájí, klla gē pīya ācɛ tū ipú ɔdā nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwā ā géē je yíífi.

eng_Latn: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
idu_Latn: Ufi yá ācokpɛ́fú kú Utéman nɛ̄hi, é géē kpó ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɛ́dɔm ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Ugídīyɔn mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā gā ísu kú Ujɔ́dan, klla kwú bēhé nū ɛɛ́. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ uwā amáŋ é bá ī nū aólɛlā kú uwā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí hīgwú bɛ̄ɛka ɔkɔ kú ágábá nóō yɔ̄ ī tōoji ā á. Eko nōó lɛ igwú nyā hī ā, akpáabana cīgwú gbo igbo ahāapa mɛ́mla uya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
idu_Latn: Ń cíkā nēé gē hī um ka ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú awɔ gɛ ŋ́. Kwú um bɛ̄ɛka éyi kú ācɛ nēe gē yúklɔ́ ga awɔ ā.

eng_Latn: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɔ̄nyilɔ, ámāŋ ka ɔyí uwā nɔ̄nyā, ámāŋ ɔnyā uwā nōo he uwá ɔtū, ámāŋ oklóbīya nōo kwu uwá ajaajɛ, wā í tá uwá ɛkwūbá le da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ wā ká aá gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā, aɔ́wɔ nɛ̄ ádáádā uwā í gbā uwā jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kahíníī, Lɛ ohi tá ami mɛ́mla Ujonátan. Anɔ́ɔ ūlī le Ujonátan kwú á.

eng_Latn: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
idu_Latn: Aínɔɔ̄da mɛ́mla aágblɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ ā, ɔgwú mla odumú gēe ba í je ikwū ŋmá ipú nū wɛ̄ɛcɛ mɛɛ á. Ɛ̄cī kú Ubábīlɔn a ga ɛɛ́; ɛ̄cī kú nū le bá oomɛ ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn je ɛkpa kú īkpɔ̄dā úlā ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔgālā kú anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu ā, ulá ɛpa cofigwó le Uhíram iháyí dóódu kóō bī le je ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ipú ɔkpá nɛ̄ ó tá ā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ ā, ɔyí um, ihɔtū nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ o ŋmá lɛ opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā kóō lɛ ɔfú tū wɔ iyē.

eng_Latn: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.
idu_Latn: Ācogwíijē nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ásāfu nēe bá ɛga nɛ̄ Udéfīdi tū uwā ukɔ́ kéē bá ā wɛ, Ásāfu, Uhɛ́mān Ujɛdútɔn, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā. Ó cɛgbá kú ācɛ nēe gē gbō ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kéē bá ɛgiyí úklɔ́ kú uwā kpɔ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ Ulífāyi o hile ā bá ī yá ucɛ kú onyatá ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ásāfu ɛnɛ ā: Usáku, Ujósɛ̄fu, Unetánīya mɛ́mla Assarɛ́la. Ásāfu gē leyīkwu ígwu kú ācogwíjē nyā kéē wā í tɔ́ɔna kú ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō ipú ije ō gwó, eko dúúmā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā cɛgbá uwá kú úklɔ́ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Uríya ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ nū nyɔ̄ í lɛ owu túwāajɛ lígíi ɛɛ́. Uríya nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ ɔdā ɛhi éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔyípōklóbīya nōo bī ɔ̄kā nyā gē lɛ ɔ́ ā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ a ŋmá āa? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki, amáŋ n lā ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔnyā ōgbajā mɛ́mla ɔnyā ɔdāhá gē yá ā yɔ̄ á, ó nyɔ̄ í le ajā gbo, le iyē gwá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú híhó ka anúɔ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā mafú okómpinu nōo ga ɔ̄gɔ̄ olékwū nōo dobū nɛ̄hi ā ga uwɔ jéejéé ɛɛ́?.

eng_Latn: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
idu_Latn: Aá híīī mā ɔkɔ o yɔ̄ ī gbā tá ŋ́, aá kē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī ka lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, aá kē tá ɔ̄ ahínyá.

eng_Latn: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé kwú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā ú wī wā ajɛ ā, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn mɛ́mla Umerári nēe gē bī ɔ̄ ā, géē gbɔɔ́ kéē nyɔ̄ gbɔbū.

eng_Latn: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɔtū oōmá ɔtū kú ihɔtū le hókónu tū iyī aá. Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú aá nēe pīya tɔhā mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n ka ā, n géē yá ká aá lā amānyā nōo wɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā aá, kóō wɛ ákú uwā piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
idu_Latn: Ugɛ́dɔ, Ahíyo, Uséka.

eng_Latn: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
idu_Latn: Uhátūsi, Ussebaníya, Umálúci.

eng_Latn: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things.
idu_Latn: Ɛcí kú aéwɔhá ā í bī ɔwɔ gē lɛ alɔ glá ŋ́. Ɔkpáncō ɔlamu í yá ká ɔwɔ ká ō yá glá ŋ́. Alɔ leyī kpóce uwɔ ɛɛ́, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ. Ohígbū ka awɔ ya ɔdā nēe bá nyā á.

eng_Latn: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
idu_Latn: Unɛ́bɔ, Ubáali-mēyon, mɛ́mla Usíbma tú gwó igbɔhá. É kwú iyē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ í kpó ce aígelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄é kpó tú gwó nēe bá nyā a.

eng_Latn: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
idu_Latn: Aá bū okómpīinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū ā wā eyīpú, yɔ̄ ī tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá. Aá ga eyīpú kú agblīihɔ ā yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
idu_Latn: Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Ujúda ā, da ācogwíijē kú Ulífāyi ā kɛ́ɛ̄ gwííjē kɛ́ɛ̄ cɛ̄tla Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄, Udéfīdi, mɛ́mla Ásāfu ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔ tá tū ɔkpá lɛ ā. Odúúdú uwā le okwúukwu kpó kwaajɛ, anɔ́ɔ é bá gē gwííjē mla éeyē nɛ̄hi gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aódómgwɔ̄ɔwɛ nɛ̄hi nēé ī bū ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā le kpó fu tá ipú īmū, aígbɔ́cí nēé bī lɛ gwū ūwā ā kwú kpó cē nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. É le ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū ā kpó bɛ̄ɛka aólagbá kú ɛfú ga ajɛ éwɔhá ɛɛ́. Ācɛ nōo ī nwū íne ā í klla yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā i gē má ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ā bá í yɛ ipú uwā bilíbilí, bá gē trú uwá ikwū. É gē da uwá kéē híī yá ɔtūnōbí ɛ̄cī otīihɔ kú Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdɔ nɛ̄hi nōo licō nɛ̄hi. Ó lɛ okonɔɔwɛ igwɛ́ɛpa, nɛ̄ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa gē gbō uwā ā. É le iyē kú aípɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā éyééye tá tū aókónɔɔwɛ ā éyééye.

eng_Latn: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ nɛ̄ ayí nū ahāapa le pɛ́kwú ɛ̄cī ékpónú ā yɔ̄ ī hɛ́kwú ohígbū ikwū ō je ɛɛ́. Otú lɛ ɔ́ bī ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ. Uwēyī lɛ ɔ́ kwu ɛɛ́. Ācɛ ohile ká aá ā, n géē cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú aá je aá kpó ŋmó. Ami, Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔyī mɛ́mla ɔtā kú uwɔ̄ ú abālɔbányā, ká ā ga ipácí, gaá lɛ ɛbɛ́ ŋmó gé um.

eng_Latn: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ikpó da odúúdú aálagbá kú éwo éyi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī le gla ā, Ujísɔ̄si kwú Upíta mɛ́mla Ujémīsi mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni, ɔyínɛ́ Ujémisi ú, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá bī nyɔ̄ icō ɛfu nɛ̄hi ōfōofū uwā á.

eng_Latn: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú lā ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um. É ī kwāajɛ bá ī gbō ācɛ gɛɛ bɛ̄ɛka ofītɛ́ nōo ī kwāajɛ gbēyī ɛbɛ́ ā. É gē jē ukpa í kwú ācɛ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe ī jē ukpa tá ajɛ í le kwú aígbáanɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
idu_Latn: odúúdú ijē nɛ̄ aá ge gwó mla ɛ̄ngwū kú aá ā géē mɛ hímm.

eng_Latn: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
idu_Latn: Ábūdɔn wɛ ɔ́kplá kú nū á. Ayí nū ɔhá ā wɛ, Usúr, Ukíss, Ubáalu, Unɛ́ɛ, Unádābu.

eng_Latn: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ ó ka lɛ Umálakāyi, kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ācɛ ā nu bɛ̄cɛ ā, ó le aálelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kpóā fu kwāajɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ídɛn. Ó kwū ɔkpacāŋgelī ō cɔ̄lá nōo ī pīyeyī ga ɛga dóódu ā ú gbo ɔwɛ kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu ga ɛgiyí ɔcí nōo ī je oyēeyī opiyóó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
idu_Latn: Ubílha, Ɛ́sɛm, Utólādi.

eng_Latn: And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn le ojibó kú ɛcí kú Usúkōtu Ubɛnótu ma, ācɛ kú Ukútan, le ojibó kú ɛcí kú Unágali ma, ācɛ kú Uhámati ā kē le ojibó kú Assíma ma.

eng_Latn: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, abɔ̄ ɔgba kú unwalu ā gáā ce uwɔ abālɔbányā ɛɛ́ mā, ɔtū kú uwɔ kē kwú gbenyi ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwɔ iyē ā, abɔ̄ kē hɛ́ uwɔ iyē ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
idu_Latn: Ami Óndú ā géē da uwɔ, ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā yá ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ ń tū uwá ɛhɔ̄ ŋ́ nááná, nēé gē bī iyē kú um gē lɛ kɛlā, klla ī ka ka ɛfú mɛ́mla ɔkpɛtá ɔ́ɔ́ gáā wā í klá ajɛ ā gɛ ŋ́. N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔkpɛtā mɛ́mla ɛfú kpó uwā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwā wɛ úlā ofu ahātá ce úlā éyi .

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Óndú ā nōo yá aá ā á. Ami húmáyí tá aá abɔ̄ ŋmíīfī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ma aá ā. Aá yúúfi ŋ́, ayí Ujékɔ̄pu ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um. Aá nēe he um ɔtū nɛ̄ n fu ā.

eng_Latn: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe kwūce uwá ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛfrēm nɛ̄ Ɛlíssāma, ɔyí kú Ammíhūd géē leyīkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yíífi. Ka ɔ̄nyɛ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ nōo géē tá ūwā abɔ̄ glá āā?.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayí aá lɛ ɔ̄kā da aá ka, ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú ucɛ nyā a.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uféro le ɔtū kú nū yá lɔfú, nɛ̄ ó tá kóō cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́ mā. Óndú ā lɛ odúúdú aɔ́kplá kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kpó ŋmó, kwu ákú ācɛ mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē je ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú alɔ mɛ́mla ákú aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú alɔ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. Amáŋ alɔ gē hīla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú alɔ cīgbīhi.

eng_Latn: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́kpa ā piyɔkɔ́ ɛga ɛpa nēé géē je uwá kwɔhá glá gbā. Odúúdú ɔ́kpa ā wɛ ō piyɔkɔ́ ɛga ɛpa nyā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
idu_Latn: Anyā īkpɛ̄ɛnū gē tú wāajɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē ma ɔyí uwā wāajɛ á?.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nephthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
idu_Latn: É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa. É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáfutāli. É le ācɛ úlā ofucigwó fukɔ̄ údɔ̄bū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
idu_Latn: É bá ī tíne ō lā áklō kú ɔ́glɔ́ kú ɔkpá, mɛ́mla ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ipú ajɛ mɛ́mla ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄.

eng_Latn: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
idu_Latn: É yá Óndú cɔ̄nū ɛgiyí njɔlɔ kú Umɛ́rība, Ācɛ ā le Óndú yá cɔ̄nū abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ unwalu gaá ce Umósīsi ikpɛ̄yí ohígbū uwā á.

eng_Latn: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
idu_Latn: N da aá ɔ̄kā ka, ó lɛ kpaakpa kú ɔcɛ kóō pīya Ɔwɔicō tū nɛɛ? Nááná aá bá ī pīya um tū. Aá gē dɔɔ̄kā ka, ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ gē pīya uwɔ tū ā? Aá ī pīya um tū ipú ɛ̄gbā kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú aá, mɛ́mla ɛya nɛ̄ aá gē gwó ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, Usámsin kwú ihɔtū kú ɔnyā ɔhá nēé hī ka Udelíla ā ú. Ɔnyā ā lā ɔpɛ́ kú Usórēki.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
idu_Latn: Óndú ācɛ̄ la uwá lɛ ɛlā ogbájí nwū aá ɛɛ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Íjīpiti yɔ̄ ī yá a wɛ ɔdā obɔ̄bí, yɔ̄ ī ga ɔwɛ ga ácí bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔɔ kwú a.

eng_Latn: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā gē je ɔcí usɛ́da nɛ̄hi ā yíla ɛpa wā ajɛ, kwu ɛdɔ ɔcí usɛ́da dóódu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn.

eng_Latn: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ussímēyi kóō lɛ ɔlɛ́ gwó lɛ īyī nū ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm abɔ́ɔ. Ó klla da ɔ́ kóō lā ipú inu ā cɛ́ɛ́ kóō híī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
idu_Latn: Kóō mīyɛ odúúdú ɛhi kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú ɛya kú uwɔ kóō le he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu gaá le agada yá tū Ugolíyāti, le ɔkpacaŋgelī kú Ugolíyāti pi ŋmá ɔ̄ apɛ́, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó klla bī ɔkpacaŋgelī kú nū ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, le ɔ́ īkpɛ̄yí hɛ́. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya má ka ogbēnjūwā, olɔfú kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ gekwú ɛɛ́ mā, é le inya kwu le pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
idu_Latn: Aínyankwūlūmī kú uwā wɛ, úlā ce ofu ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄. Aíjakī wɛ úlā igwáhāpa ce ofigwɛ́ɛhīlī.

eng_Latn: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ da uwá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í yá piíí kéē lɛ ɛka nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gbo mla uwá ā tū ā. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne igwó nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tá tū iseléti ā piíí.

eng_Latn: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
idu_Latn: Adáya, ɔyí kú Ujéhōram, nɛ̄ aádáádā nū wɛ Upásshɔ, Umálkíja, Umaási, Adiyélu, Ujásɛ̄ra, Uméssūlam, Umessílemiti mɛ́mla Ímma ā.

eng_Latn: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
idu_Latn: Usímīyɔn mīyɛ ɔyí obene ā bɔ́tū anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō á, kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā Ébrahām le hīla ókplícī nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́, Ɔwɔicō kē le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́ ipú ɔdā dóódu nōó yá ā.

eng_Latn: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ géē lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka īkpō úmlá kú ipú ɛcɛ ā. É géē nyīla ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄, ɛhícō mɛ́mla ɛháajɛ. Oŋmá ɛgiyí ayááyí kú uwɔ ā nēé géē hɔ́hā ce odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujɛhówāsi yá ā, kwu ɔtú ōlɛ kú nū ɔgbɛ́fú ā, é le uwá tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ɔ̄kā kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Óndú um ka, Cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú um jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ kpóbá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ā gē lɛ ojīlīmā akpókónu cē um, amáŋ ɔtū kú uwā le ligbó ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: N géē tá uwɔ ahínyá ɛ̄cī dóódu. N géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ piyóó.

eng_Latn: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
idu_Latn: kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ó géē jɛ̄, í kwu ābɔ̄, klla í gwá īkpō. Ó klla í nwuné nɛ̄hi. Ɛdɔ aígbáanɔ dóódu géē wā í mulɛ́nyɔ̄ abɔ̄ nū, klla gwó ɔlɛ́ ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu má háyicō iyɔ̄bū aígabɔ̄ kú igelī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ācɛ Átɛnsi, n má kóō he aá ɔtū nɛ̄hi kú aá gbā aɔ́wɔ alɛwa ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ odúúdú iyó nɛ̄ aólɛlā kpó ā á. Ó klla mīyɛ Ulɔ́tu, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla iyó kú nū, mɛ́mla ācɛnyā ā mɛ́mla ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí nōo yɔ̄ ī jɛ́ ɛyí inu ɛga nɛ̄ ajɛ í cɔkpɛ́nú nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ tá ɛgba lɛ ipú gaajɛ ŋ́ mā, nōo gē jē ŋmɔ́ɔlá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ō í jɛ̄ ga ɛga dúúmā ā.

eng_Latn: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ācoyɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu um ɛɛ́, Ígwu kú ācobɔ̄bíipú nēé je uwɔ ka a wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā, bá ī tíne kéē ŋmó um.

eng_Latn: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ipú ukpɛ̄ nōo wɛ ákú ācɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, géē je éyi ŋmá ipú ofɛpa ce igwó dóódu kú ācɛ, ɛna, ijakī, álá mɛ́mla ɛwū ā lɛ Óndú ā, aá kwú ɔ́ɔmā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi, nēe gē leyīkwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí gbōō káā bɛba ká ā jɛ́yí kú odée.

eng_Latn: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú nōo he um ɔtū ā nɛ̄ n í je á. Ɔ́ɔmā jɔ̄ɔ́ncɛ́nyā bɛ̄ɛka okóhō ā. Anú ōfōōfūnū wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū á. Anú kē wɛ ɔyí oōcɛ̄ kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū á. Odúúdú ācɛnyā kpéyī klá anú klla ī cɛ̄tra anú Ānyā ɔlɛ́ um ā mɛ́mla aɔ́diyɔ̄ ā, gē gwííjē cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ aíne lɛyíkwu ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú, ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā, ɛya kú ejé, mɛ́mla ɛya nēé ī gwó ohígbū ɛbɔ́ ā lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aá, eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ā gā ā. Aɛ́nyā gáā kwɛyí ɛya kóō yá jīla kú okónu ō ce ámāŋ ka ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ kú aá á.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu da ayínɛ́ nū kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ujósɛ̄fu á. Ádā um yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ̄? Amáŋ abɔ̄ ayínɛ́ nū le ɛlā ā pó ā, ó le hɛ́ uwā ohí nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ka ɔdā dúú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó cɛgbá kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō da uwá ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é bī ije ā le yúklɔ́ lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kóō he aá kú aá wɛ ákú nū. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē gbā Óndú ā kéē gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
idu_Latn: Ó le odúúdú ācɛ nēe pi ɔkpacaŋgelī wu abɔ̄ ā kpó kwāajɛ iyɔ̄bū Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbō ɔcɛ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā lɛ ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ofíyajɛ kú nū ā mafú. Odúúdú ācɛ ā kē ī má ɔ̄ tɔ̄há. Óndú ā bī okónu abɔ̄yī nū le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le da uwá kahíníī, É géē yá ká ami, nōo wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ kóō móowē nɛ̄hi piíí. Anyākwɔ́cɛ, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, mɛ́mla aútíca kú íne ā géē tá um tónū. Ācɛ géē je ami nōo wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmó. Amáŋ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá Ɔwɔicō géē je um héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
idu_Latn: jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔ́ ga ɔkpáncō. Gbɔbū kóō nyɔ̄ ā, ó bī ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ nōó fu keé wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n̄ yá aá kú aá lɛ jé koó wɛ opiíí ka odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpó aá yíífi ā, é géē kpó uwā yíífi dúú. É géē kpó odúúdú aólɛlā kú aá kwú ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ aéwɔhá. É kē í yá ācɛ nēe yá aá ōwē ā, ōwē piíí. É kē í wu ɔlɛ́ kú odúúdú ācɛ nēe kpó ɔlɛ́ kú aá wu ā piíí.

eng_Latn: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.
idu_Latn: É lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn úlā ofɛpa cɛhɔ̄ kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ Usíba hīīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka anúɔ géē kpó ɛjɛ̄ɛ́jī ɔdā dóódu nēe wɛ ákú Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ákú ipɔ́ɔnū kú nū ā lɛ Umefíbōssɛ̄ti, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú ɔkpani nū.

eng_Latn: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n gáā tū ɔcí ā ɛyí ga únóji ā, odúúdú aéwo ā géē jīliyē. Odúúdú aɔ́cí kú Éden, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcí ɔhá kú Ulɛ́bānɔn, nēé géē kpó éŋkpɔ̄ tū uwā ɔkwu lɔɔlɔhi ā, nēe le pɛ́ gekwú ɛ́ɛ́ mā géē gwéeyē ipú únóji ohígbū oōhɛ́ wāajɛ gwōnū kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
idu_Latn: Uhananíya ma ayí ɛpa. É wɛ Upelatíya mɛ́mla Ujɛssáya. Ujɛssáya ma Urefáya, nōo ma Ánan, nōo ma obadíya, nōo ma Ussekánīya ā.

eng_Latn: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he um nɛ̄hi, eko nēé da um kahíníī, Wā ká ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
idu_Latn: Aá ka lɛ odúúdú aéwo kahíníī, Óndú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́. Ó kwú ɛcɛ ú kwu ajɛ, nɛ̄ ó gáā tōō fu glá ŋ́. Ó géē kɛ́pɔ̄ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ.

eng_Latn: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi kwú íne ā ú kwaajɛ. É kē yɔ̄ ī lɛ íne ā tū ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ otú le bī nɛ̄ eyī le nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛ̄hɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē tókónu lɛ uwá ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ kwú eyī pīya ŋmá aíne kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ jé jééjéē ŋ́ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdā nēé tíne ā je lɛ uwá, Amáŋ ó lɛ ōcē tū klá uwá.

eng_Latn: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
idu_Latn: Ami mɛ́mla awɔ wɛ ɔdā ékpónú ipéyī Ɔwɔicō. Ó yá um ŋmá ɔmɛ bɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ayí nū mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, ohígbū oyábīya kú ádā uwá, ohígbū nɛ̄ uwá klá ī cāŋjɛ klá í nyīla igbɔhá klá ɛcɛ mla ɔ́bíipú kú aádáádā uwá a.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Uharáda gaá lā Umakélɔ̄tu.

eng_Latn: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ ede gwó abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē í ce abɔ́ɔ ka Óndú ā wɛ otúta kú um á.

eng_Latn: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.
idu_Latn: Émɔ̄si ka ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ mafú lɛ anúɔ ā yɔ̄ á. Ó kahíníī, N má abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī tútū kóō tū aɔ́wá kú aéfūma ɛhɔ̄ klá ajɛ ā. Ɛ̄nyā igbīhi kú eko nēé le ukpɛ̄ kú ácí kú aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kpó hɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ kwɛyí, nɛ̄ ácí ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō lū ŋmá ajɛ kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, Ó ka anúɔ géē je Ísrɛ̄lu yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛha ī bíya odée ā. Ka anúɔ klla í je ācɛ kú Ujúda ā yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcí ī je gbokwu ā.

eng_Latn: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
idu_Latn: Ká Ɔwɔicō kóō nyā aá tá bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpú ō kwɛyí ā. Aá mīyɛ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā ŋmá abɔ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ.

eng_Latn: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
idu_Latn: Ucē nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā gē yá ā, he Óndú ā ɔtū, ó klla í gbō uwā ɛyí, amáŋ ucē kú ācobɔ́bíipú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwā kpó gbliífi.

eng_Latn: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
idu_Latn: É gā ɛgiyí nū, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ágábáidu, Ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu! Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ akwū tū ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: The ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mahāanɛ wɛ Ujéssūwa, ɔ́migwó wɛ Ussékanīya.

eng_Latn: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí nōo gē ŋmó gbɔbū lɛ eko kú nū nōó klla ī pīya ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ ɔhá gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ gáā nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla aá ŋ́. Kóō wɛ ɔdā dúú tū olɛlā kú aá ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ohile kú aá le igbihi pīya kwú pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ámāŋ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ kōō lɛ o kɔ̄ ɛga ɛpa kú aá kpó ŋmó nááná. Amáŋ oyēeyī kú nū ɔ́ɔ fíyɛ́ ācɛ úlā ofu cɛhɔ̄ kú aá. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ géē lɔhi fíyɛ́ kú ɔ́ɔ̄ klá ipú igelī, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ́ɔ̄ tū ɔdā nōo í tá aá abɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ gé lɛ aá ɔgbɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nāa yá ā gē lēyīce uwɔ klla gbolóce uwɔ ká ā je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá, eko nɛ̄ ɛgbá nū ce uwá ā.

eng_Latn: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ɛlā kpóce ɔ́mpa nū ka ɔ́ɔ yá anúɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ bī wā ɛgiyí ede kú uwɔ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔkpá gbo ka anúɔ í jé ikpɔ́ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú eko nōó le pīya iháyí úlā ce ofigwáahātá ce igwáahāapa āa.

eng_Latn: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄yī aá, aá tɛtɛ yɔ̄ ipú ajodobū, amáŋ abālɔbányā nɛ̄ aá le pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ɛ́ɛ́ mā, aá le pīya ācɛ kú ɔlá ofíyajɛ ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá géē yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú ɔlá ofíyajɛ ā piíí.

eng_Latn: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:
idu_Latn: Ó kwu ɔ̄cɛ éyi ú ŋmá ipɔ́ɔnū ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́, lɛ okónu ce mla anú klla yá ɔ̄ ká ō lɛ ɔkpá gwá ka anúɔ í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́. Ó kwú odúúdú ācɛ ocɛgbá ā ú kpó ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó le hɛ́ uwā idáagó. Anɔ́ɔ é habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the LORD,
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujosíya yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tā ajɛ lɛ Óndú ā mla íne kú nū.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kú aá híīī gbagbafú ohígbū ōwē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē má ohígbū aá ā ŋ́. Odúúdú nū wɛ ohígbū olɔhi kú aá nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē kwú aójibó kú uwā í kpó yɔlá ŋmáajɛ dúúdú. Ó klla da uwá kéē híī héyīfuúfuú kú ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ugóolu kú uwā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē je ɔdā dúú kú uwā ŋ́, ohígbū nōó géē pīya ukpa lɛ uwá. Ohígbū koó wɛ ɔdēelihɔ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔlá ofíyajɛ, nōo géē nya aílɔ́wá tá ā gé lɛ uwá. Ó kē géē bī ojīlīma gé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá kwú ɔtū kpoókpoó mɛ́mla unwalu ú ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú unwalu ú tonū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá, ohígbū ka eko ɔyípōklóbīya mɛ́mla ɔ́ncɛ́nyā wɛ áncā nɛ.

eng_Latn: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē tū ōcē obɔ̄bí klá uwɔ, géē yá kéē ŋmá ācɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛhi ɛbɛɛbɛ klá aúláyi kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. É géē kpɛ́fú tá uwɔ ŋmá āyā dóódu, klla í ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ a le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú, nōo ī yá ucē okpaakpa ā, le agbá kú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā hɛ́ he alɔ tá, klla le alɔ nyatá.

eng_Latn: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛɛcɛ kú aá kē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jé áá má ŋ́. Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, odo le tútū, amáŋ ɔkpíyē ā le gbagbafú.

eng_Latn: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ucē kú Ɛ́ri í lɔhi ɛgiyí Óndú ā ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ Óndú á le ɔ́ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́wá kú efūma nēe gē hɛ́ odée lé ŋmá ajɛ habɔ̄ tá ā, ɔ́wá kú efūma ɔhá nēe ī wu nēe gboce uwá ā, kwú kpó lé ŋmá ajɛ. Ɔdā nɛ̄ efūma o tá ómbili habɔ̄ tá ā, efūma kú ífi kwú kpó lé.

eng_Latn: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
idu_Latn: N gē ba Ɔwɔicō kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá,nōo wɛ Ádā nēé ī cɛ̄tra anú ā kóō lɛ alelékwū nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ aá jééyī ipú aɔ́dā kú Ɔwɔicō, nōo géē yá kú aá lɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wɛ abāābɔ̄yī nū ā jé ā je lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō le bū ujē mɛ́mla ɛpɛ̄, ó tīile dúúmā ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō lɔfú tokónu lɛ ɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ ɔlá kóō kwú ɔ̄ í yi tāajɛ glá.

eng_Latn: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:
idu_Latn: Umanásɛ wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛpa ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á, ó gbō ācɛ kú Ujúda ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
idu_Latn: Aá yɛ í háyi ɔnyɛ̄ɛpa ɔwɛ kú aá kwu ācɛ nēe bá ī kwu ā ŋ́. Aá yɛ í kpó ācɛ nēe hile ā lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā ipú ɛ̄cī kú ɔtūnōbí kú uwā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ ā yá ā í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō glá gɛ ŋ́. Ó ka ɛcí nēé gē pā le jé ūwā iyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nēé habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá glá ŋ́, ka ó cɛ̄ lɛ uwá jé ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē kpó uwā fíyákátā gaá lā ipú aéwɔhá. Ó da uwá ka ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā hile ŋmá ipú uwā ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛwa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, o he um ɔtū, aá blla kwu ɛnyā, odúúdú aá kéē jāhɔ̄ kéē pó ɛlā fíyaa, amáŋ aá ŋmúléyīkwū kɛlā fíyaa ŋ́. Aá kóō híī cɔ̄ɔ̄nū fíyaa ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
idu_Latn: Iní nɛ̄ n géē má ɛbɛ́ ŋmá nōo géē jila odúúdu ɛwa nyā glá ā? Ohígbū keé bá ī jikwū tū um eko dóódu kahíníī, Je ɛbɛ́ lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ lé.

eng_Latn: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwū ɔkpá kú Okónu ōce ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ jé tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ ā kéē pó á. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, Alɔ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú, alɔ klla í yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛlā nɛ̄ó da alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó wɛ ɔdā nōo he Ádā um nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā ɔtū kú éyi kú ayí nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe bá ā kóō le yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nēé lɔtūce ɔ́ ɛgiyí ɔdā olígíi glá ā, é géē lɔtūce ɔ́ ɛgiyí ɔdā nɛ̄hi glá. Ɔ̄cɛ nēé lɔtūce ɔ́ ɛgiyí ɔdā olígíi glá ŋ́ mā, é gáā lɔtūce ɔ́ ɛgiyí ɔdā nɛ̄hi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ō tá áncā ohígbū ahi, í cɛ̄ lɛ ɛhá gē kwú ɔ̄cɛ. Amáŋ o cēyītīkwū yúklɔ́ lɔfú gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ agbénú.

eng_Latn: And again the word of the LORD came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ̄cī ofu ce ɛnɛ kú ɔyā ahāanɛ ā, Óndú ā le Uhágāyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ igbɔhá fu Userúbábɛ̄lu, igbómína kú Ujúda ā ka.

eng_Latn: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si le ācɛ alɛwa hɛ́tá ŋmá ɛdɔ ōcē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú uwā, ó nū aálelékwū obɔ̄bí ŋmá iyē kú ācɛ, ó klla lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ikpēyī kú uwā pu ā eyī kpó nwūla.
