eng_Latn: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī aéwɔhá lɛ gbō inu olɔfú ɛgotayínū kú nū ā. Ó géē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ācɛ dúúmā nēe mīyɛ anú ká anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā á. Ó géē kpó uwā ce āhɔ̄ onwuné nɛ̄hi, klla í je ajɛ cíla uwá ulé.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ugídīyɔn ka ācɛ ā ɛ́ɛ le ɛwa kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Kóō lɛ uwá kpó nyɔ̄ ɔkpá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ uwá kɔ̄ hī ɔhá tá lɛ ɔ́ abɔ́ɔ. Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ lɛ da ɔ́ ka, ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā géē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú á, anú géē nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla anú á. Ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā nyɔ̄ ŋ́, ó gáā nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
idu_Latn: Unóha mɛ́mla Uráfa.

eng_Latn: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;
idu_Latn: Ó klla le jé ka Ujékɔ̄pu lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ádā nū mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá Umɛsopotámīya á.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔfú tū alɔ iyē igbɔhá kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ, nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā kú ālɔ̄ cɛ̄tra awɔ.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alɔ kahíníī, Alɔ nyɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ gáā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā ipú nū, iyɔ̄bū ede kú nū.

eng_Latn: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi ā, kóō kwúcē ŋmá ucē ɔ́bíipú kú nū ɔ́ɔmā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōó gē yá ucē okpaakpa ŋ́ mā, kóō kwúcē ŋmá ɛlá icííci nōó gē gbo ɔ́ɔmā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā. Ó kē í méyīnyinyi uwā klla í je ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yá ā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi fíyaa.

eng_Latn: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyínɛ́ nū nōo gboce ɔ́ ā kwú ɔnyā nū ú ɔnyōkwū á, ó klla gekwú í ma ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́. Ɔdā ékpéékpó ā yá ɔyínɛ́ ɔ́mɛtá ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ íne kú uwɔ he uwá ɔtū ā lɛ ɛbɔ́ nɛ̄hi, ɔdā dúúmā í gáā yá uwá kéē gwōnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū alɔ gbɔɔ́ kóō nyɔ̄ ajɛ Usísarīya. Alɔ yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ Ufílīpu otɔ́ɔna kú okōolɔhi, nōo kē wɛ éyi kú ipú ācɛ ahāapa nēe fu kéē kɔ̄ ɔdōlé ā nyɔ̄ í le gbɔga.

eng_Latn: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ācɛ kú Umówābu yálé. Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɔ́ gā ipú ajɛ kú uwā iháyí ofɛnɛ á.

eng_Latn: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kū nū ā kahíníī, Aá gbɔbū gā um, ká n̄ tá aá igbīhi. Amáŋ ó ka ɔdā dúúmā lɛ ɔbá nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aídengéli kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ nēe wā abɔ́ɔ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Aá bī ɔkpacaŋgelī mɛ́mla ogló wā gaá kwú um bɔ̄ɔdā nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ohéjulúgwu ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē nwū ayí uwā aíne ā lɔɔlɔhi. Ó klla da uwá kéē ka aíne ā tɛ́ɛ́cɛ lɛ ācɛ eko nēé bá ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla eko nēé yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɔwɛ, mɛ́mla eko nēé gwutá yɔ̄ ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ mɛ́mla eko nēé yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
idu_Latn: Ini nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú uwɔ ɛ́nēe gē da uwɔ ka, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn í gáā kpɛ́fú tá uwɔ ámāŋ́ ajɛ nyā ŋ́ mā bá āa?.

eng_Latn: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā n leyīce ka Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yīnū géē je ami abɔ̄yī um héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō mīyɛ Ébrahām wā ɛgiyí nū eko nōó hɛ́ apī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cotɔ́sú dúúmā í gáā yēeyī nōo géē kwúcē ga ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ́sú cē ɔ̄ tū ɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū mla odúúdú ācɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā í gáā hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, which stand there before the LORD.
idu_Latn: gáā yúklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū ā abɔ́ɔ, bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ohile ā glá.

eng_Latn: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
idu_Latn: Ó géē he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi ká n̄ kwú iyī um mɛ́mla odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n lɛ ā ī ŋmó tū aá. Ɔdí í yá nɛ̄ ń he aá ɔtū nwuné ŋ́ nááná nɛ̄ aá kē he um ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́ɛ̄?.

eng_Latn: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N géē je odúúdú obɔ̄bí nāa yá ā, yá uwɔ ɛhi, amáŋ a géē yɔ̄ ī blakwu ɔɔ́, nɛ̄ uwēyī í gáā cɛ ga uwɔ nwūla okónu ka ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Óndú a nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tíne íjééyī ipú ɔtū kú um ā, n ka ejé nɛ̄ n géē gwá ga ɛ̄jīla kú olíla á, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ um ɔtū yá yēŋēē. Nááná nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī gbɛla kwu ɔwɛ kú ijééyī kpɔ́ ā. N tíne ō le má ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ kéē yá ipú oyēeyī kpií kú ūwā ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
idu_Latn: Umósīsi gā ŋmá ajɛ kú Umówābu, le tá ɛyí ɛfú kú Unébo, gā ikpɛ̄yí ɛfu kú Upísga, nē o leyīkwu Ujérīko ā. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɛ ā mafú lɛ ɔ́. O gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ugílííd jāā gaá kwu Udáni.

eng_Latn: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n jé ka aá cɛ̄ kú aá tábɔ̄, n kē lɛ aá bī gwō tá ācɛ o cɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō kú Umasɛdónīya dúú ɛɛ́. N da uwá ka aá, ayínɛ́ kú Akáya húmáyī tútū kéē tábɔ̄ ŋmífī ɛyílánū. Ɔtūcaca kú aá tábɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɛyínɛ̄hi uwā ɔtū tū kwu.

eng_Latn: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī omlede ámāŋ opī nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, gé lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kú íne nōó bīya ā. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú íne nōó jégēdē ŋ́ bīya ā ú yá ɔ̄ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
idu_Latn: É géē yɔ̄ ī pi ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛgwā ā É géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú uwā, yɔ̄ ī yúufi klla yɔ̄ ī fīyégbúlú. É géē pīyeyí ipú ufi wā ɛga Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jíla ɔ́ iyē kú ɛya o jíliyē lɛ Óndú ā, é kē wɛ ɔdā o tīihɔ lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, uwá mɛ́mla amɛ̄ mɛ́mla átákwū nɛ̄ íne tɛtɛ kóō wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā aā, ɔ̄cɛ ígwu kú átámɔ̄kpá kú Óndú ā géē lɔfú gwá ejé glá mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
idu_Latn: Ó kē le kwɔ́ɔ iyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ nōó yá wā ipú ɛcɛ ā. Íjémā le mu ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
idu_Latn: N gē da aá ɛ̄nyā, ayínɛ́ um, ohígbū ka eko ámōōmɛ ā ī wā fíyaa. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔbá ámāŋ ka ɔnyā, kéē bá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé lɛ ɔnyā ámāŋ ka ɔbá ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā nū bī ā. Ó klla pā ɛcí nɛ̄ ádā nū lɛ, klla gē pā ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu lɔfú lɛ tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā, é kwú ācɛ Ukénan ú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwā. Amáŋ Ísrɛ̄lu í nū uwā bɛ̄cɛ dúúdú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ohilí nū kahíníī, N géē yá ɛ̄nyā piíí, ohígbū ka ācɛ ā gē wā ɛgiyí um, gáā jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī ɔtū lɛyíkwu uwá ā.

eng_Latn: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔlékwū, n kē yēeyī ícɛ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: É géē wɛ ocíbú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi, nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó, mla ɔgbanjɛ éyi nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛtá ce igwó. Ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú uwā géē wɛ oōmu mla anɔ̄ kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā.

eng_Latn: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.
idu_Latn: Ubówāsi da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ gbō uwā, ká ɔ̄ má ɛga nēé géē bá ī cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ klá mla uwá. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka anúɔ le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ́ anúɔ kéē híī je unwalu lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Eko dóódu nɛ̄ ijēnyi ɔ́ɔ gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ́, ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ gaá gwá éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá ipú ɔjá nēé hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n kwú Íjīpiti ú yɔɔlá, klla kwú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja nēe ī cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ uwá ā ú kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ é le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n géē hápápá lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ um í lɛ ɛyí wu ā pīyɛ lɛ iyī um ŋmá ipú ofúlutu mɛ́mla owu nɛ̄hi nyā.

eng_Latn: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
idu_Latn: É le ije je lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ufi tū um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ íne bīya, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē lɛ um iyē bīya, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla í lɛ okónu kwu um iyē.

eng_Latn: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ géē lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ. N géē lɛ ɛlá kwu íne kú uwɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄, Ɔwɔicō, géē cālɛ́ ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú aá, ó í je pīya alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo nwuné ipú aá fíyɛ́ dúú ā, géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o cɛ̄ aá ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā, ó gáā nyíla okónu nɛ̄ ó ce ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó géē yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ce okónu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, eko nāa hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tá, nāa gbɔbū lɛ uwá ipú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
idu_Latn: Ɛcí nēé gē pā ā gē cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā kóō yɔ́bɔ́nyā. Ɔdōōbɔ̄bí nēé gē yá ā, gē yá Óndú ā cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
idu_Latn: Éŋkpɔ̄ ā le yɛ um jīla klla kwú um mlɛ, ísu ā kē má klá um dúúdú, ácí enyi ā kē le jíla tū um ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da aígabɔ̄ kú nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ alɔ í yá ɔdā dúúmā ka ālɔ̄ mīyɛ Urámɔtu nōo yɔ̄ ipú Ugílɛ̄di ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ŋ́ mā? Ó kē wɛ ákú alɔ.

eng_Latn: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, ó le cāā ka Óndú alɔ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda, Umósīsi í kē ka ɔdā dúúmā ohígbū ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpɛtá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́fú lɛ alɔ kwú ɛɛ́. Iyē kú alɔ le hɔ́lá gbáyíí bɛ̄ɛka útuló ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
idu_Latn: Aá le fíyɛ́ ācɛ ɔhá dóódu ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā. Ipú ɔtōōce Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ipú ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi nɛ̄ aá ī tá ā, ipú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá jé lɛyíkwu ɛlā ɔkwɛyi ā, ipú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē cɛ̄ kú aá tábɔ̄ lɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē yíhɔtū tá alɔ lɛ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ tíne kú aá le fíyɛ́ ācɛ ɔhá dúú ipú úklɔ́ ihɔtū kú oōje lɛ ācɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā gwutá klá ɔyí ā, kwú okónu, īkpēyī, mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kú nū ú klá ákú ɔyí ā. Abɔ̄ ó gwutá klá ɔyí ā, iyē kú ɔyí gbɔɔ́ ō kwɔ́lá.

eng_Latn: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n jɛ́yí odée nwuné bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé ā dúú. Ń nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ aá ɔwɛ dóódu ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu jé ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ka nyā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔyí ijakī ā bī gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si á. Anɔ́ɔ é le úwé kú uwā plla ce ɛyí ɔyí ijakī, anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ujísɔ̄si í ce ɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū kú Óndú ā le tá ipú iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā nōo lé ka Amásāyí, nōo je pīya aótrɛ̄yí kú Aícɔ́ɔja olɔtū ofu cigwó ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛgba dɛ kahíníī, Udéfīdi, ɔyí kú Ujése, alɔ wɛ ákú uwɔ nɛ! Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla awɔ, ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ dóódu nēe gē tá uwɔ abɔ̄ ā. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ mla uwɔ klla ī tá uwɔ abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi lɛ uwá būla klla kwú uwá ú kpó tū aícɔ́ɔja kú nū ā ipú á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujɛ́ta wɛ, Ujefúne, Upíspa mɛ́mla Ára.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla íne kú Ɔwɔicō bīya bɛ̄ɛka aéwo nɛ̄ Óndú ā nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.
idu_Latn: ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ka ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nyɔ̄ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔdájī mɛ́mla óbō kú uwɔ pīya kwu ācɛ nēe gē nū um inya ā. Ká ā da um ka awɔ, Óndú ā géē hɛ́ um tá.

eng_Latn: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
idu_Latn: Ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ lɛ oyēeyī kú alɔ hɛ́ kpií, ó gebí tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka owu ohīlatá ā.

eng_Latn: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla ka kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ iháyí ofɛpa le yá le yɛ ā, n géē kpó ācɛ kú Íjīpiti wā ɔlɛ́ uwā ŋmá ipú éwo dóódu nɛ̄ n pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpani nū tíne kóō yá, amáŋ nōó tū iyī nū tū ō yá ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ mā, é géē gɔ́ ɔ̄ itali nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi igbalɛwa.

eng_Latn: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ aládi odunkulu ahāapa gbaáluka ŋmá ɛ̄cī nōo gboce usábáti nɛ̄ aá bī ɛ̄wɛ̄ kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ aflɛ́yí kú aá gé lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō hī ɛga nōo ŋmó ā ka ajɛ áncā. Ó kē hī ɛga nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ pɛ́ tū ā ka ísu. Ɔwɔicō le má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.
idu_Latn: Ó klla yɔ̄ gē kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá híī je mlanyī okónu nɛ̄ ami mla aá ce nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā lɛ ɔ́ jila, nɛ̄ abɔ́ɔ kwú cá ɛɛ́, ó géē je abɔ́ɔ híla ŋmá īlī ā ámāŋ ka ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
idu_Latn: É lā kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ajaajɛ, ohígbū koó wɛ úklɔ́ kú uwā kéē gbō okómpīinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla nwūla anú tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
idu_Latn: Aéwo géē wā gaá kwū ɔlá ofíyajɛ kú aá ā, aɔ́cɛ́ kē í wā gaá má ɔdā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nōo yɔ̄ gē yá Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ aéwo ɔ́ɔmā géē wā í ka ka, Aá wā kú ālɔ̄ ga ɛyí ɛfu kú Óndú ā, ká ālɔ̄ ga Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu cɛ́ɛ́ kóō nwū alɔ ɔwɛ kú nū, ká ālɔ̄ yɛ ɔwɛ kú nū. Ohígbū ka aá kē jé ka o ŋmá Usáyɔn nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā je íne lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ujérúsālɛm nōó gē kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋmá á.

eng_Latn: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um nyatá ŋmá ɛcá nɛ̄ n yúufi nū ā, ohígbū ka ɛpɔ̄ ō hɛ́ kú uwɔ lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
idu_Latn: Udána, Ukīrīyati Udébiri.

eng_Latn: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɛ̄cī ahāapa ā yá jīla ā, ācɛ Ujíyu nēe ŋmá Ésiya ā le Upɔ́lu má ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É le útú hɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ odúúdú ɛwa lɛyíkwu Upɔ́lu, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ésa wɛ, Ubílhan, Usaafán mɛ́mla Ujaákam. Ayí kú Udíssan wɛ Úsu mɛ́mla Áran.

eng_Latn: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le ayínɛ́ nū ɛhɔ̄ kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɛgiyí Uféro á. Ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ádā um mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um mɛ́mla aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú uwā mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā gā ɛgiyí um ŋmá Ukénan ɛɛ́. É bá Ugóssɛn abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
idu_Latn: É tíne kéē je ejé nēé lɛ ɛcí nēé hi ka Umɛ́ɛ ā tū ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kóō gwá abɔ́ɔ, amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tá ō gwá ejé ā.

eng_Latn: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe háyi pī ɔ̄ ā kahíníī, A gē ka atufú lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya kú Ɔwɔicō nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā í gē lɛ itene dúúmā ŋmá ɔ́bíipú kú nū ā ŋ́, amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa yá, ó géē miyɛ ulé nū.

eng_Latn: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, alɔ yɔ̄ ī lɛyítáajɛ ga awɔ klla leyī kpóce uwɔ. Óndú, ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ tíne ofōōfūnū ā wɛ owóofu kú iyē uwɔ.

eng_Latn: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, é géē da ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Aá híī yúufi ŋ́, igelī kú Usáyɔn. Aá híī cɛ̄ lɛ abɔ̄ hɛ́ aá iyē gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ikɔɔkɔ nōó í klá Unásārēt ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lā ajɛ kú Ukapánɔm, nōo yɔ̄ okónu ísu, ipú ajɛ kú Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Unáfutāli āa.

eng_Latn: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ígwu ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa nēe bā í gwííjē, bā i gwó ɔdā, klla bá ī tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ā, gaá le jīla ɛgiyí Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ami mɛ́mla ígwu kú anyākwɔ́cɛ nēe bá mla am ā.

eng_Latn: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a le ɔlá ofíyajɛ je gā um. Anɔ́ɔ a le obū kú um nū nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.
idu_Latn: Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si le ɛ̄cī ahātá ámāŋ ka ɛ̄cī igwó yá Ujerúsālɛm mla uwá, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē wā Usísarīya á. Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ó gaá cīce úgādā ɔcɛ́ kóō hɛ́pɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ Upɔ́lu bī wā.

eng_Latn: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó ce ɔcɛ́ ā, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn, Unebúkádinēsa le aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó wā Ujerúsālɛm gaá le íbɔm cē tū Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɔhā kóō yɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo bī abɔ̄ kú nū lɛ okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ ádā um, Udéfīdi ā yá jīla ícɛ ā. Okónu nɛ̄ ó ce kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
idu_Latn: Aá le eko táajɛ otɛtɛ ā gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā gē yá ā. Aá yɔ̄ gē lā oyēeyi obɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka unwū kú ɔnyā ō yá icííci, ejé ō gwá otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī kóō kwú aá mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú ɛcí nɛ̄ aá gē pā nōo ī tūwēyī ā.

eng_Latn: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
idu_Latn: É géē bī owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔwā lɛ hiijā kú īkpō ɔcí kú upomégránēeti tū okónōgwu kú nū.

eng_Latn: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le ejé tū ɔjá ā, ó wɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, amáŋ ó kwú lé ɛɛ́. Īlī kú alɔ mɛ́mla áblákpá kú alɔ klla kwú kpó lé ohígbū iyāwu nɛ̄ alɔ yɛ ŋmá ɛga olígbó ā.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
idu_Latn: Iyē um le ka Isíkɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ubúsi. N kē wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā ɛnɛ kú iháyí ɔmɛ ofucigwó ā, n lā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujíyu nēe kpó abɔ̄fú ga ajɛ Ubábīlɔn ā. Alɔ bá okónu ísu kú Ucɛ́ba ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā. Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔkpáncō kwú nwūla tū um eyī, n kē lɛ ɛbɛ má ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛbɛdimɛ́lɛ̄k, ɔ̄cɛ Itiyópīya, igabɔ̄ éyi nōo gē yúklɔ́ ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, le pó ka é kwú Ujeremíya ú tá ipú obugā á. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ ī kɛpɔ̄ Okómpinu kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
idu_Latn: Lɛ omlede ā ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú oyī ōhī ú. A géē lɛ oyī ā nya akpáhɔ̄ kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, a klla géē lɛ oyī ā nya ocúgbɔ̄du abɔ̄lɔ́ná mɛ́mla ocúgbɔdu ikpó abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú uwā. A géē je oyī o hile ā ce klá ɔ́kíka ɛnɛ kú ede ā biílí.

eng_Latn: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
idu_Latn: Ókónu ō tá tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ úwé gē tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ō je wiyē ā, okónu nɛ̄ ó tá pií ā kóō kwú pīya klá anú bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ā. Kóō le pɛ́ mu ipú ikpokwú kú nū bɛ̄ɛka anɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nēé le ɔ́ ka, géē gbā āyā éyi kú usɛ́kɛlu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē miya ije kú usɛ́kɛlu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ lɛ ā. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ géē gbā ije nyā kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛya nɛ̄ó gwó gā um ā.

eng_Latn: All this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ma odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā fú gā um lɛyíkwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ n tá ɔ̄ táajɛ gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā wɛ ɛhɔ̄ mla ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú āka ohígbū Umówābu aflɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
idu_Latn: Íkpɛ́yí kú ācɛ ā, wɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ nɛ̄ ɔwɛ kú uwá bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi ā, ugbé ā wɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nɛ̄ ɔdā oōnwū kú uwá wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.
idu_Latn: Alɔ nōo wɛ ācɛ nōo ī yɛce Ujísɔ̄si ā í lɛ alelékwū nōo gē gbō ɛcɛ nyā ipú kú alɔ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ Alelékwū kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ jé odúúdú ɛhi nɛ̄ alɔ mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, da um, ɔ́dāŋ ka ā géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ a cíkā ō yá lɛ ɔkpani um, kócōō ka gā um. Ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ ā ŋ́, ka koó lɛ ā ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ka n̄ miya ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kóō híī yúufi uwā ŋ́, ka eko nyā kú o ŋmɔ́ɔcī nū ā, anúɔ géē lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ā kpó ŋmó kwɛyí lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kē í je ɔnya kú uwā ikpó kpó cē klla í je úgbɔ́ɔnya kú uwá kpó tɔ̄lá.

eng_Latn: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa je lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā le ce uwá bá, anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó kwú ɛga ōhī kú ajɛ ā ú lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔ̄n.

eng_Latn: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō, lɛ ɔ́ cē, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkpíyē kú um nōo wɛ ákú aá ā á. Aá yá ɛ̄nyā kú aá bī le blakwu um.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
idu_Latn: A géē ca uwā tāajɛ mla okwutɛ kú oje kú uwɔ, a klla í je uwá kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛtɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ipú ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ nēe bá nyā ó lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ alɔ bū okónu kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ɛɛ́, ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó je kóō lé úgwū kú ɔdā dóódu ā, anú ā nōó kē yá ɛcɛ yɛ iyē nū dúú á.

eng_Latn: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gē lé gē gwá ā, aá gē lé gē gwá lɛ iyī aá ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā nōó gē jé ɔdōlé lɛ ācɛ, klla ī je ɔdōlé cabácabá á.

eng_Latn: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn kwu aúpíla kú oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā o lɛ akā nēé ī kpó éŋkpɔ̄ ce nēe bá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla okpómōlóolo olɛ éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ kú oje udɔ ā í kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ á. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú oje udɔ kú uwā ā í kpó ga ajɛ Ubábīlɔn á.

eng_Latn: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ lɛ ɔdā obɔ̄bí ka tá alɔ nɛ̄, alɔ gē bī ɛlā ō gbo ɔtū nɛɛ le tú uwā ohi. Alɔ le pīya īmū kú ɛcɛ nyā. Jāā kwu abālɔbányā alɔ ā wɛ áhingílí kú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá lɛ pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nēé kē le ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka apī ohɛ́ ā yá aá ā. Ó wɛ apī ohɛ́ ɔlamu nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu í yá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ aá hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔ̄cɛ gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ bīyíne ā.

eng_Latn: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
idu_Latn: Aá géē lɛ ɛ̄cī kú ojīlīmā ō ce um nyā tū kóō blatū aá kú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā. Aá géē lé ucɛ nyā ŋmá iháyí ga iháyí, ŋmá ayááyí ga ayááyí, piyóó ipú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔlɛhɔ́cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ipú ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā nōo jéeyī nɛ̄hi. Ó bī íjéeyī kú nū lɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā hɛ́tá. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í bla kwu olɛhɔ́cɛ ɔ́ɔmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
idu_Latn: É klla le áma kú ugóolu abāābɔ̄yīnū yá playi ɛplá ijā kú ɔcí nēé hī ka upomégrānete nēé he tū ɔ̄ biílí jīla tá ā.

eng_Latn: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú ayíkpó nēe ŋmá Usísarīya āa le yɛ mla alɔ. É le alɔ kpó nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ Uminásɔn, ɔ̄cɛ Usáyíprɔ̄si, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō ŋmá ajaajɛ ā gáā gbɔga.

eng_Latn: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē ka glá ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī mīyɛ íjééyī nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. N le eyī kwɛɛcɛ cɔɔ ipú obócí-ádēde, n mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ohɛ́julúgwu nēé nyɔ́kpá mla anú ā kɛlā obɔ̄bí kú nū ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā dúú á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, iyɔ̄bū kú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla odúúdú ójíla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ācɛ kú Óndú ā, nɛ̄ alɔ bá yɔ̄ á. N gē da áa ka aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā ipú ɔdā dóódu mɛ́mla íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da dóódu nōó géē je klla í ka lɛ aá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá géē bá ī lā ipú ajɛ olɔhi nyā, nɛ̄ aá klla í bá í je ajɛ ā lɛ ayí aá ŋmá ayááyí éyi ga ayááyí ɔhá piyóó.

eng_Latn: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
idu_Latn: Ɔkpá nɛ̄ alɔ gē tá fu aá ā wɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá géē lɔfú jé klla í jɛ́ɛyí nū glá. Amáŋ ɔkwɔɔkwu nyā aá jɛ́ɛyí ucē kú alɔ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔhá lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpɔ̄dā nēe pɛ́ bá ɛplá ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā. Ɔkwɔɔkwu nēé lɛ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō pó ā, é mīyɛ ɛlā ā mla ɔtū ékpó.

eng_Latn: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le gbo abɔ́ɔ gbɔ́ɔ̄cī á, ó le ɔdā kú ɛhi kú aɔ́dāajɛ kpó ŋmá ipú aɔ́dāajɛ kú nū kóō kpó yá Ísɔ, ɔyínɛ́ nū ɛhi.

eng_Latn: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ɛ́frēm ɔkā ka ɔdí nɛ̄ anúɔ géē yá mla uwá ā. Ó ka ihɔtū nēé lɛ lɛ anúɔ ā, ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ébú kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī nōo gbojī ō mɛtāajɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
idu_Latn: A géē kpó ogbló kú ɔ́kīkā ā kwu ɔhá ŋmá ɛháajɛ jāā ga icō. A géē gbā ogbló ɛpa nēe í je pīya ɔ́kíkā ā, ɔwɛ ékpónú nyā dúú.

eng_Latn: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá um okónu ā, yálé, kú uwēyī kóō lɛ uwá kpó kwú.

eng_Latn: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
idu_Latn: Íne kú uwɔ nāa je gā um ā, jɛ̄ um eyī fíyɛ́ odúúdú agbénú kú ɛcɛ nyā á.

eng_Latn: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
idu_Latn: N géē klá okónu kú um, n gáā kɛlā dóódu ŋ́. Ohígbū ka awɔ kē yá nɛ̄ um móōwē nyā á, Óndú.

eng_Latn: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n tíne ō kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ka Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá géē kwúcē wā, ka alɔ géē túbá tɔ̄há mla anú ā. N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá, ayínɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ ō yá kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ géē cɛ̄ ijáalí tá ūwā. Íne nēé bīya ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ikpó gbaajɛ, klla í gwōnū. Ācɛ kú Ujúda kē í lɛ ikpó gbo ajɛ í gwōnū mla uwá.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ń da aá ka, Ɛláyíja gā ɔkwɛ̄yi ɛɛ́, amáŋ é jé ɔ̄ ŋ́. É kē yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwá ɔtū ā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā yá Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ɔdā nōo he uwá ɔtū lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
idu_Latn: Ɛgiyí nū ā nɛ̄ oyēeyī yɔ̄ á, oyēeyī ā kē wɛ ofíyajɛ kú ɛcɛ á. Ɛgiyí ɛlā ā nɛ̄ oyēeyī ŋmá á, ámāŋ ɔdā nēé yá ā, lɛ oyēeyī ŋmá opīyatɔ̄há mla ɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛpa lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú á, ohígbū ka é gē yúklɔ́ tɔ̄há lɔhi fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɔ́ í gáā yɔ̄ ipú igelī ɔ́ɔmā glá ŋ́. Akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ɔyí álá géē yɔ̄ ipú igelī, cɛ́ɛ́ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū géē bá ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ádā uwā Ujékɔ̄pu ɔ́ɔ nya mla áplɛ́ ɔyínɛ̄ nū, Ísɔ, eko nēé bá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ ūwā ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla bī ɔ̄ ijēnyīīkpó. Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu ɔ́ɔ le jɛ̄ ā, ɔ́ɔ nuunu mla Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je uwēyī lɛ ācɛ nēe lɛ íkwu ā. Ó klla ī mīyɛ ɔfú iyē kú ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔfú ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā.

eng_Latn: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
idu_Latn: A yɔ̄ í gbō um, ká n̄ lɛ íne bīya, cɛ́ɛ́ káā tá ō je íne nɛ̄ um bīya ɔ́ɔmā yá um ɛhi.

eng_Latn: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ n dɔɔ̄kā ō má aá, ká n̄ lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ aá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ ohígbū eyīyōce kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nēé tū um agbá nyā á.

eng_Latn: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
idu_Latn: N géē je oje ɔdɔ gā uwɔ ikɔkɔ oje udɔ. N géē je oje nɛ̄hɛ́ gā uwɔ ikɔkɔ oje ɔlamu. N géē je oje udɔ gā uwɔ ikɔkɔ ɔcí. N géē je oje ɔlamu ga uwɔ ikɔkɔ ɛcɔ̄. Aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yi nēe ī gbō uwɔ ā, géē bī ɛbɔ́ mɛ́mla okpaakpa le gbō uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
idu_Latn: Ucē ɔ̄kwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi kú ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi gē bī ɔ̄ jé ɔwɛ á. Amáŋ ācɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ í lɔtūce uwá glá ŋ́ mā, ucē ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú uwā piíí ā gē ŋmó uwā á.

eng_Latn: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.
idu_Latn: Ígwu ɛpa kú aá nē é gáā yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī usábāti ŋ́ ma, ke í gbō Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbō ɔcɛ́ ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ alɔ, n tíne kú aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō yá ipú aícɔ́ɔci kú Umasɛdónīya ā jé.

eng_Latn: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
idu_Latn: N wā ipú ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá-ofíyajɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɔtūce um, kóō yɔ̄ ipú obū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā mɛ́mla íne kú Umósīsi ā kɛlā lɛyíkwu eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔīcō í gaá cɔcɛ́ ā, gbéeko nɛ̄ Ujɔ́ni gbo úklɔ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Usamérīya ā gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ géē lɔfú lɛ eyī méyī mla Ujéhu glá ā? Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ujóram mɛ́mla Ahasíya í fū ɔ̄ iyē ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mpa tú ákú aflɛ́yí ā ɔkwu yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ó kwú gblífi ɛɛ́! Ubábīlɔn nɛ̄hi ā kwú gblífi ɛɛ́! Ucē obɔ̄bí kú Ubábīlɔn ā lɛ odúúdú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ kpó bīya, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ejé olɔfú nōo kpó lɛ uwá gwá kwú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
idu_Latn: Ɔtū í gáā hɛ́ alɔ ko ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ajɛ yɔ̄ ī jīliyē, nɛ̄ ɛfu le wúla tū ipu itekwū.

eng_Latn: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
idu_Latn: Usedekíya wɛ iháyí ofu céyi ɛ́ɛ́ nōó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó cɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí igwóléyi. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Uhamutálu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujeremíya nōo lā igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Ulíbna ā.

eng_Latn: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Aá wā bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je oyeeyi lɛ ɔ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ aá gwó tū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, ɛga nɛ̄ aá géē yúklɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ācogwɛ́ɛya o tīihɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá gwɛ́ɛya otīihɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mīyɛ glá, o ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ohígbū ɔ́bíipú ce ɔ́bíipú icō kú ācɛ kú Utáya ā, n géē yá uwā italā. É le okónu nēé ce mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lé tɔ̄há ā nyílá, anɔ́ɔ é kwú odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā eyīpɔ́lɛ́ éyi, ú kpó lá bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā ga ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm.

eng_Latn: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn wā gaá cɔcɛ́. Ācɛ nēe tūufi nɛ̄hi nēé klla mlɛ́nyɔ́ ɛfú ō kpó ŋ́ mā. É le bɛ̄cɛ kéē mīyɛ ajɛ kú aéwo ɔhá kú ɛcɛ ā dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
idu_Latn: Ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ká aá kwú kpó tɛ́kla ɛɛ́. Ɛ́kla kú uwā ke ī cījáalí tū aá. É kē í je ɔkpíyē ká aá lé, í je ɔ́ yi bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā. Aá yɔ̄ gē kpó agbénú ká aá tū ipú ɛcɛ nyā nōo géē mɛ ānāānā ā.

eng_Latn: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā le hɛ́bɛ̄cɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā á, ofiyajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā lɛ uwá yɛjīlatá bɛ̄ɛka ojuja ā. Ufí le uwá kwú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
idu_Latn: Anú nɛ̄ ó yá ɔtū kú ācɛ ā, jé ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ Óndú ā gaá da um kahíníī, Ujeremíya, ɔdí nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī má ā? Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ ka n yɔ̄ ī má ābɔ̄ kú ɔcí nɛ̄é hī ka álmɔ̄ndu ā.

eng_Latn: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá Ujísɔ̄si ohi kahíníī, Alɔ í jé ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ń kē gáā da aá íkwu nɛ̄ n bī gē yá ɔdā nēe bá āa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɔlɛ́ nāa lā anú ā he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í má ɛgahi kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ulámɛ̄ki wɛ iháyí ofahāanɛ ce ɛpa ā, ó le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi lɛ.

eng_Latn: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
idu_Latn: N géē wā í gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdāajɛ o yɔlá dúúdú gā uwɔ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ. Ɔdā nɛ̄ n cokónu nū gā uwɔ ā, n géē je gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
idu_Latn: É gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ alɔ ka ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛga je lɛ uwā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē wɛ ipú úklɔ́ kóō tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō nēe bá Ujudíya ā abɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
idu_Latn: Unówa, nōo wɛ ɔglɛ́ɛjí ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo hɛ́ɛ́hɔ̄ kú ufáyin á.

eng_Latn: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ abɔ̄ ce opī ā ɛyí, klla í ŋmó ɔ̄ ābɔ̄ ɛhícō kú ede, ɛga nēé gē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya ō yɔlá, ipéyī Óndú ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛya nēé gwó kóō kpó íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bīya ā nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É bá yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi mla ɛgahi nɛ̄hi ā. É wā gáā kɛlā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si lɛyíkwu ikwu nōo géē ŋmó ɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm, nōo kē wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miyā táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā í gáā kwu hɛ̄ ɔ̄ tá, lɛ aólɛlā kú nū gbóógbóō ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē má ɔ̄ tá kóō lé ɛpɔ̄bí eko nēé í kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ bī ɔcɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ɛfú dóódu lé ā wā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī āa? Ɔ̄nyɛ ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ī yá aájɔ̄cɛ́ alɛwa lé ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ gē kpó aɔ́cɛ́ kú aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā tū ipú abɔ̄ kú nū āa? Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú ɔcɛ́ ā gē kpó uwá ŋmó bá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka umlá ā. Ɔyī kú nū gē ŋmó uwá tuúú bɛ̄ɛka igbóŋgbō nɛ̄ owu gē kpó ā.

eng_Latn: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufílīstiya kē gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ɛfú ā kē kwú hɔ́lá tū ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu iyē nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu yálé á. É klla ŋmó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ áluka kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ úlā igwó ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Amáŋ ákú ācɛ nēe le ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō pó, bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́ ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Kwú odúúdu aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ú tōoli ɛcɛ péee ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ipéyī um. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú um cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
idu_Latn: Aá gē nwúleyīkwū kú aá nyɔ̄ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí piyóo. Aá gē hágágā kú aá nyɔ̄ gáā ŋmó ācɛ nōó yá aá ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ mā. Ɛlá kú ɔ́bíipú ō nyɔ̄ í bī nɛ̄ aá gē gbo piyóó á. Ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ aá le yɛ, aá gē je ācɛ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kpó yíifi klla gē kpó uwā catāajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔtū kú nū yékpónú. Ó gáā yúufi ŋ́, Ó géē yéeyī kéē má eko nɛ̄ ó í yá aólɛlā kú nū lé.

eng_Latn: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, ɔ́dāŋ ka n gē tɔ́ɔna kú ācɛ kéē lɛ apī hɛ́ kpɔ́, ɔdíyá nēé gē yá um ŋmó kpɔ́ ā? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ́ɔmā lɛ a a, ayíka ɔna nɛ̄ n tá keé le Ujísɔ̄si nyɔ́kpá playi ɔcí ā í tīile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē lɛ ɔdōlé tū okónu ɛ́ɛ́ kóō jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú nū ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gé jé ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā wɛ ɛlā íjéeyī eko nōó lɛ ɔ́ pó á.

eng_Latn: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā nēe yá olɔhi jɛ̄ ɔ̄ kéē héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū kéē yēeyī eko nōo ī wā ā í gáā lɛ ɔnyā ámāŋ lɛ ɔbá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ī tíne oje ā gē bu ɔ̄gɔ̄ tū ɛcɔ̄ nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, klla ī je ɛgba kú aɛ́fu bū tɛ́ɛcɛ péee á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́mofu ce ahāapa nɛ̄ alɔ bá ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, Óndú ā klla lɛ ɛlā igbɔhá kā gā um.

eng_Latn: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le eyī na ā, ó le bɛ̄cɛ, abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kwú īyī nū tū ā, ó le ɔ́da je kéē lɛ ɔdōlé bī wā.

eng_Latn: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ móōwē nɛ̄hi tū ɔ̄ hí ā, aéwɔhá géē je kpó. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā lɛ ɔdā dúúmā gwū opíyatū mɛ́mla ōwē ō má eko dóódu tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kē le jé ka Udéfīdi nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ abɔ̄ dúúmā ipú ikwū kú Ábna ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m, Étam, Utékōwa.

eng_Latn: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí dúú nɛ̄ íjééyī hi ɔ́ ɔtū, gē je ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ lɛ ádā nū. Ɔyí dúú nōo gē cikpó akwuna, gē kpó ije bónū ā, wɛ olíla.

eng_Latn: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ukapánɔm, aá ā gbɛlá ka aá géē jáglīmā lɛyí kwu ɔkpáncō nɛ. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē bī aá wā ajɛ ga ɔlékwū. Ohígbū ka úklɔ́ idáagó nēé yá ɛgiyí uwɔ āa, kéē lɛ ɔ́ yá ajɛ Usɔ́dɔm nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í yɔ̄ kwu ícɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā í tū ebilíi abɔ̄ kóō lɛ ɔkpíyē kú nū bīya, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ alelékwū kú nū nyatá ɛ̄cī kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
idu_Latn: É le ijā kú ɔjá mɛ́mla ákú ododó nōo le nwūla ā he tū ɔcí nēé hī usɛ́da kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É lɛ ɔcí ā gɔ́ bá ɔdɔ ā dúúdú ipú nū nɛ̄ ɛpá dúú í tá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī má ɛcɔ̄ nēé bī le gwó inu ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā dóódu nōo wɛ ɔdā o je kpó yíífi lɛ Óndú ā, aá híī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, aá kwú ɔdā ífi dúúmā ú wā ɔlɛ́ aá, aá géē bī unwulu mɛ́mla ífi gé lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔdā nɛ̄ aá ī yá ā ɛ ɛ́. Aá kpɔtūce ɛlā ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ ó gáā tīile lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am the seer: go up before me unto the high place; for ye shall eat with me to day, and to morrow I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that is in thine heart.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu tá Usɔ́lu ohi kahíníī, Ami wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā á, aá bēhé nyɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū um, ga ɛyí ɛfú ā, ohígbū ka ícɛ nyā, á géē le ɔdōlé mla um, ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī nɛ̄ n géē ka ɔdā dóódu nōo yɔ̄ ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ̄ ā gā uwɔ á, ɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ ma uwɔ tá nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ N géē nya ācɛ ōhī kú uwā lígíi ŋmá ɔkpɛtā, ɛfú mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bī ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ipú aéwo dóódu nēé géē nyɔ̄ í bá ā, é géē lɛ okónu cē aúc­ē obɔ̄bí nēé yá ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmá uwá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Unówa kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ ipú ɔwū ā, awɔ mɛ́mla aíkonó kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Ohígbū ka n le má ka awɔ ōfōōfū uwɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ɔdā nōo lɛ kpaakpa ipú odúúdú ɛcɛ ipéyī um eko nyā á.

eng_Latn: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú da um kahíníī, Olɔhi, ayíka, a lɛ igbō kú uwɔ a yá ɛyí ɔlá kú emī ɛna mɛnɛ, ikɔkɔ emī kú ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
idu_Latn: É ka iŋini tū Umósīsi kahíníī, Ó géē yɛ í lɔhi lɛ alɔ fíyɛ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ le pɛ́ gekwú mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔ́mpa alɔ ā, okómpíinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he ācɛ kú Usáyɔn, ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda gē gwéeyē, ohígbū ɛpɔ̄ nāa hɛ́ ā, Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ kaŋmó ka alɔ géē yɛ úgbéenyi nyɔ̄ Ítāli ā, é kwú Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla aálagbá ōhī ú kpó tū otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ kú ɔ́wá aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɔgɔ́stɔ̄si, nēé hī ka Ujúliyɔ̄si ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
idu_Latn: Ubálam da Ubálāki ka, háyi amānyā pīyɛ̄ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú uwɔ ā, ká n̄ nyɔ̄ gɔbū, ká n̄ má ɔ̄, ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā géē wā ɛgiyí um, ámāŋ ka ó gáā wā ŋ́. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó í mafú gā um ā, nɛ̄ n géē ka gā uwɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá icō généé kú ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ eko éyi nōo yɔ̄ í yá ucɛ klɛ́ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ alɛwa hīgwú wā ɔnū ucɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá lɔfú tū ɔ́mpa aá iyē ɛ̄cī dóódu, ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛlā nēé tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka ɛ̄cī ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛ́plá kú ínōbīya kóō je ɔtū ká aá yá lɔfú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī má eyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī mīyɛ omíci lé gbɔbū kéē hɛ́pɔ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, omíci omīyɛ lé, gē pu ācɛ ojéeyī eyī, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē hɛ́pɔ̄ obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, kóō hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, kóō yá kú ā nyīla, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ā le pīya ádā ka aéwo alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ gbō kéē gá ɔ̄ itali ā, Upɔ́lu da otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄, nōo háyi pī ɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Íne ā jɛga ga awɔ ká ā gɔ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ ɔyí ajɛ kú Uróm eko nɛ̄ á ŋmó ɔ́ ɛpɔ̄bí kú ɔdā dúú ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka é bá gē tū aá ufi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ aá úklɔ́ ā ci, amáŋ anúɔ le ɔkɔ gbā kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, lɛ ɔfú tū um iyē.

eng_Latn: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka anúɔ géē cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ ɛbɔ́, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ anúɔ gā, anúɔ géē je inu ɛgolɔfú kú uwā ā, wúlatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ é le kpó wā iyɔ̄bū kú ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ kɔ̄ lɛ ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛgbá kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá gā ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, ɛgiyí igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō oyēeyī, nōo wɛ Ujerúsālɛm kú ɔkpáncō, ɛga nɛ̄ aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé lɛ áluka ŋ́ le jīla bá.

eng_Latn: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
idu_Latn: Ísɔ dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a bī ɔtū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a tū ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ā ɛhɔ̄ fu um ā? Ujékɔ̄pu tá ɔ́ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kú uwɔ kóō gāajɛ nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak unto him: and if he stand to it, and say, I like not to take her;
idu_Latn: Ó ka anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ipú igelī ā í hī ɔmáapu ɔbá nū ā igwú, géē kɛlā lɛ ɔ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ tá ka anúɔ í gáā je ɔ́ onyōkwū ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ádɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin ā géē yá mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Ó géē wā í lɛ ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɛhɔ̄ ɔcí ufáyin ā ú tū aólufa ɔhá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
idu_Latn: Aá gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kóō yá aá bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ ā. É gē bī aá le yúklɔ́ kú olɔhi kú iyī uwā, gē leyī gwō aá bónū, anɔ́ɔ é klla gē yá aá ɔdūwēyī.

eng_Latn: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
idu_Latn: Lɛ īmū kpó ŋmá ipú oje nɛ̄hɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ onɔ̄wá ā kē í bī oje ā lɛ na ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka ācɛ kú Ɛlam kéē yúúfi kú aólɛlā kú uwá, nēe tíne ō ŋmó uwá ā. N géē cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi da uwá, géē je Ɛ́lam yíífi. N géē tū aícɔ́ɔja ɛhɔ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tú uwā jāā gbéeko nēé kwú yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
idu_Latn: Eyī kú um le kpá gɔɔ ohígbū ikwū nɛ̄ n je ā, klla le kpó mi nɛ̄ ń mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si gā útū ɔcí ā, ó je eyī má icō, anɔ́ɔ da Usakíyɔ̄si kahíníī, Hīlatá fíyaa fíyaa Usakíyɔ̄si, ohígbū ka n géē gbɔga ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ícɛ piíí.

eng_Latn: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: N géē je Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ mɛ́mla ede ā yá tīihɔ. N géē je Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū tū céé, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū gēe bīya la ācɛ otá īlī a.

eng_Latn: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɛ̄nyā kóō le yá lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda kpó ŋmá eyī kú nū, ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Umanásɛ, ɔcɛ́ kú uwā bī tū Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwā wɛ, úlā ofu ɛhɔ̄ ce úlā ɛtá ce ofu igwó .

eng_Latn: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā í gáā cɛ̄ lɛ aá jɛ́ɛ́yí kú ɔdā nōo gáā yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá ā ŋ́. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá nēé lɛ ɔ́ gwū le ɔja hɛ́ klá anú ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá le bī gē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo jɔ́ɔ́kpá cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ jé cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛyí nū ka lɛ aá, ó í ka ka anúɔ í jé ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ ohígbū kéē le ɔja ja klá anú.

eng_Latn: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots; and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
idu_Latn: Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya le odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá ofu cigwɛ́ɛpa, mɛ́mla aɔ́nya kú ɛfú mɛ́mla aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá le íbɔm cē tū Usamérīya o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
idu_Latn: N géē je awɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛbéenyi nēe kɔ̄ klá uwɔ iyē a kpó tá ga ipú ígbíli. Okwū kú uwɔ géē tá abɔ́ɔ áncā, ɛcɛ pée, é gáā je uwɔ nyi ŋ́. N géē je okwū kú uwɔ lɛ aígbáanɔ nēe ī wu icō mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí ká ō wɛ ɔdōlé kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nēé yá mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ ā, kwu ocíbú nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé gē bī le fu ɔlá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, é kwú uwā ú kpó ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi ɔ́ɔmā lā ɔtāhɛ ācɛ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi. Otú kwu ɛnɔ, ɔtū gē bīya lɛ ɔ́ nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɛlā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó gē pó mɛ́mla ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó gē bī ikpēyī abɔ̄yīnū ī má ā.

eng_Latn: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō gā ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nu, nōo yɔ̄ ɛfú kú Ujerúsālɛm ā, gaá lɛ uwɔ tábɔ̄.

eng_Latn: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá nēé gē bī le jé oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu má á, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gē jé ɔ̄cɛ ŋmá lɛ ocɛ̄tra mɛ́mla ɛlā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē ka lɛyíkwu ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Upássɔ ā wɛ ācɛ úlā ɛtá ce ofɛpa ce ahāapa.

eng_Latn: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā le yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ka lɛyíkwu ɛdɔ ikwū nōó géē kwú ā kóō le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
idu_Latn: Iyē um lé ka Usɛfaníya, n wɛ ɔyí kú Ukússi, ádā um wɛ ɔyí kú Ugɛdalíya, ádā kú ádā um kē lé ka Amárīya, Amárīya ɔ́ɔmā kē wɛ ɔyí kú Uhɛsɛkíya. Eko nɛ̄ Ujosáya, ɔyí kú Ámɔn wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Óndú ā lɛ olɛhɔ̄ nyā je ga um.

eng_Latn: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nāa gē bī wā ahɔ̄ kú alɔ yɔ̄ á. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ tíne ká ālɔ̄ lɛyí ɛlā nēe bá nyā jé.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD thy God for any vow: for even both these are abomination unto the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá dúú ka ɛ́ɛ híī bī ije dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ŋmá akwuna ō yá kú agbla kú ɛcí ā wā ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, í yá okónu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ce ā jīla ŋ́. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gē wɔ́tū akwuna kú agbla kú ɛcí ā.

eng_Latn: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄ uwā ijáalí ka uwá je ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é má lɛ ā, é klla kōō je fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é má abɔ̄ lɛ ā. É jé ŋmá ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá híī nyíla ajɛ nɛ̄ aá lā ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ami Óndú ā, yɔ̄ mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó gaá háyi pī agōdō kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ tū áganá ā, anɔ́ɔ áganá ā habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá á. Ó cāŋjɛ ikpíikpo ɔ́ɔmā anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō kpó ɔdōlé lɛ uwá lé á.

eng_Latn: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔyí nū, Ujóram tɛ̄hɔ̄ fú Udéfīdi gaá je ɔ́ abɔ̄ ogwú gicō kú oyálé nōo yá Uhadadésa, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Utɔ́yi húmáyī kpɛ́fú mɛ́mla anú igbalɛwa ā lé ā. Utɔ́yi klla bī oje ɔdɔ , oje udɔ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ gaá yá Udéfīdi ɛhi eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ uwá kpó tū ipú útuló nōo ī cɛ̄ nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ géē jikwū klla géē hīla ayīnu abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Usámūwɛ̄lu kahíníī, Eko nyá nāa géē yá ɔtūnōbí kú Usɔ́lu gāá kwu ā? N tá ɔ̄ kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ lɛ anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hí ka ólīfu ā hɛ́ tū ipú odée, cɛ́ɛ́ káā ga Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m, ɔlɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi, nēé hī ka Ujése ā. N le ɔyí nū éyi fu kóō lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
idu_Latn: Usɛbadíya ɔyí kú Umákɛ̄lu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ussɛfatíya mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem le tútū kéē kpɛ́fú, anɔ́ɔ é le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan gā Usáfɔn gāá da Ujɛ́futa ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bū ɛjī kú aá gāá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ámɔn, nōó ka lɛ aá ŋ́ mā? É ka aá géē je inu ɔlɛ́ nū tū ɔlá klá ɔ́ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū yɔ̄ ī tū um cacaca, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ ohi tá uwɔ ohígbū ɛlā nɛ̄ a ka ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
idu_Latn: Keé lɔfú bī ije le lá ɔdōlé mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ ō gwá ŋmá abɔ̄ uwā glá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
idu_Latn: A géē yá ajī kwu áklō kú ɔkíkā ɛnɛ kú nū ā. A géē yá ajī ā kwɔhá mla ede ā. Aá lɛ oje udɔ ma plá anú.

eng_Latn: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ŋgbá ácábɔ̄ ā géē wɛ ɛgɔ́ īlī ɛpa, nēé le gɔ̄ kwu áklō kú nū, nēé lɔfú je ɔ́ kwu ɔhá glá.

eng_Latn: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
idu_Latn: É gē bī āpīicɛ kú uwā bū ajɛ, ī ma ɔfú kú uwá fú. É klla ī kwinya ga ɔgbɛ́fú lɛyíkwu iyɛ́fú kú aólɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ kwú úwé kú nū ú klá ēyī, gaá háyi okónu kú ɔgɛ̄cɔ̄ kú ɛfu ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ nōó pó ā kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a gē yá amānyā, Ɛláyíja.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayínɛ́ nū ɔhá ā kahíníī, É kwú ije kú um í cīgbīhi ga um, anú ce ɛyí īkpɔ̄dā ipú ɛkpa kú um yɔ̄ á. Eko nēé le ɔ́ má ā, ɔtū kú uwā kwú gbenyi, anɔ́ɔ uwā le eyī pīya tá iyī uwā anɔ́ɔ é ka ipú ufi kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá alɔ yɔ̄ ā a.

eng_Latn: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
idu_Latn: N da iyī um ka, ami jééyī fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe tɛtɛ cɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm gbɔbū gā um ɛ́ɛ́ á. N jééyī klla jɔ́dā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce nɛ̄ Umósīsi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Íjīpiti á, ó yúufi ka ɔcɛ́ ā í cɔ̄nū ŋ́. Ó lɔtū bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nōó lɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í gē má ŋ́ mā má ā.

eng_Latn: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Udéfīdi ka lɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ulífāyi dóódu nēe kwú pīya iháyí ofu, é lɛ iyē kú nū tá tāajɛ kóō yúklɔ́ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
idu_Latn: Aá kē kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Ɔwɔicō kē yɔ̄ ī yá ā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ eko dóódu, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka anú ā fíyɛ́, ká aá kē lɛ ɛdɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nōó wɛ ā jé lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
idu_Latn: O ŋmá Ubɛ́tɛlu ga Ulúsi, gaá bū Atárɔ̄tu Áda, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ácāti lā ā.

eng_Latn: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɛ̄cī ɔhá tū nōó í je ɛga lɛ ācɛ kéē mlɛ́nyɔ́, ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ícɛ. Iháyí alɛwa le gla ó kɛlā bū okónu kú Udéfīdi ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nēé tɛtɛ kɛlā ŋmá anú gbɔbū ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō pó ícɛ, aá híī tá ō bī ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā le yúklɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā kú nū ā le kpó hídáagó, bá ī dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā yɔ̄ ī kpó ācɛ nēe gbā Ujísɔ̄si ɛ̄gbā ā ŋmó ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā yɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó wā amānyā ohígbū ɔdā ékpó nyā ŋ́ nɛɛ, kóō lɛ uwá kpó kwú gé lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pahīla klá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā, lɛ íbɔm ce tū ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō bá ā mɛ́mla Igelī nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā. Amáŋ ɔlá wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō gaá lɛ uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni le odúúdu ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā túbá iyɔ̄bū ɛcɔ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwá ka, á jāhɔ̄, ācɛ o yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, alɔ í bī éŋkpɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ɛcɔ̄ nyā lɛ aá nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Uhɛ́sbɔn mla Ɛlíle ba í je ikwū, ācɛ pó ikwū ooje kú uwá a jāa ga Ujáhās. Kwú aícɔ́ɔja a gbo ɔɔ ooyá ufi klá fīyégbúlú, ɔtū kú uwá kwú gbenyi.

eng_Latn: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.
idu_Latn: Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́ le ācɛ nēe lā okónu ísu mɛ́mla eyīpú ɔlɛ́ kú Upɛ́siya ā kpó pi abɔ̄fú kéē yúklɔ́ lɛ́ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ocu kú ɛya oyi ɔlá dúúdú nyā pó ā, ó he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó ka ipú ɔtū kú nū kahíníī, Ń gaá tá okónu lɛ ɛcɛ ohígbū alɛɛcɛ igbɔhá gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n jé ka ɛlá obɔ̄bí nēé gē gbo ipú ɔtū kú uwā ā eko dóódu ŋmá eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú uwā á. Ń gaá je ɔdā oyēeyī yíífi igbɔhá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá eko nyā ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ukɔ́hāti ā le tá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gaá lɛ ɔdā otīihɔ nyā má, eko nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bá ī tū uwā tū, kéē cālɛ́ ā, é géē kwú.

eng_Latn: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōó cē ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ tá ŋ́, amáŋ nōo kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū odúúdú alɔ ā, ó lɛ ā Ɔwɔicō nōo je ɔyí nū lɛ alɔ ā, í gáā kpó ɔdā dóódu lɛ alɔ alahá dúú ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
idu_Latn: da uwá eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nēe ɔ́ɔ ka ā géē yá ā? É ka ɔ́ɔ da aá ɔdā nōo géē yá nōo géē cābɔ̄ ka eko nɛ̄ aɔ́dā nɔ́ɔ ka kpɛ́mm ā géē yá ɔkwɛ̄yi ā.

eng_Latn: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
idu_Latn: N gē cɛ̄tra okónu nɛ̄ Óndú ā ce ā.

eng_Latn: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
idu_Latn: Ukéni le gwutá mla ɔnyā nu, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā nū le ipú yɔ̄ á. Ɔnyā ā le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi ma nēé hī iyē nū ka Énɔ̄ku. Ukéni le igelī nɛ̄hi éyi gwó. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ í hī iyē kú Énɔ̄k ɔyí nū á.

eng_Latn: The Lord GOD hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, bī oōtīihɔ kú nū le okónu ce kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā, nēe géē bī uwɔ lɛ kpó aá ŋmá amānyā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē kwú ebéenyi mla uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú á. Óndú ā klla ka kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpɔ́tū ce awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ká aá wā í tá uwā abɔ̄, amáŋ, a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ácí ékpó nēé le kwu ajɛ, hī ɔ̄ ka ɔ́kpa okwajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
idu_Latn: Ami ā, n wɛ ogbɛhá mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́. Awɔ gē tá um abɔ̄ klla ī hɛ́ um tá á, Óndú. Wā í tá um abɔ̄ fíyaa, ā kpéko bónū gɛ ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō kú um.

eng_Latn: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
idu_Latn: Ásshu, ádā kú Utékōwa ā lɛ anyā ɛpa, Uhɛ́la mɛ́mla Unaára.

eng_Latn: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ádā kú Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, nēé gē cɛ̄tra ɔ́ piyóó ā wɛ ijáalí kú um ka ń kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka, a lɛ ɔdā dúúmā í ka nɛɛ, ayíka a ka, ká n pó. Ohígbū ka n tíne ō hɛ́pɔ̄hi ga uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ̄! Alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ alɔ tá bá ī yɛce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!
idu_Latn: Eyī ɔlɛ́ gbɔɔ́ ō ce Udéfīdi, anɔ́ɔ ó ka eyī ɔ́ɔ yá anúɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ō gwá bī gē lɛ anúɔ ŋmá obugā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kwu pī okómpinu kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm ā kú anúɔ gwá.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
idu_Latn: Nááná ā aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu alɛwa lɔtūce Ujísɔ̄si, amáŋ ohígbū ācɛ Ufárisīi ā, é ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ glá ŋ́, ohígbū nēé géē lɛ uwá nū ŋmá Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ owu le tá klá anú, ó kwú ŋmó, klla gebí tāajɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í klla gáā má ɛga nōó tɛtɛ kwu ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a le yɛ mla alɔ, ɔdā olɔhi dóódu nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē yá lɛ alɔ ā, alɔ géē kɔ̄ ɔ̄ mla awɔ.

eng_Latn: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ā cāŋjɛ, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ nēé gbā ā pó ɔlɛ́ nū ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá le jé ka, ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kwú um ú ŋmó, oyī kú um í ce aá mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā igelī nyā ɛyí ka aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó lɛ́pɔ̄bí ŋ́ ŋmó. Ó lɛ ā ohígbū ka Óndú ā tū um ɛhɔ̄ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ka amíyɔ̄ ka odúúdú ɛlā nyā lɛ aá á.

eng_Latn: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe géē lā ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā kē wɛ Unássɔn, ɔyí kú Ammínādabu.

eng_Latn: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú nōo tīihɔ yá ā, le ka ɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā kéē gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
idu_Latn: É kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ú tēelihɔ ohígbū kéē gē je ɛga lɛ ācɛ aéwɔhá nēé hɛ́ apī ŋ́, í klla lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́ mā, kéē wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um eko nēé gē je ijē mɛ́mla oyī kú ɛbɛ́ ɛya ā gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, kwú okónu nɛ̄ n ce mɛ́mla uwá ú tēelihɔ ohígbū ucē ɛbí dóódu nēé gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
