idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē lā amānyā mla alɔ, aá lɔfú lā ɛga dóódu nōo he aá ɔtū. Aá géē yíliyētá, í tɔ́ɔ́hí klla í gbagbénú.

eng_Latn: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ujísɔ̄si abɔ̄yī nū tɛtɛ le je kahíníī, Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ í gē lɛ ojīlīmā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ujúdasi gā ā, ó le yɛ tá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si bōōbū, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okónu kwu ɔ́ okónu á.

eng_Latn: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujeremíya da odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō tū um ɛhɔ̄ ka amiyɔ̄ ka odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka nɛ̄ aá pó ā lɛyíkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla igelī nyā á.

eng_Latn: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, owu nāa fu áncā ā Óndú, cɛ̄ lɛ úgbagwú kú enyi kwú ācɛ Íjīpiti í kpó bí. É le pɛ́ ga ɛháajɛ ísu ā bɛ̄ɛka ígbɛ́cɔ̄ ipú ísu o túgbagwú nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:
idu_Latn: N klla lɛ oje ɔdɔ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄, mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú uwá wɛ ukílōgram úla ɛhīlī nɛ̄ a géē bī le hijā tū eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mɛ́mla eyīpú nū.

eng_Latn: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ó gē kwú ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ogwije ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ kōō le nyīla bɛ̄ɛka ayínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō ā, nááná ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā hile ā, í gáā jɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gā, ɛgiyí Ujóssuwa Ugígalu, gaá da anú mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, aá ŋmá ɛga oligbó, ka aá tíne kéē lɛ okónu ce mla aá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
idu_Latn: A í fu Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū kéē yúklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā gbla uwá yá, é géē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ Usólōmɔn le ɛ̄gbā gbā Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ o ŋmá lɛ ogwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede kú udɔ ā. Aɛ́bɛ́ úlā ɛpa ce ofu igwó nɛ̄ ó kpó gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
idu_Latn: É lɛ iyī uwā táajɛ gā uwɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ īyī uwā táajɛ lɛ aɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla aádā uwā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwā. É géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ā, klla ī lɛ ɛka kú uwɔ ā tū.

eng_Latn: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ó le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ alɔ. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si nōo hɛ́ alɔ tá ŋmá ɛpɔ̄bí kú íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya ā.

eng_Latn: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā áncā yɔ̄ ī yá ipú ɛcɛ nyā nɛ̄ ó lɛyí ŋ́ kpɔ́. Ācɛ o yá olɔhi mɛ́mla ācɛ okpaakpa ā, bá ī mīyɛ ulɛ́ kú ācobɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla ācɛ ō yá alācī. Ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā, kē bá ī mīyɛ ulé kú ācɛ o yá olɔhi. Ɛ̄nyā dúú ā, í lɛyi ŋ́, ó klla wɛ áncā.

eng_Latn: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpacaŋ́gelī olulé éyi yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú nū. Ɔ́ɔmā nōó gáā bī le yá aéwo ā lé á. Ó géē bī ogbló kú oje le gbō uwā. Ó géē ŋmá ācɛ ipú ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī le ikpó wú aíkpɔ̄cí ufáyin ɛga nēe ī yá ejé ā.

eng_Latn: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je gā um mā, n da ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aá ka, aá híī gbɛlá je iyī aá gicō fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā ā ŋ́. Amáŋ aá gbēyī gɔɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá je iyī aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
idu_Latn: Alɔ wɛ ācɛ alɛwa, amáŋ alɔ wɛ ɔkpíye ékpó, ohígbū ka alɔ gē kɔ̄ ámú igbō ékpónú eko nɛ̄ alɔ gē lé ɔdōlé ihɔ.

eng_Latn: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōlé ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ɔdōlé ō gbɛ̄yí kú ajɛ ā ohígbū iháyí ahāapa kú ɔkpɛtā nēe géē wā ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔkpɛtā kóō je ācɛ ā kpó yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the man of thine, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.
idu_Latn: Náaná n géē mā ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwɔ éyi ta oyēeyī, nōo géē wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú um, amáŋ eyī kú nū géē je pu, cɛ́ɛ́ eyīyōce kú nū géē mɛ. Ācɛ o hile kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwɔ kpɛ́mm ā géē kwú ikwū ɔlɔ́ɔ́lá.

eng_Latn: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu le ka lɛ uwá ɔdā nēe wɛ ígbe kú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla úklɔ́ kú ɔcɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ɔkpá klla kwú ɔkpá ā ú tá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔnyɔɔnyɛ nū ga ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
idu_Latn: Agbénú kú alɔ yɔ̄ ipu abɔ̄ kú aúgbɔga, aéwɔhá lā ɔlɛ́ alɔ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ leyīce ka alɔ géē miyɛ oyēeyī opíyóó nɛ̄ ó cokónu o je ā.

eng_Latn: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ géē pó ɛgba ɔfú nēé í dɛ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ɔkɔ kú otrɛ̄yí kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla opo kú Ɔwɔicō. Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā abɔ̄yīnū géē wā ajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō. Ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ ɛlā Ujísɔ̄si ɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ā wɛ ācɛ nēe géē héyī aflɛ́yí á.

eng_Latn: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛka nɛ̄ alɔ í gbo ā wɛ ka á gáā yá alɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ í lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwɔ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ ī yá uwɔ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Alɔ kē gbonɛnɛ gā uwɔ klla cɛ̄ gā uwɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ɛbɔ́. Abālɔbányā alɔ jé péee ka Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú lɛ enyi amɛ̄ kú aɛ́wū, nāa géē lɔfú yá anɔ̄ ŋmá anú nāa géē le bī ipɔ́ɔnú kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ glá.

eng_Latn: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu, nōo lé ka Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́cí ā ŋ́. Anú yá ɔdā dóódu á. Ó kē le ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā fu kéē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nú abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī ā í gbɔɔ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ jāā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugárēbu klla pīya kɛɛlɛ ga Ugówa.

eng_Latn: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Benhadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le īlī ekwu kpó tū ohí, klla le ewo wu klá ɛyí, le ɔ́ŋgbá kpó kwú ɔkɔ anɔ́ɔ é le tá ɛgiyí Áhābu gaá da ɔ́ ka ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū Ubenhádādi í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ga uwɔ ka ā híī je anúɔ ŋmó ŋ́. Áhābu tá uwá ohi ka ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ yēeyī kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi, Ubenhádādi ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
idu_Latn: Ó je íne lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ó je ɔ́da lɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu. Ó da aádáádā alɔ kéē lɛ íne nyā nwū ayí uwā.

eng_Latn: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
idu_Latn: Utápūwa, Uhɛ́fa.

eng_Latn: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kwɛjī lɛ aílɔ́wá nēe je pīya ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā nɛɛ, alɔ lɛ ɔkpá tá fu uwá yɔ̄ ī da uwá ka alɔ le ɔ́ miya kéē híī lé ɔdōlé dúúmā nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí gbɔbū ŋ, ámāŋ ka o lé oyī kú ɛbɛ́ ŋ́, ámāŋ ka o lé ɛbɛ́ dúú nēé le ɔ́ ɔkɔ nyacē gbuúlú le ɔ́ ŋmó ŋ́. É klla í lɛ iyī uwā tū ŋmá ajā ō gbo mɛ́mla ikpó ɔnyā ɔhá oōce.

eng_Latn: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
idu_Latn: Usáyímɔ̄ni tóohi kahíníī, Óndú, egiyí ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ alɔ géē nyɔ̄ gɛ? Awɔ lɛ ɛlā nōo gē je oyēeyī opiyóó á.

eng_Latn: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ um fu ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla itíca, cɛ́ɛ́ kú um bī ɔkōolɔhi ā tɔ́ɔna.

eng_Latn: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ije ā ú le cíla ulé ajɛ kú ɔ̄comɛtɛ́ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da um ā.

eng_Latn: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
idu_Latn: Ipú Ujerúsālɛm ā, éŋkpɔ̄ ókpoó éyi tá okómpinu ɔwɛ kú álá, nēé hī okónu Uhíbru ka Ubɛtisáta. Ó lɛ okómpīinu ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayínɛ́ ā le ɔdā kú ɛhi ā, ije ā mɛ́mla Ubɛ́njamīn kpó, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá Íjīpiti gaá háyī iyɔ̄bū kú Ujósɛ̄fu á.

eng_Latn: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú aɔ́máapú nū mɛ́mla ayí nū géē gbolóce ɔ́. É géē playi anú ɔkɔ bɛ̄ɛka aíkókwū mɛ́mla aógo mɛ́mla aɛ́hi nēe ī playi ɔcí pílópíló nēé ī hɛ́ tū ɔdɔ kéē lɛ odée playi anú ā.

eng_Latn: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
idu_Latn: Ó gáā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, ká ā lɛ anúɔ hɛ́tá ŋ́. Ó gáā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ká ā ményīnyi nū ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ yúúfi ŋ́, ohígbū ka anúɔ í méyīnyinyi nū ohígbū ádā nū Ujonátan. Ó ka anúɔ géē kpó odúúdú ajɛ kú ádā kú ádā nū, Usɔ́ɔlu, lɛ ɔ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ī lé ɔdōlé mɛ́mla anúɔ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóbu mā ō kɛlā ā, Usófa, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Unámāati ā, gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū oyēŋēē gē je ɔfú iyē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ, amáŋ ɔtūnōbī gē bī ikwū gē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ fíyaa.

eng_Latn: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔma, n géē cɛ̄ lɛ uwá má ɛ́kɛma ɛdɔ nēé gē yúufi nū piíí ā. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá í tóohi eko nɛ̄ n hīīgwú ā ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēé gē pó ɛlā kú um eko nɛ̄ n kɛlā lɛ uwá ā ŋ́. Amáŋ é jégēdē bá ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé he um ɔtū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ otú piíí ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā wā ɛgiyí Unátan gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ó le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, ó klla yá ɛdɔ kú ucē kú ɔ́bíipú kú ɛcí oōpā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Unébati, yá nɛ̄ ó klla kpó ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
idu_Latn: N géē bī okpaakpa mɛ́mla olɔhi kú uwɔ tóokónu yɔ̄ ī ka eko dóódu. Ohígbū ka a le ācɛ nēe tíne kéē ŋmó um ā yálé, le uwēyī kpó tū uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
idu_Latn: Arawúna je eyī wāajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū má bā ī wā lɛyīkwu ɔ́ á. Arawúna má kwōkwū ajɛ iyɔ̄bu Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a le gege eko kú unwalu, ayíka a kwáhi ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū nōo bīya lɛ aá ā wɛ o ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ kóō yá aá ā, aá kē má ɔdā nōó yá lɛ aá ā! Ó cɛ̄ lɛ aá yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá ā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá mafú ka aá yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Aá le cɔ̄nū ohígbū ɔdā nōo yá wā ī yɛ ā, aá gē yúúfi kú ɔdā nōo lɔfú yá glá kpɔ́ ā. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ aá ī dɔɔ̄kā ō lɛ um má eyī, ó cɛ̄ lɛ aá cɛ̄pɔ̄ um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ italā yá ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā. Ipú odúúdú unwalu nōo yá gáā yɛ ā, aá le mafú ka abɔ̄ kú aá í wu ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī nyíleyī ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, oŋmá lɛ ɛ̄gbā ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
idu_Latn: Aá ba Ɔwɔicō cɛ́ɛ́ kóō hɔ́hā ce ācɛ nēe ī yá aá ŋmó ā. Aá da ɔ́ kóō hɔ́hā ce uwá, óō híī wɛ o da ɔ́ kóō tá okónu lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kahíníī, Ɛga dúú nēé mīyɛ aá, aá klá inu ékpó ɔ́ɔmā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ ga Ussílo, ɛga nɛ̄ um fu aflɛ́yí kéē gbā um ɛ̄gbā ā, ká aá má ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá abɔ́ɔ ā. N kwú ɔ̄ ú yíífi, ohígbū ɔbíipú nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, Ísrɛ̄lu bī ā.

eng_Latn: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́na kwú ɔ̄ ú je gicō ŋmá ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó māháyi icō á.

eng_Latn: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā nēé géē je ɔ̄cɛ olɔnyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē gwōkónu.

eng_Latn: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi tɔ̄ɔ̄há kahíníī, Ódúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā, alɔ géē yá. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ ohi kú ɛlā kú ācɛ ā kpó gē lɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Userúbābɛlu, ɔyí kú Ussɛ́litīyɛlu mla Ujessúwa, ɔyí kú Ujehósādaki le ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛlā kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā pó ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú nōo yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ā. Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɛpa ā bá pīyɛ̄ uwā gē tá uwá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ jéeyī gē gbo ojuja áluka glá, klla í píya anú kɛgɛ́ɛ̄ kóō pīya ɔwɔ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá anú āa?.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ géē je Umáyíka lɛ Udéfīdi, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ géē lɛ pīya ukpa nōo géē kwú ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ufilístiya kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, Usɔ́lu le da Udéfīdi igbɔhá ka ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ohilí anúɔ piíí ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ijēēnyi gē ŋmó ɔ̄, kóō wā gaá gwá éŋkpɔ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó lɛ ijē ŋ́ nááná, kóō wā í lá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lé. Wā ī lá ejé, mɛ́mla enyāamɛ̄. Á gáā gbā ije dúúmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō ī hɛ́ uwɔ ɔ́lá nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
idu_Latn: N le odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú Ujúda ā kpó gaá le jīla icō kú ɔdɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú uwā ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú ígwu ɛpa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nɔwɔ jīla igá kú igelī ā, bá gē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá. Ígwu kú aflɛ́yí ā le yɛ ga abɔ̄lɔ́ná, icō kú ɔdɔ ā lɛyíkwu okónɔɔwɛ kú útrīmū ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ulában le ɔ̄kā kú Ujékɔ̄pu, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā ā pó ā, ó le inya kwu gaá jīla ɔ́ ɔwɛ, le ɔ́ kwú bá ɔtū. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ bī wā ɔlɛ́ nū á. Ujékɔ̄pu le ɔdā dóódu nōo yá ā kpó ka lɛ Ulában.

eng_Latn: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
idu_Latn: Á gáā bī ɔtulalī dóódu, ɛya kú ɛbɛ́, mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó tīihɔ ŋ́ lɛ gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede nyā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nāa kōō í pīya ɛya kú ejé klá ɛyí ede nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
idu_Latn: Aá klla lɛ iyē kwú ohígbū ācɛ. Ohígbū ka uwá géē kwú aá ga ójīla okɛpɔ̄, uwá géē gɔ́ aá ipú aágblīihɔ nɛ́ŋ́cɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kú aá le mafu lɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā koó he aá ɔtū lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú odúúdú agbénú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, mɛ́mla ákú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā ú kpó ga Ubábīlɔn. Unebúkádinēsa kwú odúúdú iyó kú ugóolu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn yá ā ú kpó ca, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ka lɛ, bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nōo gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ tāajɛ ā he uwɔ ɔtū ō ka piyóó á. A wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ō plla ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And every raven after his kind,
idu_Latn: ɔkláklá.

eng_Latn: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í gbɛlá pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́, náaná nɛ̄ Óndú ā nɛ̄ lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ ī je ōwē la uwá a, é kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā ɛɛ́ ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O LORD God.
idu_Latn: A lɛ uwá fu ŋmá ipú odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kéē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ uwá bū okónu kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, Umósīsi lɛ eko nɛ̄ a kpó uwá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
idu_Latn: Á kē je anɔ̄ olīifu gā um le nya ɛyí ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā nyā lɛ anɔ̄ ihiméle nyā um ikpó.

eng_Latn: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é tá ɔ̄ ohígbū alɔ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ alɔ dúú, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā anú nōo je Ujísɔ̄si Óndú alɔ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ācɛ Ufárisīsi le ɔ̄kā da ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɛtɛ peyī ā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa lɛ í ka lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ ā, abɔ̄ ó lɛ eyī kú uwɔ nwūla āa? Anɔ́ɔ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
idu_Latn: Aéwɔhá ā le pó, é bá ī fīyégbúlú kpáákpá ipú ufi, ufi le mu ācɛ Ufilístiya ipú.

eng_Latn: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
idu_Latn: N le uwɔ yá ifa mla īlī nēé he ijā tū ɔ, lɛ áblákpá kpó wu uwɔ ikpó klla lɛ adíko ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ mla uwé usílíki kpó gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú alɔ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ka alɔ lɛ ɔdōlé tútū kú alɔ gaá tá aá. É kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ ɔ́ kwú īyī alɔ í yá aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ okónu ce mla alɔ.

eng_Latn: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
idu_Latn: Lɛ okónu ɔwɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā nwūla gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ bēé wā í tá Óndú ā ahínyá.

eng_Latn: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́, Ó wɛ ɔlɛɛcɛ nōo gē pīya odo kú nū abɔ̄ ā ŋ́, Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ó le okónu ce ka anúɔ géē yá, ó géē yá ɔ̄, Ó le ɛlā ka, ó kē ī yá ɔ̄ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when ye are come nigh unto the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people,
idu_Latn: Ó da ka gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā, ācogwɛ́ɛya éyi ɔ́ɔ í wā ɛcɛ kóō da aícɔ́ɔja ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́sro ŋmá Ukámɛ̄lu, Unáarāyi, ɔyí kú Ésbāyi.

eng_Latn: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Userúbábɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe pīyɛyi ŋmá ajɛ ɔfiyɛ, Ubábīlɔn ā, le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da uwá kéē yá ā kpó yá á. É le ufi yá klla kwú ɛyí ú táajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Uhágāyi, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, da uwá ā.

eng_Latn: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
idu_Latn: kú áa tɛ́ɛyí wāajɛ lɛ ɛdɔ kú ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī yúklɔ́ ī cɛ̄ Óndú ā ɛhɔ̄ tɔ̄há mla uwá.

eng_Latn: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka pó ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō yɔ̄tū nōbí. É le abɔ̄ ci ifa ō yá mɛ́mla o kpó ɔdīfa tū iyē.

eng_Latn: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nyā yá cɛ́ɛ́ ká Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm nēe cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kpó ayí kú Ugídīyɔn ofɛtá cigwó ŋmó ā kéē mīyɛ ulé kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nyi á, amáŋ eko o cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, ácáácí nēé má á. É yúklɔ́ lɔfú nɛ̄hi, amáŋ é má ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́má úklɔ́ ā ŋ́. Ɔnū nɛ̄ n cɛ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu uwá ā, yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā í yá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhɛ́srɔn gekwú ā, ɔyí nū, Ukálɛ̄bu kwú Ɛ́frati ɔnyokwū kú ádā nū ú. Ó ma ɔyí éyi lɛ ɔ́. Iyē kú nū lé ka, Ásshɔ́ nōo wɛ ádā kú Utékōwa ā. Anú klla le igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēé hī ka Utékōwa ā kwaajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́kpá kú Ɛ́dɔm géē je pīya unɛ nōbí nēé ī le yá ɔwɛ uklotā ā. Ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm géē je pīya úmlá kú ōwō. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā gē je gbɔlá ohígbū unɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko ɔ́ɔmā, Alelékwū Ihɔ cɛ̄ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si gwéeyē nɛ̄hi anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ádā um! Óndú kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ! N tá awɔ ahínyá ohígbū ka ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ a kwú tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí ācojeeyī mɛ́mla ācojɔ́dā ā, a lɛ ɔ́ mafú lɛ aógwuda nēé jé ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ mā. Īī Ádā, n tá uwɔ ahínyá ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ a miya kóō yá á.

eng_Latn: And he brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛhóyāda kwú Ujówāsi ú bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ, kwú ukata kú ɔcɛ́ ú kwu ɔ́ ɛyí, klla kwú ɔkpá kú íne, nōo gē gbō aɔ́cɛ́ ā ú wu ɔ́ abɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é le anɔ̄ tū Ujówāsi ɛyí klla le opo tá kahíníī, Ujówāsi wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda mɛ́ɛ̄ á ooo. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō gwāābɔ̄ klla gē kahíníī, Ɔwɔ kóō lɛ ɛyí kú ɔcɛ́ tápɛ́tɛ̄cɔ̄ ooo, ɔcɛ́ kóō yēeyī piyóó.

eng_Latn: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umánōwa le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā ká ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā í kɛlā lɛ aá ā ká ɔ̄ gā kpɔ́, eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔyí ā ma, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō da aá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā dɔɔ̄kā ō nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ā gā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú ā nɛ̄ ó klla lɔhi lɛ uwá fíyɛ́ ācɛ nēe bá ī kwú igbīhi ajɛ nyā á. Ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔkpɛtá yɔ̄ ī kpó ŋmó ga ɔlékwū ɛmɛɛma, nēé má ɔdā dúúmā lé ɛ́ɛ́ kéē yēeyī ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā dúú ā, ó kwú ɔtāhɛ̄ ódúúdu ɛcɛ nōo yɔ̄ iyɔ̄bū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ ā ú tū Óndú ā abɔ̄. Ó le ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā mɛ́mla ijē kú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú olétɔ̄há kpó gwó lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā ohígbū ka ede kú oje udɔ ā le nyɛ́ lɛ odúúdú ɛya nyā.

eng_Latn: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé bá ī doōcē ā, n lɛ okónu gwū, le ewo wu klá ɛyí. N le īlī ekwu kpó wiyē, klla le ɛyí playi ajɛ yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū uwā.

eng_Latn: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
idu_Latn: Ó kē yɔ̄ ī fíyáajɛ mɛ́mla ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō. Igelī ā yɔ̄ ī ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ōgbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ā, bɛ̄ɛka Ujáspa ā, ó klla le péee bɛ̄ɛka ogigo nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í mɛ́ɛbɛ bū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
idu_Latn: É le pɛ́ wā Ujúda gaá le odúúdú iyó mɛ́mla agbénú kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā kpó. É klla lɛ anyā nū mɛ́mla ayí nū kpó ɔfiyɛ nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā. Ahasíya, ɔyínū ōhɔ́ɔma ā nēé mā ɔ̄ tá Ujerúsālɛm ōfōōfūnū á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ɔ́ɔ kéē húmáyī jāhɔ̄ ga um kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú um nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ agege kú nū fíyajɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n gē yɛ ā. Ó kē ī bī ofíyajɛ kú nū le bī um jé ɔwɛ bū ipú obū.

eng_Latn: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛfrēm wɛ, Ukémūwɛlu, ɔyí kú Ussíftan.

eng_Latn: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le ɔdōlé kɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú uwā. Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kwu ācɛnyā kwu ācɛnyīlɔ, ó je igbō mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ o pá ɔlá mɛ́mla aíkpɔ̄cí ufáyin nōo le ŋmó lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā ā wɛ igbo ɔ́mɛtá nɛ̄ n tútū ō táaha wā gaá má aá yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́ á, ń kē gáā dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí aá ŋ́. Aá nɛ̄ n tínē ō má á, ń cɛgbá ije kú aá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ayípɛ̄ í cíkā ō tá agbénú tū gbēyī ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwā ŋ́, ádā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ cíkā ō tá agbénú tū gbēyī ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwá á.

eng_Latn: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā, ɔdā dúúmā í gáā jíla ɔ́ iyē gbóógbóō ŋ́. É géē blakwu ɔ́ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
idu_Latn: É kē lɛ ɔ̄kā kú uwɔ kā uwā ka awɔ gē nwū odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu nēe bá ɔtāhɛ̄ aílɔ́wá ā ɛlā kéē lɛ igbīhi cē kwu íne kú Umósīsi, ka a gē da uwá kéē híī hɛ́ ayí uwā apī ámāŋ ka o lɛ uculo kú ācɛ Ujíyu tū ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
idu_Latn: Ami lɛ oyēeyī á! N gekwú, amáŋ abālɔbányā n kē yēeyī piyóó. Ami bī ayígodó kú ikwū mɛ́mla ákú ɔlékwū á.

eng_Latn: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
idu_Latn: Éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā, Ó gáā mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó le ɛbɛ́ ŋmó klla lɛ ɔ́ híla lé, Klla lɛ oyī kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ó ŋmó ā pi gwá.

eng_Latn: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ odúúdú ɛ̄nyā yá kwɛyí ā, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā ōhī ā, wā gaá da um ka, ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aúlífāyi ōhī, ɛ́ɛ lɛ īyī uwā tū céé ŋmá ɛgiyī aéwo ɔhá nōo lā kwu alɔ ā ŋ́. Éwo kú Ámmɔn, Umówābu, Íjīpiti, Ukénana, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, Upɛ́risi, Ujébusi mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámɔri. Ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla aúlífāyi ā bā í yá ucē elihɔ nɛ̄ aéwo ɔ́ɔmā ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔnyā géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔbá nū dúúdú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ icɔ́ɔci géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā lɛ ukpa kpla lɛ ācɛ ɔhá, amáŋ ukpa ā le anú abɔ̄yī nū kwú.

eng_Latn: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ipú éwo dóódu ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yúufi nū, nōo kē yá ɔdā okpaakpa ó gē mīyɛ anú.

eng_Latn: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
idu_Latn: Aá lɔfú le ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá eko nɛ̄ n gē gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā a pó ɛɛ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā dóódu nōo tɔ́ɔtɛ́ gā um kú n̄ yá kú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ā kéē móowē nwuné lɛ āa, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n klla cēyītīkwū kú n̄ klla lɛ uwā kpó yíífi lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndū ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Eko nēé je aá pīya aɔ́fiyɛ ā, é gbā ije dúúmā ikpɛ̄yí kú aá ŋ́, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā gbā ije dúúmā ikpɛ̄yí kú aá eko nēé lɛ aá hɛ́tá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ hɛ́ ācɛ kú Udamáskɔ̄si iyē, ufi klla yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ lɛ uwá pɛ́ kwu ɛɛ́. É bá ipú ɔnɔ mɛ́mla ákanya bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ayínɛ́ um, aá wɛ ayí kú okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce bɛ̄ɛka Áyísīki ā.

eng_Latn: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ācɛ nēe bá ā kpó tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá nēe gē yá ɛdɔ úklɔ́ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā á. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Aklóbīya, aá jé ka o ŋmá úklɔ́ nyā nɛ̄ alɔ gē lɛ agbénú á.

eng_Latn: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, aá mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú aá lɔfú lé amɛ̄ mɛ́mla átákwū kú abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɔdā nēé je kú ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, ɛga oyēŋēē. Aódée kú ɛya nyā wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú awɔ mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ŋmá aódée kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē gwó lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
idu_Latn: N yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka n ka eko gā nɛ̄ n tíne ō gwɔ̄ɔ́ci kú ɔdā nēé yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā ɛɛ́. Ká n̄ kē lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ aólɛlā kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le má pée klla le jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ mla Udéfīdi, nɛ̄ Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ klla he odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Where were white, green, and blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.
idu_Latn: É lɛ abɔ́ɔ yá ifa mla īlī owú nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla odufā. É klla lɛ īlī ɔgalúlā fúlá tū eliká kú ugóolu mɛ́mla ɔtángbédē, le uwá hɔ́ɔgba icō lɔɔlɔhi. É lɛ agōdō kú ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kpó bá eyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā. É lɛ ɔ́ yá mla ɔtángbédē nɛ̄hɛ́, ɔnɔ̄wá, odufā mɛ́mla ɔgalúlā. É bá ī ceyī nyɛɛ́nyɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
idu_Latn: Á jé ka Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu le okónu ce lɛ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ayí nū keé géē yɔ̄ í lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔfú tīīyē ká ā gā ɛ́ɛ́ ká owu kóō bū. Upúdensi, Ilínūsi, mɛ́mla Uklaudíya ka ami ɔ́ɔ hokónu tū uwɔ. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá amānyā ā ka amíyɔ̄ hokónu tū wɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɛ́ ɔnyā ā le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi ma lɛ Uhádādi. É hi iyē kú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā lé ka Ugɛ́nūbati. Ɔcányā ā lɛ ɔ́ fō klla le ɔ́ bī jɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔ́nū ɔlɛ́ Uféro, ɛga nōó lā mɛ́mla ayí kú Uféro ā.

eng_Latn: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda le pɛ́ i yɛ mɛ́mla ācɛ Usímīyɔn, anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ kú Ukénan nēe lā igelī nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka Uséfāti ā yálé á. É lɛ okónu tá lɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā, le ɔ́ wúlatāajɛ dúúdú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú iyē ú ce abɔ́ɔ ka Uhɔ́ma. Ɛyí kú iyē nyā lé ka ogblífi.

eng_Latn: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ, Ɛláyíja lɛ ɔkpá tá fu Ujɛhóram kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā aá Udéfīdi ā, le uwɔ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí, ohígbū ka á yɛce ɔwɛ kú aádáádā uwɔ Ása ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbō ɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ le tá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Usiríya, amáŋ alɔ í má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gē pó ofu ɔ̄cɛ, amáŋ ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔnya kú uwā wɛ oōwā ajɛ ɔcí, mɛ́mla aɛ́na kú uwā. Áklɔ̄kpɛ kú uwā kē bá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ tɛtɛ ā iyí nū kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ayínɛ́ ahāapa le ɔ́ lɛ ɔnyā kpɛ́mm ā, ɔnyā kú ɔ̄nyɛ nōó géē wɛ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe kwú ā le kpó héyī ā?.

eng_Latn: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufárisīi le odúúdu ɛlā nyā pó kpɛ́mm ā, é yá Ujísɔ̄si okónu ohígbū keé ī yúnwū ije nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū klla kwú ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hī ā ú wúlatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
idu_Latn: Alɔ tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá, anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ádā kú Óndú alɔ, Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ó kē wɛ Ádā nōo ī ményinyi ɔ̄cɛ, nōo ī tú ɔ̄cɛ ɔtūlé ojigógó.

eng_Latn: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da um ka áluka kú ācɛ nēé fukɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō údɔ̄bū ā wɛ úlā ofigwáahātá. É ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ása í je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aíkpɛ́cí kú ācopɛ̄cí nēe bá ipú ajɛ ā kpó yíífi dúúdú ŋ́ náána ā, ó le lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā klla ī yá ucē nōo ī he Óndú ā ɔtū ā kpaakpa odúúdú oyēeyī kú nū.

eng_Latn: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo tá ka anúɔ í tōhílīpú ŋ́, ayíka ikwū bayi gē gbēyī nū á.

eng_Latn: The men of Kirjathjearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ukɛriyati Ujēyarím, Ucefíra mɛ́mla Ubéerɔ̄tu wɛ úlā ce ofigwáahāpa ce ɛtá.

eng_Latn: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
idu_Latn: Ń tá ō tá aólɛhɔ́cɛ abɔ̄ jéejéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. N kē ī yá ka anyōkwū kéē leyīce odée eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔnyā háyi iyɔ̄bū ede, iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā kóō gwá ɔkpá nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē yá uculo kú nū nyā.

eng_Latn: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
idu_Latn: Iyāwu o yɛ bɔ́lɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ kú olíla, gē mafú lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe má ɔ̄ ā ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ olíla á.

eng_Latn: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka a le tá ɔlɛ́ nū, ɛ́mba ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga ɔlékwū nāa yɔ̄ ī yɛ abɔ́ɔ á. O ga ɔlɛ́ nū ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka o túbla ɔlíkɔtɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
idu_Latn: Kwú anɔ̄ ō kpócu nɛ̄hi ú. Lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá ā mīya kléklé: éŋkpɔ̄ kú Umaar, umu okpócu nɛ̄hi nēé hī ka ucínāmɔn, mɛ́mla ɔnjī nōo gē kpócu nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛwa nēe jila bá ā hīgwú mla ayíkpó kú nū, wā ɛgiyí nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tíne kóō yɛce um kóō leyī gwō iyī nū bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú nū ú ce ɔkɔ cɛ́ɛ́, kóō yɛce um.

eng_Latn: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast: for my time is not yet full come.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ucɛ abɔ̄yī aá, ń gáā nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ucɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka eko kú um í yá jīla ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ó bɔ́tū kɛlā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā? Ɛ̄nyā wɛ atufú ō yá Ɔwɔicō. Anú ōfōōfūnū je íne nɛ̄ ācɛ bīya ā yá ɛhi glá á.

eng_Latn: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, aá lɛ iyó kpó le tútu kéē kpó aá aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ ewɔhá. Umémfisi géē jé tá alácɛ̄ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lā anú ŋ́, bɛ̄ɛka Ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
idu_Latn: N je íne ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ aá, ká aá yíihɔtū tū iyī aá. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yíihɔtū tū aá ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā aá í yíihɔtū tū iyī aá lɛ ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
idu_Latn: É géē je uwá kpó ga Ubábīlɔn. É kē í bá abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n le tútū ō gaá nyɔ̄ í kpó uwā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, cɛ́ɛ n lɛ uwá kpó cīgbīhi wā Ujerúsālɛm amāa.

eng_Latn: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n nyɔ̄ gaá lā mɛ́mla Ugɛdalíya ipú ajɛ kú Umíspa, ipú ācɛ nēe hile ipú ajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujérobōwam wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu iháyí ofu cɛpa. Ó gekwú, é lɛ ɔ́ nyi, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Unádābu kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le blakwu Urécɛ̄lu, klla lɛ ɔkɔ nōó gbā ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ ɔ̄gɔ̄ɔ̄ma nwūla á.

eng_Latn: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
idu_Latn: Ubaána, ɔyí kú Uhussáyi, wɛ Ugbómína kú Ássa mɛ́mla Ubeyálɔ̄tu á.

eng_Latn: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kéē ya kú ācɛ ā kéē má báajɛ ígwíígwu kú ofɛpa cigwó ofɛpa cigwó.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
idu_Latn: Kwú utéblu ā ú háyi eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú ɛga o tīīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō hayi ābɔ̄ ɛhíícō kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ ā ú hayi ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
idu_Latn: Ɛyí ɛfu kú Afɛ́n, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu pā ɛcí ɔ́ɔmā, ácí mla ujē géē bū tū ɛyí ede kú uwā. Ó ka é géē da ɛfu nɛ̄hi kéē wā í kwú aá ú tayínū ipú nū, é klla í da aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā kéē má klá aá báajɛ.

eng_Latn: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā le Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kú odúúdú aólɛlā kú nū ā, ó le ijē nyā gwó lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā le da uwá ka ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kɛlā kú um dúúmā í gáā gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ ká o yá gɛ ŋ́. Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ n ka ā géē yá jīla piíí. Ami, Óndú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le kā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ ká Ɔwɔicō kóō yá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ajɛ mɛ́mla ácí ā, n yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le hí ísu ā igbó gā ogbeé ɔhá ā, uwá gāājɛ kú Ugɛnɛ́sārɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá igelī ā le tá ɛyí ɛfu kú ɔcí olīifu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Umósīsi kahíníī, Wā icō ɛfu ā, ɛgiyí um. Awɔ mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni, mɛ́mla Unádābu mɛ́mla Abíhu, mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ofɛtá cigwó ŋmá ipú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Eko nɛ̄ó hile lígíí kú aá wā ɛyí ɛfu ā, aá túkpɛɛ́ kú aá gbā um ɛgbā.

eng_Latn: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: N le ācɛ ōhī kú ayí aá fu kéē le pīya ācomɛ́ɛbɛ́, mla aóklóbīya ōhī kú ɔlɛ́ kéē lɛ pīya aátámɔ̄kpá. Ɛ̄nyā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́ nɛɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu? Ami, Óndú ā, le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ jé ā, é lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɛ nēe yɛ abɔ́ɔ jílatá ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ācɛ odoōcē kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó gé lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ n nwū aá ā le aá gwó tá yēŋēē ɛɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔglɛ́jí gē gwó ūkwū ɔcí bónū ŋmá ɔcí ā.

eng_Latn: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɔtūce ā í gboji ō hɛ́ ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka owú kú ɔlákápá ā.

eng_Latn: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
idu_Latn: Kéē jɛ́yí ita, mɛ́mla ɛyí ācīije mɛ́mla ɛyí gbúbitā nɛ̄ ācɛ ojéeyī gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: A géē lɛ anɔ̄ ā tū Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛyí. Kwú abɔ̄ ú ce uwa ɛyí kéē kwú pīya ācogwɛ́ɛya kú um.

eng_Latn: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Usɔ́dɔm da Ébram kahíníī, Lɛ ācɛ ā kpó gā um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ agbénú ā kpó.

eng_Latn: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le má ka o pɛ́ ɔ́kɔ gɔbū ā le lɔnɔ tū ayíkpó kú nū, ohígbū ka owu yɔ̄ gē tá ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwā, anɔ́ɔ ɛplá obúgwū o tógwú aflɛ́yí mla ɔ́mpa ā, o yɔ̄ gē yāwu eyī éŋkpɔ̄ ī wā ɛgiyí uwā. Ó kōō gáā gla uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū nāńdaa le okwutɛ kú nū miya kwu eyī éŋkpɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kwúcē á. Ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā yá kéē le kwu ŋmá ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, amáŋ Óndú ā lɛ uwá kpó tá tū ipú ísu ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
idu_Latn: Ami, Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka, n géē je ācɛ Ujúda nɛ̄ n yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kpó uwā ga aɔ́fiyɛ ga ajɛ Ubábīlɔn ā kéē lɔhi lɛbɛ̄ɛka aíkpō ufíigi olɔhi nyā.

eng_Latn: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ ā labɔ̄ nū kwɔtū lɔfú fíyɛ́ yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ɔdā nōó yɔ̄ ī nwū ācɛ ā gē yá kú ɔtū kú uwā kóō wu kllicō kéē cīlɛ̄fú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī Ujudíya. Ó gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Ujudíya anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā ó kē gā amānyā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
idu_Latn: Upéka, éyi kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū, ɔyí kú Urɛmalíya mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛpa ce igwó, ŋmá Ugílɛ̄di, le ujɔ̄ tū kwú Upekāhiya ú ŋmó tá inu eyīpú kú ɔlɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí Upekāhiya á.

eng_Latn: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
idu_Latn: Aɔ́nya kú uwá wɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛpa ce ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō, yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwā wɛ ācɛ ō yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje ɔlamu í gē tōō cē ŋ́ mā nɛ̄. Odúúdú uwā bá ī bá ɔlɔ́ɔlɛ́ ī híla ācɛ klla ī yá awanda. Odúúdú uwā le bīya kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan klla da Udéfīdi ka, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ tíne ō ŋmó ɔ̄ kpɔ́, Óndú ā kóō lɛ anúɔ ŋmó ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ jé, cɛ̄ɛ̄ kó ō le kwu ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Udéfīdi ka Óndú ā kóō yɔ̄ mla anú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ yɔ̄ mla ádā anúɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú íkókwū ú, lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō, kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ uwá, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā le gwá ŋmá ipu nū á.

eng_Latn: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú nū lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo jīla mɛ́mla anú gē gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi.

eng_Latn: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
idu_Latn: Aóhī hábɔ̄ bá ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ nɛ ajɛ kú nū ā í lipú ŋ́ mā. É le bū abɔ̄ ajɛ ā í lipú ŋ́ klla lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɛbɛ nɛ̄ n má otú ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā, n má odée nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā. Ó yɔ̄ ī wā ɛgiyí um, ojuja le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ nōo húmáyī yɔ̄ ŋmá íkííkée ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú bī wā iyɔ̄bū nū á.

eng_Latn: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, Óndú ā yɔ̄ amānyā, anɔ́ɔ ń jé ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú eko nōó kwú hīla ókplící dúúdú ā. Ó lɛ agbénú mɛ́mla ojīlīmā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Usólōmɔn lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, awɔ nōo ī nwū ācɛ ɔhá ɛlā ā, á cíkā ō nwū iyī uwɔ ɛlā ŋ́ nɛɛ. A gē tɔ́ɔna ká ācɛ kéē híī wūwī ŋ́, amáŋ awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ kē ī wūwī.

eng_Latn: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
idu_Latn: Ámsi, Ubáni, Uséma.

eng_Latn: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ aíne kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ agwú nōó gáā má ɔdā ō bī gwɛ́ɛya kú o yá yēŋēē kú nū glá ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
idu_Latn: N le Ubɛsálélu, ɔyí kú Úri, ɔyí kú Uhɔ́ɔ, ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā fu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó kē gbo mla anú ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú nū ā ma. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka UJÍSƆ̄SI á.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD, the LORD of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe bī kpati kú okónu ōce ā kwū ikpó kú uwá ú wu ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, ísu ā í gáā pɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ī pɛ̄ ŋmá ɛháajɛ ā géē je pɛ̄ tū ɛgéégée.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Á má ɛbɛ lɔhi. Ɔ́ɔmā mafú ka n leyīkwu ɛcɛ gɛɛɛ ká n yá kú ɛlā kú um kóō le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó le ɔ̄kā da kpɔ́ kahíníī, A wɛ Ísɔ, ɔyí um, ɔkwɛ̄yi ii? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ohi kahíníī, N wɛ ɔyí uwɔ Ísɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
idu_Latn: É géē le úklɔ́ kú o bi ákanaba ō bī gwó Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ɔcí o kwu ajɛ, ɔcí aflá, mɛ́mla ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
idu_Latn: Ebilíi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō á, le ómblí tá gajɛ ohígbū keé tɛɛtɛ lɛ tá tāajɛ ipú ɔkpíihɔ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō géē je ɔ́da lɛ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū lɛyíkwu uwɔ. É géē bī uwɔ ce abɔ̄ kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā híīī lɛ ikpó kú uwɔ gbo ɛcɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, a géē je ɛbɛ́ kú ɔbɛ́ɛna ā, ɔkpá kú nū, mɛ́mla ácílubu kú nū kpó yɔlá eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ aá lā ā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ íne nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya bīya ā kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
idu_Latn: Ébrahām wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē je pīya éwo olɔfú nɛ̄hi, nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā, nɛ̄ n géē hɔ́hā ce odúúdú aéwo.

eng_Latn: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n tíne ō tóohi ɛlā nɛ̄ aá tá lɛyíkwu ɛhi nɛ̄ Alelékwū ihɔ gē je lɛ ācɛ ā. N tíne kú aá lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi lɛyíkwu ɔdā ā jé,ayínɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é cāŋjɛ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si kwu tɛ́ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú igelī kú ɔlɛ́ uwā á. É lɛ ɔ́ bī ga á ogenegene kú ɛyí ɛfu nēé gwó igelī kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ce ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le ɔ́ pīyɔcíkōtō gaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
idu_Latn: Unehemíya kahíníī, Igbīhāajɛ ā, ācɛ Ujíyu kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ gbɔɔ́ ō ka iŋini lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ujíyu ɔ́mpa uwā.

eng_Latn: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo he odúúdú ācɛ Átɛnsi mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā ɔtū ā wɛ ka o bī eko kú uwā yɔ̄ ī kā klla yɔ̄ ī pó ɛlā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a híī yá um italā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, a kē híī tū um ufi gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, ó klla lɛ Umáaka, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ábsālɔm lɛ. Ɔnyā ā ma ayí ɛnɛ lɛ ɔ́, iyē kú uwā bá yɔ̄ á: Ábīja, Atāyi, Usíba, mɛ́mla Usélōmiti.

eng_Latn: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ā híī lɛ odée gbō ɔbá ɛna okónu eko nɛ̄ ó yɛ ɛyí īkpɔ̄dā kó ō wú ɔ ŋ́. É klla ka ipú nū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔcɛ dúúmā nōo ī yúklɔ́ cíkā kóō miyɛ ulé kú nū.

eng_Latn: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o hile kú Ujúda ā géē bá ī jɛ bɛ̄ɛka, īkpɔ̄cí nōo tá ɛgba ga ipú ajɛ lipú, nōo yɔ̄ gē gwá eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā ɛ̄cɔ̄bū, nɛ̄ ɛfu ɛga nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā kwu ā, géē cɛgbá klla í lɛ ojīlīmā fíyɛ́ dúú á. Ó géē lɛ ojīlīmā fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā. Ācɛ kú odúúdú aéwo gē pɛ́ kwūū bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá ā, wā abɔ́ɔ ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɔ́ɔ je ɔdōlé nēé hī umaná, nɛ̄ ádā uwā í lé jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má, lɛ uwá ipú ígbíli ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá móōwē nɛ̄hi, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō já uwā má, cɛ́ɛ́ igbhāajɛ ɛɛ́, ó lɛ ɔhā kú aɔ́dā olɔhi hɛ́ ce uwá.

eng_Latn: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíyāsafu, ɔyí kú Ulɛ́lu wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma nyā á.

eng_Latn: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le má ka, Ulában ɔ́ɔ̄ gáā gbonɛnɛ lɛ anúɔ bɛ̄ɛka otɛtɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Ɔbánɔ̄si ɔ́mpa alɔ o yúklɔ́ kú ɛhɔ̄ ō cɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá, mɛ́mla Usitákīsi ɔ̄cɛ ohum ɔtū.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n da aá ka, ā híīī gwō ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí dúúmā ɔ́ci ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ lɛ abɔ̄ fíyɛ́ uwɔ ábáa abɔ̄lɔ́ná, lɛ ɔhá pīya tá lɛ ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ odúúdú ójila kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā túbá, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā je ɔ́da lɛ aá ká aá yá.

eng_Latn: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
idu_Latn: Ucílēyabu, ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Abígɛ̄ɛlu, ɔ̄nyā okwūma Unábalu nōo ŋmá Ukámɛ̄lu ā. Ábsālɔm, ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Umáaka, adá kú Utálmāyi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ugɛ́sɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the LORD from his holy temple.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú éwo ā, aá lɛ ɛ̄lā nyā pó. Odúúdú aá nēe lā ipú ajɛ nyā ā, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nyā. Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō géē cījáalí tū aá. Aá jāhɔ̄! Ó kɛlā ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔkpáncō kú nū.

eng_Latn: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ajɛ nyā kɔ̄ lɛ īyī aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma kú aá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóna lɛyí táajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, le yɛ tá Unínīfɛ, ɔlɛ́ o nwuné nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ó géē je ɛ̄cī ɛtá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō yɛ ɔ́ jīla glá ā.

eng_Latn: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
idu_Latn: Ń kē ī kɛlā obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá gē ka ā ŋ́. N kē ī bī ɔdā nāa gē nwū ā le yúklɔ́. Ń kē bɔ̄bíipú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nɛ̄hi le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū. É bī ācɛ ocīkpó, ācɛ opeyī, ācɛ odokónu, mɛ́mla ācɛ o doōcē alɛwa ɔhá wā dúú. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá kpó bá ɛgiyí ikpó kú nū. Ó kē lɛ uwá hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í yɔ̄ gē yá ɔdā dúú nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā cɛ̄tra alɔ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ kōō ī tíne kú aá ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú kéē cɛ̄tra alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujóssuwa le da ācɛ ā kéē híī dɛ̄gba ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛlā dúúmā ɔ́ɔ gē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú uwā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ anúɔ le ɔdā nēé géē yá ā da uwá.

eng_Latn: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
idu_Latn: Óndú, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē gbo ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē kpó aólɛlā kú uwā nēē tá ítū mɛ́mla ɔyī lɛ uwá ā yíífi. É géē bá ī gbogwú ɔgbɛ́fú bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā, abɔ̄ é géē bá ī ŋmó aólɛlā kú uwā ā. Oyī kú ācɛ nēé géē yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ā, géē yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ cɛnyi ŋmá uwá iyē bɛ̄ɛka oyī kú ɛya nēé gwó, nōo le mu ocíbú cɛnyi ā. Ó klla í lɛbɛ̄ɛka oyī nōo ī pɛ́ klá ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
idu_Latn: N géē tá odúúdú aéwo ā bá, cɛ́ɛ́, n lɛ uwá kpó wā ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɛhósāfati ā. Abɔ́ɔ ā, nɛ̄ n géē kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā ohígbū odúúdú ɔdā nēé yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā. É le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu pahīla ga ipú aéwɔhá. É kwú ajɛ kú um ú kpó kɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
idu_Latn: Aá híī cikpó ɔ̄cɛnyā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔnyā uwɔ ámāŋ́ gbo mla ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔbá uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú klla lɛ ɛlā ka gā um igbɔhá.

eng_Latn: And when they were come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant that was with him, Come, and let us return; lest my father leave caring for the asses, and take thought for us.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ipú ajɛ kú Usúfu ā, Usɔ́lu da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kóō wā kú aá kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́, ámāŋ ádā anúɔ ɔ́ gáā lɛ ɛlá wu aíjakī ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ɔ́ɔ géē yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá í wā ɔlɛ́ ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
idu_Latn: Á kē jé ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá okwúbɔ́há kú aɔ́lɛ́ nɛŋcɛ éyi kú Ésiya, Ufigélɔ̄si mɛ́mla Uhamojínesi, le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king's daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ayínɔ̄nyā kú ɔcɛ́ ā í kpó ɔfiyɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ohile, nēe bá Umíspa ā nɛ̄ Unebusárādan otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn kpó tū Ugɛdalíya abɔ̄ ā. Íssmɛ̄lu lɛ uwá kpó ɔfiyɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ajɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri á.

eng_Latn: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
idu_Latn: Ajɛ ā yɛ ɛháajɛ ŋmá Akrabím gaá bū Usín. Ó gaá bū ɛháajɛ kú Ukádɛssi Ubanéya ga Uhɛ́sīrɔn gaá yɛ ga Ádda, ɛga nōó pīya ga Ukáka.

eng_Latn: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó le uwá kpó ŋmó igbledū, klla kwú oyēeyī kú uwā ú ŋmɛ̄yí icííci.

eng_Latn: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le aɔ́dāajɛ kú uwā kpó gé lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu á. Ó kē le ɔdōlé kpó lɛ uwá iháyí ɔ́ɔmā kwɛyí aɔ́nya, aálá, aɛ́wu, aɛ́na mɛ́mla aíjakī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
idu_Latn: É le ɛpɔ̄bí kú íne ō bīya ā lé, ohígbū ka é cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwā wɛ úlā ofu ahāapa ce úlā igwóléyi ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
idu_Latn: A gē hɔ́ɔ́hā ce ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ ā. A gē gbō uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkplɛ́fú gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ ā, ohígbū keé he uwɔ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;
idu_Latn: É yá ucē kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá kú íne lɛ ā. Ɛ̄cī éyééye, é gē gwɛ́ɛya nōo cɛgbá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anú nōo cīīce ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, N yɔ̄ ī je ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu yá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄! Ó klla da um kahíníī, Lɛ ɛ̄nyā tá tāajɛ, ohígbū ka ɛlā nēe bá ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, nōo tōō lɔtūce.

eng_Latn: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ohile kú ɔcí ā, ó kē kwú ɔ̄ɔ̄ ú gbā ojíbó, klla gē túkpɛɛ́ ī gbā ɔ̄ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā. Ó gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔwɔ kú um á, lɛ um nyatá.

eng_Latn: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ dúúmā kú alɔ nōo le túblla Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā géē kwú. Ayíka odúúdú alɔ géē je kpó yíífi mɛ́ɛ̄ á ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
idu_Latn: Aépu le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí aókwū ɛbɛ́ ā gáā kpó uwā lé, amáŋ Ébram le uwá kpó nū.

eng_Latn: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
idu_Latn: nōo kwú ohígbū alɔ, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ lɔfú lā tɔhá mla anú, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ kōō yēeyī ámāŋ ka alɔ gekwú eko nōó í wā ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā á. É kē gáā lɛ agbénú dúúmā ipú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gɛ ŋ́. Ami ā wɛ ɔdā dóódu nēé ce ɛgbá á.

eng_Latn: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́, n gáā lɛ okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce ā gbla ɔdā nōo ī yá ɔtāhɛ alɛɛcɛ eko dóódu. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ cɛ̄ tɔ̄há lɛyíkwu odée lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔkpá, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í bīya ámāŋ ka o tá ɔdā ɔhá tū ɔ̄ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kwúcē igbīhi ga ogbeé ɔhá kú óókpoó ā. Ɛwa kú ācɛ le jīla tū ɔ̄ okónu óókpoó ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá Óndú ā da um ka.

eng_Latn: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, alɛɛcɛ le bɛ̄cɛ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ kú uwā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ klla le gbō kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Ugídīyɔn mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī gāá lɛ aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kwu pīya obugā kú Uhárɔ̄du. Aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Umídiya ā bá ɔpɛ́, nōo ga ɛhíícō kú uwā pīya ɛfu kú Umɔ́re ā.

eng_Latn: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā jégēdēē leyī gwū ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā bónū. Ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka ka é yá ɔkpáncō ŋmá lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka íkííkée ā, é kē yá ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú éŋkpɔ̄, ó ke bī éŋkpɔ̄ le hɛ́ igá tū ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka éwo dúúmā géē tú ɛyí wāajɛ í gbā ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛ̄gbā, N géē mā ācɛ éwo ɔ́ɔmā tá ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē hɛ́hɔ̄ anú, kéē klla lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, aá yɔ̄ ī yá kú Ɔwɔicō kóō ce ɔcɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ aɔ́dā mbá ā le pīya ákú dúú.

eng_Latn: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó yɔ̄ ɛga ékpónú nōó nyīla tū ɔkpíyē ohile ā ŋ́, ayíka ofu kú ipí ā nɛ̄, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē ka ká ɔ́ɔ le yēŋēē.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ohile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujɛhóssāfāti yá ā, é lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
idu_Latn: Ujáhāti, ɔyí kú Usélōmiti, ɔyí kú Ísiha.

eng_Latn: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
idu_Latn: Ádā um nōo kē tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā, anú abɔ̄yī nū cījáalí kú um á. Aá pó ɔkɔ kú nū jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ī má ōgbla kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
idu_Latn: Aá ŋmó ācɛ igelī ā gbóógbó nɛ̄ odúúdú uláyi le mu mla okwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ iyē kú uwɔ ā! Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā cīla ka, iyē kú anúɔ wɛ Ulíjɔn, ka aá lɛwa nɛ̄hi íbí.

eng_Latn: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ iháyí igwɛ́ɛnɛ le gla ŋmá eko nɛ̄ n táaha ga Ujerúsālɛm ā, n le yɛ tá Ujerúsālɛm igbɔhá mla Ubánābasi. N kwú Utáyítɔ̄s ú tɔ́ɔkwu nyɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
idu_Latn: É bī aɔ́dā éékpó ɔ́ɔmā le ɛkpa o bɔ́tū ā wu klla le ijā he tū ɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ákú ɛ́fɔ̄du ā.

eng_Latn: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Amáŋ awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, lā ipú ɛcɛ nyā glá ā? Odúúdú ɔkpáncō ā í nwuné jɛ̄ nōo gē bī uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó lɛ ā, abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi lígíí nyā géē jɛ̄ uwɔ glá ā?.

eng_Latn: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um lɛ ífulá ka lɛyíkwu um, n gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwā, klla gē yá lɛ uwá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā ā.

eng_Latn: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔnyɛ ā le tá ipú kú nū, ó géē je hɛ́ɛnɔ tū ɔ̄ ipú.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔnyā, ɔtū nɛ̄ a kpóce úm a nwuné íbí. Kóō le yá gā uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā tíne ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā ā le hɛ́tá ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ éyi kú Unábalu da Abígɛ̄lu kahíníī, A pó ō, Udéfīdi le ɛhɔ̄ tū ŋmá ipú ígbíli wā í lɛ okónu kú ɛbɔ́ hɛ́ tū ɔkpáni alɔ, amáŋ ó lɛ ɛcá tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ gē yúúfi ō kpɛ́fú ā nɛ, ɛmba anú mɛ́mla ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, Upúra, kéē lɛ pɛ́ ga aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú ācɛ Umídīya.

eng_Latn: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
idu_Latn: Umatɛnáyi wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujoyárību á. Ússi wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujedáya á.

eng_Latn: And as they went up the hill to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said unto them, Is the seer here?
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ é bá í tū ɛfu ga igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, é jīla ayípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā nēe bɛ̄cɛ gāá hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ ɔwɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é da uwá ɔ̄kā ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nōo yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛgbá kú alɔ lɛ alɔ. Ó tīihɔ, ó yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kōō lɛ́pɔ̄bí eko dúúmā ŋ́ má. Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācobīyíne, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú gicō i tá ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá dóódu kpó lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ o da um kahíníī, Le tá fu ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú icɔ́ɔci kú Upɛgámum ā ka ami nōo bī ɔkpacaŋgelī o leyi ɛpa ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā bī ɛlā icííci lɛ plla aá ŋ́. Ó wɛ ohígbū ikpɔ́nyā ōce, unwū ɔnyā ō yá bɛ̄ɛka opī mɛ́mla únwū ɔdā nō yá nɛ̄hi ā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē bī le cɔ̄nū tū ācɛ nēé lɛyítáajɛ le ɔ́ ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ígbɔhá Óndú ā klla ka ɛlā ga um kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔkpá tá gā awɔ ɛga okɛpɔ̄, lɛ ɛlā ā kagwó mɛ́mla anú eko nɛ̄ a lɛ eko kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, gbɔbū kú ā ga abɔ́ɔ. Ikpíkpó nɛ̄ aá lɛ tá abɔ́ɔ, ó géē je uwɔ tū ɔcɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄ abɔ̄. Ɔcɛ́ ohɛ́pɔ̄ ā géē jé uwɔ tū udásanda abɔ̄. Cɛ́ɛ́ udásanda ā kwú uwɔ ú tá agbá.

eng_Latn: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká eko nēé lɛ um nū ŋmá úklɔ́ ɛɛ́ ká ācɛ kéē mīyɛ um wā ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō yá ɔdā olɔhi eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe yá ɛdɔ ucē ōbɔ́bí nēe bá ā hɛ́ klla lɛ italā yá uwā.

eng_Latn: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ wāajɛ bū ɔtāhɛ́ úláyi nɛ̄hi kú igelī ā. Aɔ́cí nɛ̄ īkpō kú uwā gē je oyēeyī nēe gē gwá aíkpō igbigwɛ́ɛpa iháyí ā yɔ̄ ābɔ̄ ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú ísu ā. É kē ī gwá īkpō igbéyi ɔyā dóódu. Ēpū kú aɔ́cí ā wɛ ɔdā nōo gē hɛ́ aéwo dóódu tá ŋmá ōcē.

eng_Latn: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ísu ca klá ɛcɛ gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā, ɔ̄nyɛ gwū ɔwɛ tū uwā kéē yɔ̄ cíí ā?.

eng_Latn: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yá kú éyi kú ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe kpɔ́tūce um nēe bá ā kéē klla cɛ̄lā kú um gɛ ŋ́, ó géē lɔhi lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛgɔ̄ flá pla anú ɔkɔ kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ga ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōbɔ̄bí gē wú ɔcɛ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka o yá ɛdɔ éékpó mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ dóódu jōnjīlɛ̄, gē yá nɛ̄ íkwu kú ɔcɛ́ ī lɔfú nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka aá ī tá um ɔtū lé mɛ́mla ɛlā ɔdāhá kú aá ā? Odúúdú ohi nɛ̄ aá húmáyī í tá um ā wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ójila ā bá hímm le ahɔ̄ jē lɛ Ubánābasi mɛ́mla Upɔ́lu abɔ̄ é bá ī kā ɔ̄kā kú ɔdōcābɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdídáagó dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō bī uwā yá ɔtāhɛ̄ aílɔ́wá ā.

eng_Latn: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
