idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufárisīi le pó koó lɛ ācɛ Usádusīis okónu gwū ā, é le jīla tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē bī ɔfú kú nū gē le gbō aá nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ó kē le tútū ō nya aá tá, ó kē í yá lɛ ā ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ.

eng_Latn: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu ā kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō hɔ́hā ce ajɛ kú uwā, kóō yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú éŋkpɔ̄ kóō bū ŋmá ajɛ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpíihɔ ɔhá kahíníī, Óndú ā jé ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ācojéeyī ī gbɛlá nū ā wɛ ɔdā icííci.

eng_Latn: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā nēé ka ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka alɔ gekwú mla anú ɛɛ́, alɔ kē í yēeyī mla anú.

eng_Latn: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú ɔ̄cɛ le pīya kwu alī éyi ābɔ̄ éyi, eyī kú ágábá kē le pīya kwú alī ɔhá ābɔ̄ ɔhá. Ó lɛ ā jāā jīla ɔdɔ ā tá.

eng_Latn: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si má cīce, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo dɔɔ̄kā ō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú, cíkā ō kwú iyī nū ú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó cɛgbá ŋ́, fíyɛ́ dúú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī cɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le ɔ́dā je lɛ ɔ́ ka ó nyɔ̄ mla odúúdú ɔfú nɛ̄hi nōo lɛ nyā, kóō lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Umídiya. Ka anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gē tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá abālɔbányā jāā gbéeko dóódu, íne ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā géē gbō aá mɛ́mla aéwɔhá nēe lā ɔlɛ́ aá piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā á. Aá mɛ́mla uwá wɛ ācɛ ékpónú ɛgiyí Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
idu_Latn: é kahíníī, Alɔ le tēelihɔ ohígbū ka alɔ le abɔ̄ kwu okwū, ɔdíyá nēé cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ je iyɛ́ɛya kú alɔ lɛ Óndú ā mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.
idu_Latn: Igelī dóódu kú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya nēé le ɔ́da mɛ́mla íne kú ɔcɛ́ ā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ nɛɛ, ācɛ Ujíyu gbɔɔ́ ō tɔ́ɔga. É lɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ je lɛ iyī uwā, klla bá ī gwéeyē yɔ̄ gē lé ucɛ. Igbīhāajɛ ā, ācɛ alɛwa kwú pīya ācɛ Ujíyu, ohígbū ka é bá i yúufi ācɛ Ujíyu ā eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá kú ɔwɔ kóō límanya ŋmá abɔ̄ éyi kú ɔkpáncō ga ɔhá, klla ŋmá oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ éyi ga ɔhá.

eng_Latn: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Upássɔ wɛ, úlā ɛtá ce ofɛpa ce ahāapa .

eng_Latn: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn í nū ācɛ nēe lā aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ukítrɔn mɛ́mla Unahálālu ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́. É lā abɔ́ɔ mla uwá, amáŋ é wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú ācɛ Usébūlɔn.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá Óndú ā da um ka.

eng_Latn: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ojéeyī gē nwū odúúdú ɔdōojé nēé lɔfú jé glá ā, amáŋ eko dúú nɛ̄ olíla gē kɛlā, ayíka unwalu í ligbó lɛ ajɛ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu tá ɔ̄ ohi kóo anú wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cāŋjɛ kóō lé ɔdōlé, ka anúɔ géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú Unábɔ̄tu ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔ́. Ɔtú kóō he ɔ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cɔ̄nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ́cɛ dúúmā nōo gē le abɔ̄ da aólɛhɔ́cɛ ɛyí tāajɛ ī pīya uwá tū ā, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ nōo yā gē tá owu nɛ̄hi nōo gē da aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ tāajɛ ī kpó uwā ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
idu_Latn: N gē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi ohígbū ɛlā kú uwɔ, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ije nɛ̄hi pīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je uwēyī lɛ ádā uwɔ o ŋmá lɛ o cikpó ɔnyā nū ɔhá dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obededom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú odúúdú ugóolu , oje udɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó ga Usamérīya. Ó klla kwú odúúdú iyó ɔhá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ákú agblɔ̄cɛ́ nɛ̄ ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Obédi Ɛdɔm gē gbō ā ú kpó ga Usamérīya dúú. Ó klla lɛ ācɛ kpó kwu ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga Usamérīya.

eng_Latn: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou so to me?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn nōo nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú, ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ipɔ́ɔnū kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ nyɛ́ klla túwāajɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn á. Ɔdíyá nɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ɛdɔ ɛlā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ā?.

eng_Latn: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
idu_Latn: Ondú, eyinyinyi um nɛ̄ ā gē má ā kóō kwɛjī ɔwɛ ŋ́. Yɔ̄ ī gbō um ohígbū ka a yíihɔtū tú um eko dóódu, a klla ī yá ucē okpaakpa lɛyíkwu um.

eng_Latn: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú nū jíla ajɛ iyē eko ɔ́ɔmā. Amáŋ abālɔbányā ó lɛ okónu cē kahíníī, N géē jíla ajɛ iyē igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́, amáŋ ó wɛ ajɛ ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, ɔkpáncō dúú.

eng_Latn: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu ā kē cɛ̄ tɔ̄há le ɛdɔ ɛlā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā kpó ce Upɔ́lu dúú.

eng_Latn: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
idu_Latn: Ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpā um, aá yá ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá má um yɔ̄ gē yá ā. Aá leyī kwɛcɛ kú aá gbla ucē okpaakpa nɛ̄ alɔ mafú lɛ aá ka aá cíkā ō yá ā.

eng_Latn: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n tá ɔ̄ ɛɛ́, n klla í je ɔ́ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aéwɔhá. Ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā géē yá ɔcí ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
idu_Latn: Áhābu da Ujɛhóssāfāti kā, Abɔ̄ alɔ gē nyɔ̄ ɔgbɛ́fú ā, n géē je īyī um pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā, amáŋ awɔ a géē lɛ awulú kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ wiyē. Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le tá ɔgbɛ́fú, le iyī nū pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā kwú úwé kú ofulajɛ í kpó wiyē á.

eng_Latn: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
idu_Latn: Ɔnū nɛ̄ olíla gē cɛ̄ lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō ā gē ŋmó ɔ̄ á. Ímálānyī kē í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ nōó jéeyī ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú ācɛ okpaakpa ā gē wú ācɛ o ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā ɔtū nɛ̄hi, amáŋ ācɛ okpaakpa ā gē tíne kéē gbō ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
idu_Latn: Óndú um mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō kú um, da uwá ka ń jíkpó ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. A cɛ̄ lɛ uwá gwéeyē tá um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ ekwu kú Umósīsi ɛ̄cī ofuciigwó, ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si nōo wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Udéfīdi, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le pīya Ohɔ́nyɛtá kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ Óndú í wā gaá ce ɔcɛ́ ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā. Ó géē ce ɔcɛ́ klla í gbō odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā mla okpaakpa, ó klla í hɛ́pɔ̄ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛ ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ le ɔ́da je ka Ábsālɔm ká ɔ̄ lā ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yīnū, ka ɔ́ɔ̄ híī wā í lā ipú agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ŋ́, ohígbū ka anúɔ í tíne ká anúɔ má ɔ̄ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm nyɔ̄ í lā ɔlɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó wā ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi kú Ɔwɔicō gaá háyi pī Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā ka a yúúfi ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú aícɔ́ɔja ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. N géē je uwá kpó tá ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ícɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā jé ka amíyɔ̄ wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
idu_Latn: Ó gbolóce agbénú kú nū kóō gbō ɔ̄, amáŋ ó lɛ ā glá ŋ́. Ó lɛ abɔ̄ bī agbénú ɔ́ɔmā ká, amáŋ agbénú ā í lɛ́ɛcɛ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
idu_Latn: Má ɔ̄, eko ā gē wā, ó kē gā ɛɛ́, eko nɛ̄ aá géē pahīla, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu géē ga ɔlɛ́ nū, aá klla géē habɔ̄ um tá ōfū um, nááná ā ń gáā yɔ̄ ōfū um ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ádā ā géē yɔ̄ pī um.

eng_Latn: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
idu_Latn: É ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú je anɔ̄ ā lá fíyɛ́ égō nɛ̄hɛ́ ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ glá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ije ā ú kpó lɛ aógbɛhá. É ka ífulá tū ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nōo yēeyī ā géē wɛ ɔdōlé kú aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ēpū mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu wɛ ɔdōlé kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú, eko nōó le pīya iháyí úlā ɛpa ce ofɛhɔ̄ ce ɛhɔ̄ ā á.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
idu_Latn: A tíne ō ŋmó um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti ɛ́nɛ̄ ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī acá kú nū lɛ ipú nū fā tɛ́ɛcɛ. Ó í yá ɛ̄nyā ɔwɛ nɛ̄ acá ā í gáā je fā ŋmá anú ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ ó kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī nū ú kpó yɔlá ɛyí ede ā. Ocu kú ɛya kú ɔdōlé nyā gē he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
idu_Latn: Ó kē yɔ̄ ī kɛlā kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le yá kú éyi kú ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe bá nyā kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um gɛ ŋ́, ó géē lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ keé lɛ ígbɛ́cɔ̄ gbo bá ɔ́ ɔkɔ cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá tū ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄, ācɛ Ubábīlɔn lɛ íbɔm cē tū Ujerúsālɛm, lɛ imu tīkwū klá ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī ā, kéē gaá mīyɛ ɔ́ tū abɔ̄. É bá ī kpɛ́fú tú alɔ, ɔkpɛtā yɔ̄ ī ŋmó alɔ, ōcē obɔ̄bí kē yɔ̄ ī yá alɔ. A kē má ɔ̄ ka ohígbū ɔdā nēe bá ā, é kē í yá igelī nyā lé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka ā.

eng_Latn: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛ́ɛtá mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo le yēŋēē ā géē mī éŋkpɔ̄ ā klá ɔ̄cɛ ā, ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, ó géē yá ɔ̄cɛ ā yēŋēē, eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ īlī kú nū na lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ pīya klá iyī nū.

eng_Latn: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō yúklɔ́ kú nū ā, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka iháyí ofucigwó ā. Ācɛ gbɛlá ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujósɛ̄fu nɛ. Ujósɛ̄fu wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uhɛ́li.

eng_Latn: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
idu_Latn: Ipú aɛ́bɛ́ nyā, Ɔdā éyi yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛmu nōo yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄, yɔ̄ í yɛ gicō ga ajɛ ā. Ɔlá nyā gē cɛ̄ blu gicō klla ī cɛ̄ maámaá bɛ̄ɛka ɔwolímanya ā.

eng_Latn: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
idu_Latn: Unebúkádinēsa le odúúdú ayípōklóbīya, ācɛ nɛ̄hi, aígabɔ̄, ācɛ olɛ-ojīlīmā kú Ujúda dóódu ā kpó kwú bɛ̄ɛka aálagbá ā ga Ubábīlɔn. Ódúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ ó kpó nyɔ̄ ā wɛ úlā ofu ce ɛhɔ̄ . Ó klla kwú odúúdú ācoyúklábɔ̄ abɔ̄ mɛ́mla aónɔwá ā ú kpó nyɔ̄ dúú. Anɔ́ɔ ó habɔ̄ ācogbɛhá fíyɛ́ dúú ā bá ajɛ ipú Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ, kwu ācɛ nēe bá ɛga oligbó mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe kwu ajaajɛ ā. N géē hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá.

eng_Latn: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unaómi da Urútu ka anúɔ géē dɔɔ̄kā ɔbá éyi lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔlɛ́ abɔ̄yī nū lɛ.

eng_Latn: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ obɔ̄bí ka lɛyíkwu Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ, é géē je yá ɔ̄ ɛhi. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ obɔ̄bí ka lɛyíkwu Alelékwū Ihɔ, é gáā je yá ɔ̄ ɛhi ipú ɛcɛ nyā ámāŋ ipú ɛcɛ ɔhá nōo gē wā ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ a le kpaakpa ā, tá um abɔ̄ ká ā lɛ um nyatá.

eng_Latn: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
idu_Latn: Aá klla gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ācɛ, mla oyī nēé mī, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o je íneoōbīya yɛ́ɛhi, ikoko ō dɛ̄gba kú ɔ́ci ō gwō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oyī kú Ébɛ̄lu yá ā.

eng_Latn: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
idu_Latn: Ami āa, eko le yá nēe géē je um gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka ejé nēé gē le gwɛ́ɛya ī ce klá ɛyí ede āa. Eko nɛ̄ n gáā kwú ā le yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
idu_Latn: É wɛ ígwu kú aólíla, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé uwā ŋ́. Ācɛ kē lɛ ogbló kpó lɛ uwá nū bēhé ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
idu_Latn: Úwé olɔhi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ āccogwɛ́ɛya géē le wiyē, kéē yúklɔ́ ɛga otīihɔ ā. Īlī otīihɔ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya, Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ákú ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ o yúklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.
idu_Latn: ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē gbēyī, kéē le jɛ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē wɛ ɔbá uwā glá ā? Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē tá aɔ́bá ɔhá ō lɛ nɛɛ, ayí anúɔ? Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ gáā tá ŋ́. Unaómi ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ igbīhi cēkwu anúɔ ɛɛ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ kwú anúɔ iyē lɛ uwá nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
idu_Latn: Ugábali mɛ́mla Usaláyi, aɔ́máapú kú Usaláyi ajaajɛ. Odúúdú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ úlā ɛpa ce ofɛhīlī ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
idu_Latn: É bá gē dɔɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nēé géē mīyɛ klla kɔ̄ nɛɛ? Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aícɔ́ɔja ā kē í lɛ ācɛnyā éyééye ámāŋ ka ɛpɛɛpa. Īlī ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ í wɛ ákú Usisɛ́ra, īlī nēé lɛ ijā he tū ɔ̄ ā, kē í wɛ ákú ɔkɔ kú ami nōo wɛ ɔcányā ā.

eng_Latn: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm ā he ɔ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ odúúdú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá kú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujosíya je ɔ́da lɛ ā, é lɛ ɔdā dóódu kpó yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá lé, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē je ɔyí omlede ā gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá ɛyí ede dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka anyōkwū le cīgbīhi ŋmá o yɛce Ohɔ́nyɛtá gwōtū ɔwɛ kú ebilíi ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá híī lɛ okónu hɛ́ Ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛlā okónu kú ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá nɛ̄ aá gē ka ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā á. Anɔ́ɔ aá lɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú ami, Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā, Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú klla wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ aá gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā gbájí á.

eng_Latn: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
idu_Latn: Ó klla le da ɔ́ dúú ɛdɔ oje ɔdɔ nōó géē bī le yá aójotíhi nōo lɛ abɔ̄ ɛtá ā, aógo ocɛyí, aɔ́já mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nōó géē bī le yá aócíbú ā.

eng_Latn: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gbɛlá ka uwī ōwī ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ádā ɔ́ɔ bɔ̄bí ŋ́, ayíka anú mɛ́mla uwī ɔlamu ā wɛ ɔdā ékpónú á.

eng_Latn: IT IS A GOOD THING TO GIVE THANKS UNTO THE LORD, AND TO SING PRAISES UNTO THY NAME, O MOST HIGH:
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō tá uwɔ ahínyá, Óndú. Ka ɔ̄cɛ kóō gwíijē cɛ̄tra awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ kú agwú ā le nyīla tū odúúdú iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ ā, ŋmá ɛyí kwu ajɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā má lɛ glá ā.

eng_Latn: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ a kē má ka ami, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, yɔ̄ í wúla ɔdā nɛ̄ n gwó ā tāajɛ, klla yɔ̄ ī fu ɔdā nɛ̄ n tū ā ŋmá ajɛ ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi ā lɔfú bī ɔkɔ ogbonɛnɛ le pi um ahɔ̄ kóō nā um tɔ́ɔwɛ glá. Amáŋ ń gáā mīyɛ ojīlīmā ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ojigógó lɛyíkwu ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ olufa ā lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kwú, lɛ éyi kú uwā gɔ́, lɛ ɔhá ŋmó, klla lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá klá ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ádā uwɔ gē nwū uwɔ ā, ā kē híī tá ɛlā nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ gē nwū uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄ tá tū obugā éyi nōo le ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ nōó gwó ede lɛ Ɔwɔicō aflɛ́yí nōó gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbā ­āa.

eng_Latn: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú ā le lɔfú tū Usɔ́lu iyē ɔ́kíka dóódu. Ɔyī alɛwa le Usɔ́lu kwú klla le ɔ́ yá ágbe bɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́, Ákisi ā da Ákisi ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā í wɛ Udéfīdi nɛ̄ ācɛnyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē gwííjē hī ɔ̄ ka, Usɔ́lu ŋmó úluulā, amáŋ Udéfīdi ŋmó ācɛ úluulā ɛga igwó ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā klla bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka kpɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá klla gā kpɔ́ gaá da Ujóbu kahíníī, Ācɛ ohéjulúgwu kú Ucaldíya lɛ īyī uwā kɔ̄ ígwu ɛtá, wā í tū alɔ iyē. É kwú aínyankwūlūmī ā í kpó uwī, klla bī ɔkpacāŋ́gelī lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā kpó ŋmó. Ami ōfōōfū um kwu wā gaá da uwɔ yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔdā nɛ̄ n le hɛ́ Óndú ā oji ā lɛ ɔ́ ipéeyī kú odúúdú ojila kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔdā nēe gē yíífi glá ā í je pīyabɔ̄ ga ɔdā nōó gē yíífi ŋ́, ɔdā nōo ī kwú ā kē í je pīyabɔ̄ ga ɔdā nōó ī kwú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kú aá ī ka, Alɔ ā yɛce Upɔ́lu, nɛ̄ aígwu ɔhá gē ka kahíníī, Alɔ ā yɛce Apólɔsi ā, ayíka ɛ̄nyā í mafú ka aá gē yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ ɔlamu ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú uwɔ í lɛ ō mɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ɛlā nɛ̄ a ī ka ā kē wɛ áncā, bɛ̄ɛka owu nōo ī tá nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upáyílēti da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā a wɛ ɔcɛ́ kɛ̄ɛ? Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Awɔ ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ á n. É ma n wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā ká n̄ yá ɔdā ékpó nyā, ká n̄ kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo cɛ̄ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ā gē pó ɔkɔ kú um.

eng_Latn: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
idu_Latn: Óndú um, kóocōō, lɛ okónu nɛ̄ a ce lɛyíkwu um mɛ́mla ācɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ um ā yá jīla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka anúɔ géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ko yɔ̄ gē lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ā yá nɛ̄ alɔ yēeyī á, ó wɛ oŋmá lɛ ɔda nɛ̄ alɔ má ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um ígbɔhá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔ́ ka lɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā ā, géē lɔfú nya alɔ tá ŋmá ipú ɔlá kú útuló kú uwɔ ā glá, ó kē í nyi alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́tan ma ɔyí éyi nōo lé ka Asárīya.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ é bá ī ŋmó ācɛ ā, n yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ofōōfū um. N le iyī um tá pīyeyī klá ajɛ gblugudu, klla dɛ̄ íbá kahíníī, Óndú, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, a le cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm jaā nāa gáā je odúúdú ācɛ o hile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋmó nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ó géē kpó ɔkpá kú nū, odúúdú ícɛ̄bɛ́ kú nū, īkpɛ̄yí kú nū, aíkpó kú nū mɛ́mla iyíipú kú nū, mɛ́mla aj­īlīpú kú nū dúú.

eng_Latn: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó aópī ɛpa ā ga okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ, ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.
idu_Latn: Kú ē da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla awɔ. Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. Ɛbɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nāa lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka gɔbū kahíníī, Ayínɛ́ uwɔ, Usɔ́dɔm mla Usamérīya mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā, géē gbagbénú igbɔhá ɛɛ́. Awɔ mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwɔ gē gbagbénú dúú.

eng_Latn: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da Ujówābu mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā kahíníī, Aá le īlī kú aá híla, ka aá lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wiiyē ka aá yɔ̄ ekwu kú Ábna. Eko nēé gáā nyɔ̄ í je Ábna nyi ā, Udéfīdi abɔ̄yī nū tá ákplata kú okwū kú nū igbīhi.

eng_Latn: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā piíí géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā á. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā piíí kē í gbō uwā á. Ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā kē í túblá um ajaajɛ eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú wā ɛga o gbā um ɛ̄gbā. Aá kē jé ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ n hī ɔ̄ igwú ŋ́, í jámá túblá um abɔ́ɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō bī ɔdā ōmiya odée okpaakpa ā lɛ miya ɔdā lɛ ācɛ. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nōo kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā á.

eng_Latn: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
idu_Latn: N jé ka ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti í gáā habɔ̄ aá tá nyɔ̄ ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ukpābɔ̄fú ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi únóji kú ɔcɛ́ ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi á. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū lé ka Unáamā nōo ŋmá Ámɔn ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí kú Uréhobōwam, Ábīja kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda kwɛyí ádā nū á.

eng_Latn: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu ā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛháajɛ kú Ujɔ́dan nōo kwu Ujérīko ajaajɛ ā. Ó kē yɛ ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ɔkpá kú Ujérīko, klla yɛ ga ipú ígbíli. Ó yɛ ŋmá Ujérīko ga ɛhícō jāā ga ɔlɛ́ kú ɛfu klla yɛ ga Ubɛ́tɛlu.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Umósīsi kahíníī, Áa géē gwó ede ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya nɛ̄ aá í tū otulalī ɔlá ɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá nū ā, alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú gā ɛgiyí nū ipú ɔ̄na gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ujósɛ̄fu, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí Udéfīdi, ā híīī yúúfi ō le Umerí lɛ kóō wɛ ɔnyā awɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ nōó yīīpú nyā á.

eng_Latn: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
idu_Latn: N má ka oyī kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla oyī kú ācɛ nēé ŋmó ohígbū keé yɛce Ujísɔ̄si kpaakpa ā lɛ ɔ́ kwú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ejé gē kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā. Eko nɛ̄ n má ɔ̄ ā, n le hídáagó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā yɔ̄ gē yá kéē hɔ́hā ce ācɛ, é kē yɔ̄ ī ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ ɛga dóódu kú ɛcɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá ipú aá eko nɛ̄ aá pó ɔ̄kā kú ɛhi kú eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō lɛyíkwu ācɛ ā aflɛ́yí ā, nɛ̄ aá klla lɛ ɔ́ jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ kpɔ́cíí ā.

eng_Latn: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
idu_Latn: É gē ka kahíníī, Aá wā ká ālɔ̄ lɛ éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yíífi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú mlanyī Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujérobōwam mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ohile kú aípɔ́ɔma kú ɛhícō ā kwúcē wā ɛgiyí Uréhobōwam ɛ̄cī ɔmɛtá nōó da uwá kéē wā ā.

eng_Latn: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ubábīlɔn lɛbɛ̄ɛka íkókwū kú ugóolu ā ipú abɔ̄ kú um ā. N kē cɛ̄ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ le ejé gwá ŋmá anú. Ejé ā kē le uwá kwú, odúúdú aéwo ā kē kwú jɛɛ́lɛ́ ɛɛ́. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n bī ācɛ Ubábīlɔn le yá aéwo kú ɛcɛ ā italā ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n cɔ̄nū da aéwo ā lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,
idu_Latn: Ó kwú odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó bá ɛháajɛ kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá hīgwú wā í jīla ɛyí ɔpū kú okónu igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔfú tū uwā iyē klla da uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n da uwɔ ka, eko nāa wɛ ɔyípōklóbīya ā, a lɛ ɛ́nyɔ́ kú uwɔ gbō, a kē nyɔ̄ ɛga dúúmā nāa tíne. Amáŋ eko nāa le pīya ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ, a gē lɛ abɔ̄ kú wɔ nāńdaa, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá gē gbō uwɔ ɛ́nyɔ́ á. Ó klla gē bī uwɔ nyɔ̄ ɛga nɛ̄ á tíne ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
idu_Latn: Usálma nōo wɛ ádā kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m ā wɛ ádā kú ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Unetōfáti, Átrɔ̄tu Ubɛ́ti Ujówābu, mɛ́mla Usóri, éyi kú aípɔ́ɔma kú Umánāhati.

eng_Latn: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ā, Ujósɛ̄fu da uwá kahíníī, N wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yúúfi Ɔwɔicō, n géē mabɔ̄ aá tá ɔ́dāŋ ka aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n gáā ka nyā yá.

eng_Latn: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē yɔ̄ ī gwíije ohígbū ɔfú kú uwɔ, ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu. N géē yɔ̄ ī gwíijē gbōmgbōm ohígbū ihɔtū kú uwɔ nōo yɔ̄ eko dóódu ā. Awɔ húmáyī lɛ ɛlá kwu um klla gē gbō um eko kú unwalu dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ɔkpáncō ā. Ó bī ɛwa ocɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ olulé abɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe lā gboce ipɔ́ɔma nyā ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa. Otrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ Upagíyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ɔ́kran.

eng_Latn: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ īlī ekwu kpó wiiyē, lɛ ewo wu klá ɛyí, gaá cīce ɛyétutulu ipú ewo. N le okónu gwū klla gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
idu_Latn: Usakíyɔ̄si le hīlatá fíyaa fíyaa wāajɛ ŋmá icō ɔcí ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le Ujísɔ̄si bī ga ɔlɛ́ nū. Ó kē mīyɛ ɔ́ mla éeyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufilīstiya, itali nēe gē gɔ̄ aá a kwúcē ɛɛ́, amáŋ, aá lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ aá cíkā oogwéeyē nū ɛɛ́ ŋ́. Eko nɛ̄ ɛgwā éyi gekwú, ɛgwā ɔhá nōo lɛ ɔnɔ fíyɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā gēe bɛ̄cɛ kwɛyí nū. v kú ɛdɔ ɛgwā ékpónú a gēe hɛ́ ɛdɔ ɛgwā obɔ̄bí alɛwa.

eng_Latn: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
idu_Latn: N géē je Ubábīlɔn yíífi, klla ī je ɔ́ tá áncā hímm. Aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā ā bá ī wā klla bá ī dɛ̄gba kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka ugbagwu kú ísu ā, wā í kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā le mlanyī o bī ɔdōlé ga ipú ɔ́kɔ eko nēé pɛ́ ga ipú nū ā, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka igbō ékpónú ōfūnū.

eng_Latn: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ ɛ̄nyā yá, Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla alɛɛcɛ géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
idu_Latn: Ó géē fíyajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō klá alɔ nēe bá ipú ajɛ odobū kú ikwū, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ alɔ bī jé ɔwɛ ga oyēeyī kú ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
idu_Latn: Uwēyī géē kwú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, é kē í tū ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ ā wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī nū cokónu ō je lɛ alɔ á, oyēeyī opiyóó.

eng_Latn: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ alɔ gbɛ̄gbā ɔ́ɔmā gekwú ɛɛ́, é kē gáā yēeyī gɛ ŋ́. Uwá le pīya okwúmá ɛɛ́, é kē gáā héyī gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka a lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tú uwā lɛ uwá kpó yíífi ɛɛ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í klla blakwu uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú ācɛ opi owú a, mla ācɛ úklɔ́ abɔ̄ ɔhá a, gēe je gbenyi ipú ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ kú ipú aá, nɛ̄ ɔ́dāŋ koó le kwú ɔ̄ iyē géē lɛ ɛ̄cī éyi tū oyēeyī kú nū glá āa?.

eng_Latn: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɔ́tū um, ī wɔ́tū Ádā um dúú.

eng_Latn: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
idu_Latn: É le Ujówāsi yá ágbe nɛ̄hi ɔgbɛ́fú ā dúú, abɔ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ujúda ā, ó gaá gwutá ipú inu yɔ̄ í tá ágbe kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ kú nū ɛpa lɛ ujɔ̄ tū gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó tá ipú inu abɔ́ɔ kwɛyí ɔyí kú Ujehóyāda, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nɛ̄ ó je ŋmó ā. É kwú ɔ ú nyi igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi, amáŋ é nyi ɔ́ ikpámīlī kú aɔ́cɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú alɔ kéē má bá Ujerúsālɛm kéē leyīkwu ɛlā nyā. Aá lɛ ɛ̄cī tū kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ nōo lɛ ɔnyā kú éwɔhá ā kóō wā ipú ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá tū ɔ̄ ā, mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ācōkɛpɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū. Ɔwɛ nyā Ɔwɔicō géē pīya ɔtū kú nū abɔ̄ lɛyíkwu ɔnū nɛ̄ ó cɛ̄ tū alɔ ohígbū ɛlā nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gɔbu mla iyāwu kú uwā á. Umíka le má kéē le lɔfú fíyɛ́ anúɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ ā. Ó lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ɛyí ɛfu ā kpó yálé, kwu ákú ɔpɛ́ mɛ́mla ikpó ɛfú ā, jāā kwu ācɛ nōo bá ajɛ ɔlamu ɛháajɛ ā, kpó yálé kpɛ́mm. Ó habɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá ŋ́. Ó lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú. Ohígbū ka, ɔ́ɔmā wɛ, ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu da ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī-ōtīihɔ dóódu, ó géē gwɛ́ɛya kú aɔ́dā ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi ka lɛ ā. Ɛ̄cī Usábāti, ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, ucɛ kú igbɛtá kú iháyí dóódu ā, ucɛ kú igbō nɛ̄ ó gē nū ŋ́ mā, ucɛ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ō cē, ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ.

eng_Latn: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ Ukɔ́ra, Udátan mɛ́mla Abíram lā ā. Anɔ́ɔ uwá ɛtɛ́trɛ́ɛtá ā gaá háyi okómpīinu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla anyā ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā, mɛ́mla ayí olugwulugwu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
idu_Latn: Ɛcī ɔ́mɛtá ā kpɔ́, é le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā kpó ga ɛga ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́, lɛ eyī kpó kwu Ugíbɛ̄ya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yá tɛtɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Benhadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubenhádādi klla lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ɔ́ kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔwɔ um kóō lɛ um ŋmó, ɔ́dāŋ ka ń je ajɛ kú Usamérīya wúlatāajɛ, nɛ̄ úmúlá dúúmā í gáā hile nōo ī mu abɔ̄ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú um yɔ̄ ī hɔ́lá gbáyíí, ōcē yɔ̄ ī yá um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ kóō hī ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō wā abɔ̄ uwā ka aɔ́wɔ .

eng_Latn: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛ̄cī ɔmahāapa ā wɛ ɛ̄cī ōmlɛ́nyɔ́ kú um. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ dúúmā í gaá yúklɔ́ dúúmā ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá, ámāŋ ka aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú aá, ámāŋ ka aílɔ́wá nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú aá.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī dóódu é géē je ɔyí álá kú iháyí éyi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ gwɛ́ɛya ōyɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. É géē gwɛ́ɛya ɔ́ɔmā piíí ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le jɛ le pīya ijímkpa. Ó jéeyi nɛ̄hi, ó klla téeyī olɔhi kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ákú alɛɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
idu_Latn: Anyákwɔ́cɛ ā klla ka gɔbū kahíníī, Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá nōo bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō ka ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu igelī nyā mɛ́mla ajɛ nyā bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujeremíya ka ā dúú. Iyē nū lé ka Uríya, ɔyí kú Ussɛmáya nōo ŋmá Ukɛriyat Ujēyarím ā.

eng_Latn: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is the God; the LORD, he is the God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ á lɛ ɔ́ má ā, é má gbo kláajɛ, le eyī kpó pīya kláajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é ka kahíníī, Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. Anú Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū wɛ Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ Ébrahām ā, ó le eyīce ka anúɔ í yá ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ cokónu kú nū ā. Abɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ ɔhá í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ mā, iyē kú iyīnū nōó bī le cē oji á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aɔ́wɔ dóódu á. Ó ka anú ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ Óndú kú aɔ́dā ō lɔfú dóódu á. Ó ka Óndú ɔ́ɔ lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ka ācɛ ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō yúúfi nū. Ó klla ka ɔ́ gē má eyīgoo ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ gē mīyɛ omíci ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
idu_Latn: Óndú! wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ, ká ā gáā klá mla ikpati kú okónu ōce nōo ī cābɔ̄ ɔfú mla íkwu kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
idu_Latn: Usílāsi ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n lɔtūce ɔ́ ka ó wɛ ɔyínɛ̄ um ipú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ā cɛ̄ um tɔ́kpá kpií nyā fu aá á. N tíne kú um tá aá ɔtū kwu ɔtū ká n̄ cē ijáalí kú ihɔtū ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Ɔwɔicō. Aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ lɔfú.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó tayínū. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá lɛ ā .

eng_Latn: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā da Udánīyɛlu nōó hī ka, Ubɛtɛssása ā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A lɔfú da um ɔ̄na nɛ̄ n nā ā, klla ka ɛyí nū gā um glá āa.

eng_Latn: And ye are Christ's; and Christ is God's.
idu_Latn: Aá kē wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kē wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō yá odúúdú ācɛ ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ékpó. Ó klla le yá kéē lā ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā. Ó lɛ eko nēé í yɔ̄ piíí mɛ́mla ɛga piíí nēé yɔ̄ ā miya táajɛ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nōó yá uwā á.

eng_Latn: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔlɛɛhɔ̄ kú ɛbɛ oōmá ohígbū Umówābu á. É kwú ipɔ́lɛ́ kú Ár mla Ikɛr u yá ífi ŋmá ajɛ, otú ékpó. odúúdú ajɛ kú Umówābu tá hímm.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
idu_Latn: Lɛ eyī pīya kwu ocābɔ̄ kú Ujerúsālɛm nāa cīíbɔm tū ɔ̄ ā. Miya abɔ̄ kwu ɔ́, ká ā kɛlā obɔ̄bí tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ nēe bá ā wɛ úgwū kú ajɛ nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa je lɛ ípɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn á.

eng_Latn: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, a cīcē akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ yɔ̄ ī hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa gā um. A kē le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ gā um.

eng_Latn: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.
idu_Latn: Udánīyɛlu lɛ ɛ̄ba ba ŋmá abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́, anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ klla le Usádrāki, Uméssaki, mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo fu kéē leyīkwu ɛlā kú ajɛ kú Ubálīlɔn dúúdú á. Amáŋ Udánīyɛlu ā lā ipɔ́nū ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ayí kú ɔlɛ́ Uhágābu mɛ́mla Ussámlāyi mɛ́mla Uhánan.

eng_Latn: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ujíyu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abālɔbányā alɔ jé ka a lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí. Ébrahām gekwú, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kē kwú dúú á. Amáŋ a ka, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n nwū ā tū, ó gáā kwú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ijáalī ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ cɛ̄ únɛ́pɔ̄, é géē yá ɔ̄ italā piíí. Ó lɛ ɔwɛ dúú nɛ̄ ó gáā kwu glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
idu_Latn: Ó yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ɔpɛ́ nōo tá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usúkōtu mɛ́mla Usérēda kú ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
idu_Latn: Ɛnyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n mia nɛ n gāa yá ipu ɛcɛ á, N lɛ abɔ̄ kú um nandaa, gāa je ōwē lɛ odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ a ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá ā, n géē kpó uwā gā uwɔ, ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ gā um, lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā um.

eng_Latn: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, mā cíí ká ā jāhɔ̄! Gbɛlá, ká ā lɛ eyī yɛ ɔdā idáagó nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ō yá um ā? Utáya, Usídɔn, mla aípɔ́lɛ́ dóódu kú ajɛ kú Ufilístiya? Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gē cíla um ulé nɛɛ, n géē je ulé ā cīgbīhi lɛ aá fíyaa.

eng_Latn: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
idu_Latn: Aá gekwú mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá é kē lɛ aá hɛ́tá ŋmá ɛgiyí aálelékwū nēe ī gbō ɛcɛ nyā ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē yēeyī bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá wɛ ákú ɛcɛ nyā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne nēé ka.

eng_Latn: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kirioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
idu_Latn: N géē tū ɔlá ga ajɛ kú Umówābu, n klla í je igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú ɔkplɛ́fú kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ukɛríyɔ̄tu yɔlá tāajɛ. Ācɛ Umówābu géē pɛ́ kwú ipú útú nōo í hɛ́ abɔ̄ aícɔ́ɔja bá ī dɛ̄gba klla bá yɔ̄ ī tóopo ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kóō jé ka eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ Ukɔ́rīnti abɔ́ɔ, ucē kú um géē wɛ ɛdɔ ékpó mla ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē tá ipú ɔkpá fu aá eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
idu_Latn: Jāā kwu eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, ayí kú Usímīyɔn lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe bá ā: Ubiyɛssɛ́ba, Umóláda mɛ́mla Uhásarssúwālu.

eng_Latn: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda alɛwa yɛce Utobíya, ohígbū ádā ɔnyā kú Utobíya Ussicaníya ɔyí kú Ára, nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ā. Ɔyí kú Utobíya, Ujehóhānan klla lɛ adá kú Uméssūlam, ɔyí kú Ubérekíya lɛ.

eng_Latn: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka uwá mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā géē lé klla í gwá klla í jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ yúklɔ́ nū ā, iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo hɛ́ ɔhā ce uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And they glorified God in me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ó yá ipú oyēeyī kú um ā á.

eng_Latn: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú aá nōo gē kpó aá trɛ̄yí ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá, nōo gē lɛ abɔ̄ tū aá abɔ̄ bī aá jé ɔwɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
idu_Latn: Aá ka lɛ aólɛlā kú alɔ nēe bá Ugáti ā keé le alɔ yálé ŋ́. Aá cɛ̄ lɛ uwá má aá abɔ̄ aá yɔ̄ gē jikwū ā ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Ubɛti Uléfra, aá ma otūnōbí kú aá fú o ŋmá lɛ ō lɛ iyī aá míya úmlá.

eng_Latn: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ owu hīlatá, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ācɛ kú eko nyā gē dɔɔ̄kā ɔdā ō hídáagó ā? Ehée, n̄ da aá, é gáā je ɔdocābɔ̄ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā dúú lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
idu_Latn: Otrɛ́yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā le ɔkpá tá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́bā kú alɔ kéē le mu mla ɛdɔ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu. Aálá kú alɔ kéē ma nyīla, kéē ma ayí úlúúlā.

eng_Latn: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
idu_Latn: Anú ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́ klla lɛ uwá kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, yá ɔdā idáagó mɛ́mla ɔdōcābɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla eyī ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā mɛ́mla ipú ígbíli ā iháyí ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
idu_Latn: Ujótam le okómpinu kú ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā tú gwó ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ anɔ́ɔ ó klla yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi kóō lɛ āyā kú ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm nēé hī ka Ófelu ā tú gílayá.

eng_Latn: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ɛhɔ̄ nēé nyi okónu isu kú Unáyilu a gēe pɛ́ kwú klá í je ŋmóɔlá ŋmá ajɛ, owu klá í je ɔ gwu bónū.

eng_Latn: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām mɛ́mla ákú Unáhɔ géē kɛpɔ̄ kú ami mɛ́mla awɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō kú Áyísīki le ɔkpá gbo á.

eng_Latn: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
idu_Latn: Uhíram, ɔcɛ́ kú Utáya kpó odúúdú aɔ́cí mɛ́mla oje udɔ nōó cɛgbá ā lɛ ɔ́, nōó bī le gwó aɔ́lɛ́ ā á. Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn le ɔlɛ́ ā kpó gwó kwɛyí ā, ó lɛ igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú ajɛ kú Ugálílii kpó lɛ Uhíram.

eng_Latn: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le aígelī ɛtá fu ipú ajɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ísu kú Ujɔ́dan á.

eng_Latn: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī bī alítā ámāŋ ɛkpa ámāŋ áblákpá ɔmpa ŋ́. Aá híīī māháyi hokónu tū ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔwɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, uwēyī ó gáā kwú uwā, ohígbū īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nēé yá tá anúɔ ā gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka anúɔ géē kpó ācɛ oyɔ́bɔ́cɛ mla ācɛ nēe gē gɔ̄ ā, ŋmá ipú uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē hīīī yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ kú anúɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
idu_Latn: Ó le um pi kú um lɛ ōwē má bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé pi abɔ̄fú kóō kwú ɔdā ō hɔ́nɔ nɛ̄hi ú mulɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
idu_Latn: Ɛga nēé je lɛ uwá ā bá yɔ̄ á, Ujesiríli, Ucésulɔtu, Ussúnɛm.

eng_Latn: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō mīyɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe bá nyā lɔhi ohígbū ɔtū nēé kpóce ā, nááná uwá í mīyɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ uwá ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim wā gē tɔ́ɔna ipú ígbíli kú Ujudíya kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū nɛ̄hi kpɔ́ á. ɔ́rpa lɛ ɔtū má ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū ɔtū, lɛ ɔ́ tá úŋmóō. Amáŋ, Urútu í cē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ ɔbá nū tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
idu_Latn: Ágábáidu, kwú íne nyā ú kwaajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú pīya íne kú ācɛ Umédes mɛ́mla Upɛ́sīya nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā pīya anú abɔ̄ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
idu_Latn: Ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔmā gē kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um nyíleyī. É géē da uwá ka ɛbɔ́ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄, nááná nɛ̄ ɛbɔ́ í kē yɔ̄ ŋ́ mā. Ucē kú uwā nyā lɛbɛɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um lɛ ɔdɔ nɛ̄ ó lɔfú ŋ́ gwó, anɔ́ɔ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā lɛ áfū nɛ̄hɛ́ kpó pllá anú kóō bī ɔ̄ háyi.

eng_Latn: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla eyī ō gwō ɔ̄cɛ bónū gē yɛ tɔ̄há á. Ɔ́dāŋ nāa kwú ojīlīmā kú uwɔ ú tónū, uwēyī géē kwú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
idu_Latn: É jé Ɔwɔicō ipú Ujúda. Ó le ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.
idu_Latn: A géē nyɔ̄ ga Ugíligalu gbēyī um. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ n gáā má uwɔ á, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú olétɔ̄há ā gwó abɔ́ɔ. A géē gbēyī um abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ahāapa, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n wā í lɛ ɔdā nāa í yá ā da uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla le ɛlā ka gā um kpɔ́ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cokónu lɛ Ébrahām mɛ́mla ayááyí nū ka anúɔ géē je odúúdú ɛcɛ lɛ uwá ā, ó ŋmá lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō nēé le tū ā ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū kóō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ó mīyɛ ɔ́ wā ɛgiyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ofllajɛ lɛ íne bīya, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bī kú íne éyi kú Óndú nōó jégēdē bīya ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō jéeyī klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi. Ó lɛ ohílīpú klla jé odée nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ amānyā gɛ ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛɛ́. Aá blakwu ɛlā nōó ka lɛ aá eko nōó yɔ̄ Ugálīli ā.

eng_Latn: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kú um, nōo lɛ agbénú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā géē yá odúúdú ɛgbá kú aá lɛ aá kwɛyí um ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ agbénū kú nū nwunééné lɛ ā ohígbū Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá.

eng_Latn: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
idu_Latn: N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā abālɔbányā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú um, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē yɔ̄ ī bá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ piyóó. Awɔ, Óndú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō, le okónu ce ɛ́ɛ́, ka a géē yɔ̄ ī hɔ́hā ce ayááyí um piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla Ubásɛmati, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Íssmɛ̄lu, ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyā kú Unɛ́báyɔ̄tus.

eng_Latn: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛfú ɔnya kú uwá géē pahīla klá úláyi kú ɔlɛ́ aá, kllā í ŋmó ācɛ mla ɛ̄wā kú uwá. Upíla mla ákanaba kú aá nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúú nēe bī ɔdɔ kú ɔlɛ́ ā háyi ā géē je wúla wā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n gē yá ā, á jɛ́yí nū abālɔbányā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, amáŋ a géē jɛ́yí nū ɛ̄cɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
idu_Latn: Alɔ yɔ̄ í yɛ bá ɔ́kɔŋgɔ̄ kú ísu ā iyē, ípú unwalu nɛ̄hi jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ gāājɛ ɛga éyi nēé hī ka okónu ísu olɔhi, nōo kwu igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ulásiya ajaajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujúda géē lɛ onyatá, ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā kē í lā ɛbɔ́. É kē í hī Ujerúsālɛm ka, Ɔwɔicō gē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī dóódu géē tɔ́ɔna kú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá lɛ ɛ̄cī ɔhá. Otú éyééye gē ka ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ otú nōo gboce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
idu_Latn: O je úklɔ́ lɛ okwáahi gē tū íwɔ́tū bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ le alemú ogwucɛ́kwɔ gwá nɛ̄ ayīnu kú nū le kwíijile ā, ámāŋ o lɛbɛ̄ɛka ódūdū nōo gē kwū tū ɔ̄cɛ eyī ā.

eng_Latn: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ éyi kú uwā le ɛkpa kú nū nwūla kóō je ɔdōlé lɛ ijakī kú nū otú ā, ɛga nēé gbo ā, ó le ije kú nū má ce ɛyí īkpɔ̄dā ipú ɛkpa kú nū.

eng_Latn: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ um bī wā ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīpú ā á. Inu ɛpa bá abɔ́ɔ, nēe gē nwūla ga ódúúdɔ̄lɛ́ eyīyɛ̄cɛ ā. Éyi kú aínu ā lɛ eyī pīya kwu ɛháajɛ áklō kú okómpinu kú ɛhícō ā. Ɔhá ā kē lɛ eyī pīya kwú ɛhícō, áklō kú okómpinu kú ɛháajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, Ujɛhósāfati lɛ okónu kú ɛbɔ́ ce mla oklóbīya éyi nēé hī ka Ahasíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo yá ucé kú ɔ́bíipú alɛwa.
